raw.description:
Summary

Closes profitable sales of technology-based solutions for customer business environments. Researches sales leads, obtains knowledge of customer organizations, develops customer relationships, builds strong business relationships with partners and vendors, and generates product and/or services proposals and quotations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Owns all sales activities in assigned accounts or regions and achieves established sales targets annually.

  • Creates business cases and high-level financial models including ROI and TCO analysis to help in positioning and selling of technology-based solutions to solve business problems.

  • Sells to both large and SMB clients via direct new sales, alliances and leverages existing client base, both broad market and vertical.

  • Constructs clear value proposition for clients which includes business benefits (i.e. OPEX vs. CAPEX substitution, ROI, TCO).

  • Engages proactively with Solutions and Services, Marketing and Operations teams.

  • Compiles lists of prospective customers for use as sales leads, based on information from own professional network, industry ads, trade shows, Internet Web sites, newspapers, business directories, and other sources.

  • Builds and maintains research on prospective and current customers relating to how each customer is organized (hierarchically, brands, channels, and key relationships).

  • Establishes and maintains current customer and potential customer relationships.

  • Gains clear understanding of customer business requirements.

  • Educates customers on full breadth of solutions offered by Logicalis.

  • Prepares presentations, proposals and sales contracts.

  • Identifies and resolves customer concerns.

  • Demonstrates and actively promotes an understanding and commitment to the mission of Logicalis through performing behaviors consistent with the organization's values.

  • Maintains a working knowledge of applicable Federal, State, and Local laws and regulations as well as policies and procedures of Logicalis in order to ensure adherence in a manner that reflects honest, ethical and professional behaviors.

  • Supports and conducts self in a manner consistent with customer service expectations.

Supervisory Responsibilities

While this job has no direct supervisory responsibilities, guidance may be provided to Technical Consultants, Delivery Consultants, Customer Support Representatives, and Inside Sales Representatives.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual should be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education/Experience/Technical Requirements/Certifications

Equivalent combination accepted.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in related field.

Experience / Technical Requirements

  • 3 years demonstrated outside sales experience selling Information Technology products (i.e. HP Storage, Cisco, and IBM) and consulting services/managed services.

  • 3 years combining products and services into technology solutions that meet customer business needs.

  • Technical sales expertise selling to both Enterprise and SMB market and strong familiarity with Cloud, Managed Services, and Web 2.0 technical concepts.

  • Fundamental understanding of consultative, solutions sales process for dedicated, managed, cloud, and hybrid web hosting solutions.

  • Demonstrated success in strategic thinking, planning and implementation – a strong desire and track record of getting things done.

  • Aptitude, ambition, and eagerness to join A-level Sales Team and contribute to fun, professional culture focused on growth and outcomes.

  • Proficient use of Microsoft Office applications.

Certifications

  • Various vendor certifications as necessary.

Other Skills and Abilities

  • Strong technical and customer interaction skills.

  • Self-starter with excellent organizational, administrative and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to multi-task and work in fast paced environment.

  • Ability to successfully work as a team and independently.

  • Detail oriented.

  • Ability to follow through with tasks, projects, troubleshooting with minimal supervision.

  • Outstanding oral, written, technical and business communication skills.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that should be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is constantly required to sit, talk, see, hear, and use hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand; move about, climb steps or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this classification. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of personnel so classified.

Logicalis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to employ people who are qualified by reason of education, training, experience, and demonstrated performance. We value diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, marital status, age, height, weight, disability, veteran status, or any other reason prohibited by applicable federal or state laws.

NOTE:It is Logicalis’ practice that when a client requires medical testing, the employee must accept that requirement as a condition of their assignment and either submit to the tests or show proof they’ve completed the test satisfactorily (i.e., TB Test negative).

Salary Compensation Range: $50,000 to $80,000 plus uncapped commission.

Overview

Flexible Worker Contract

Location:Remote

 

About the role

We're excited to be looking for a Technical Reviewers within our Assessment Solutions team on a flexible worker contract for the following qualification:

NCFE Level 1/2 Technical Award in Graphic Design

As a Technical Reviewer you’ll provide the subject matter and assessment expertise necessary to support NCFE in setting and maintaining consistent standards across assessments within a subject area across levels, modes and over time.

You’ll support the Assessment Solutions team by reviewing assessments during key stages identified in the production process, and provide constructive technical based feedback and suggestions to ensure assessment papers and mark schemes meet the requirements of the assessment criteria as set out in the qualification specification.

Whilst this is a flexible worker role, we expect a reasonable level of commitment during assigned pieces of work that take place throughout the year. On occasion, availability during business hours will be required.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Carrying out technical reviews of assessments in line with internal quality and compliance processes
  • Attending pre-standardisation sessions to ensure a consistent application of mark schemes, making any necessary amendments to mark scheme details and guidance to maintain consistency in marking across examiners
  • Engaging with NCFE’s pre-assessment release panel, responding to and clarifying any sector related queries/issues identified prior to paper (s) going live.
  • Attending, reviewing and commissioning meetings to support decisions on the next round of paper production as well as sharing and discussing lessons learned

We'd love to hear from you if you offer the following:

  • A degree level (or equivalent) qualification in Graphic Design
  • Experience of writing and/or reviewing assessments and mark schemes for qualifications in Graphic Design
  • Experience of working within a related role, such as teaching, assessment design or production or examining of related qualifications
  • An understanding of assessment principles (validity, reliability, fairness, accessibility, manageability)
  • Excellent attention to detail, ability to work accurately and consistently
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with competing deadlines

Feeling inspired? Read the full Job Description

Why work as a flexible worker for NCFE?

Our flexible workforce provides supportive quality assurance to ensure that learners taking NCFE qualifications are getting the best education possible. If you become a flexible worker with us, you’ll choose how to fit your work around your other personal and professional commitments – making this a great opportunity to make a difference in a way that suits you.

You’ll receive full training and the materials, tools or equipment needed to ensure you’re able to complete your duties in line with NCFE requirements, with the ability to take on flexible worker contract alongside other work, without the need to be registered as self-employed.

All applicants will be expected to adhere to NCFE’s behavioural framework and to uphold our core values.

Shape real change with an NCFE career

Imagine a career where your contributions affect not only what people learn, but the way that learning is developed and delivered.

With over 170 years of education experience our core purpose remains at the heart of the organisation – to promote and advance learning to create a fairer, more inclusive society, making sure no learner is left behind.  

Want to know more? Take a look at our website

How to apply

Before applying, please note that we require all candidates to be able to demonstrate proof of Right to Work in the UK.

Ready to join us and shape real change? Apply with your CV and answer the associated application questions.

Closing Date: Friday 30 October 2026

Interview Date: TBC

Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) statement

We're committed to building rich diversity into our workforce at all levels, to ensure that we understand and are representative of the communities and customers we serve.

We do not discriminate against anyone due to their gender, sexuality, race, age, religion, beliefs, identity, social background, visible or hidden disability, or neurodiversity. Instead, we pride ourselves on our collaborative, vibrant and high-performance culture which embraces everyone, celebrates uniqueness, and enables everyone's voice to be heard.

raw.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

BeOne Medicines is a global biotechnology company committed to developing innovative cancer medicines that are more accessible and affordable to more patients around the world. At BeOne, we say, "Cancer has no borders. Neither do we." BeOne was founded in 2010 to bring impactful medicines to the greatest number of patients possible.


Reporting to the Franchise Head Solid Tumors, the Marketing Lead Solid Tumors is accountable for maximizing the performance of BeOne's Solid Tumor portfolio in Germany. The role owns the portfolio and brand strategy, leads the brand planning and go-to-market process, and drives execution against agreed commercial objectives, budgets and performance indicators. As leader of a small marketing team of 1-2 direct reports, the Marketing Lead sets priorities, develops talent and creates a high-performance, collaborative culture across the franchise.


Essential Functions of Job:

  • Own the Solid Tumor portfolio and brand strategy for Germany, translating global direction and market insights into clear national priorities, launch plans and measurable objectives.
  • Lead the cross-functional brand planning process and ensure aligned execution with Sales, Medical, Market Access, Customer Engagement, Commercial Operations and Business Analytics.
  • Develop differentiated positioning, messaging and customer-centric omnichannel campaigns, including promotional materials and field-force tools, in line with applicable standards and regulations.
  • Generate and apply market, customer and competitor insights through market research, advisory boards, analytics and field feedback to inform decisions and optimize impact.
  • Lead launch readiness and lifecycle planning for current and future Solid Tumor indications, identifying risks, opportunities and required capabilities early.
  • Own brand budgets, agency and vendor management, resource allocation and performance tracking, ensuring disciplined investment and delivery against commercial goals.
  • Enable execution through regular communication, training and updates for Key Account Managers and other customer-facing teams.
  • Lead, coach and develop 1-2 direct reports by setting clear objectives, providing ongoing feedback, managing performance and supporting career development.
  • Create a focused, accountable and collaborative team environment; prioritize work across the team and build marketing capabilities for future portfolio growth.
  • Keep management informed of material market and competitor developments, represent the franchise at relevant national and international meetings, and consistently operate with patients at the center and in accordance with BeOne standards, local laws and regulations.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Direct leadership responsibility for 1-2 marketing team members, with potential expansion aligned to portfolio and pipeline growth.
  • Accountable for objective setting, performance management, coaching, development, succession planning and talent retention.
  • Ensures clear roles, effective prioritization and strong collaboration within the team and across the franchise.

Qualifications:

  • Life sciences degree or comparable scientific education; advanced business qualification is an advantage.
  • +7 years of relevant commercial experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including substantial marketing and brand leadership experience.
  • Strong knowledge of the German oncology market; Solid Tumor and lung cancer experience is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated success in launch preparation, strategic brand planning, omnichannel execution, budget management and performance tracking.
  • People leadership experience, or strong evidence of readiness to lead, coach and develop a small team.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence senior stakeholders and translate strategy into focused execution in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Strong strategic, analytical and commercial judgment, combined with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach and a high level of accountability.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder-management skills; fluent German and English, written and spoken.
  • Proficiency in standard Microsoft Office applications.

Other Qualifications:

Additional major European language is an advantage.


Travel:

Approximately 25% of time.

Salary Range Germany: 105,600.00 EUR - 132,000.00 EUR

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity, and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. BeOne does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Join a Baltic IT powerhouse that has been the central counterparty for multiple major banking projects across Scandinavia and the Baltics so its clients never have to juggle multiple vendors.

As the Business / Data Analyst, you will join the Customer Ledger Migration initiative at one of their key banking partners – one of the largest provider of financial services in the Baltics, serving private and business customers across Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania. You will act as the bridge between business, IT, migration and reporting teams – coordinating data-related activities, validating migration data and building Power BI dashboards that give stakeholders full transparency on migration progress, data quality and delivery.

What you will do:

Coordinate data-related activities across business, IT, migration and reporting teams.

Manage migration-related scope, requirements and JIRA tickets across business and IT teams.

Analyse and validate migration data, identify data quality issues and support reconciliation activities.

Gather and document reporting requirements and KPIs together with stakeholders.

Design and develop Power BI dashboards to track migration progress, data quality and delivery metrics.

Facilitate discussions between business, migration and technical teams to ensure alignment and transparency.

What you bring:

4-6 years of experience in business analysis or related roles across the full software development lifecycle (mid-level / senior).

Consulting-level Power BI expertise – designing dashboards, reports, data models and visualisations.

Strong SQL and data analysis skills to query data, validate requirements and support insights.

Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills – able to translate business needs into technical specifications.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office – Excel (pivot tables, formulas), Word (documentation) and PowerPoint (presentations).

Fluency with JIRA, Confluence or similar tools for managing requirements, documentation and workflows.

Bonus if you have:

Understanding of financial products, processes and IT systems in banking or finance.

Experience with data migration or core banking transformation programmes.

Understanding of customer ledger and reconciliation processes.

Knowledge of data warehousing and reporting concepts.

A proactive, self-driven mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with evolving technologies and priorities.

What we offer:

Full-time engagement on a high-impact core banking migration programme with one of the largest universal banks in the Baltics

Flexible working – hybrid or fully remote from anywhere in the Baltics / EU

Contract role through the consultancy, placed with a banking end-client

raw.description:
Job Title:

Key Account Excellence Manager – Continental Europe - External Title

Associate Manager, Account and Client Management - Internal Title

Location: Hamburg, Germany

Summary:

We are seeking an Key Account Excellence Manager to join our fast-growing Hershey’s team in Europe.

The Key Account Excellence Manager – Continental Europe drives Hershey’s profitable growth with Pan‑EU retailers and priority national accounts across Continental Europe (ex‑UK & Ireland). Operating without direct reports yet with high influence in a matrix, the role partners closely with the Business Development Manager Europe, distributors, and cross‑functional teams (Customer Marketing, Finance, Category, Supply Chain) to deliver customer‑back strategies and flawless execution.

The key priority goal in the region is to achieve market financial goals which include but are not limited to: Net Sales, Gross Profit, distribution gains (numeric & weighted), sell‑out velocity, promo ROI, and operating income. The role builds and executes customer Joint Business Plans, steers trade investment governance (plan, budget, ROI), and ensures consistent delivery of assortment, pricing, promotional calendars, retail media, and Perfect Store standards across markets. Externally, it represents Hershey with distributor key account teams and senior retailer stakeholders, cultivating long‑term partnerships and unlocking multi‑country initiatives.

The role requires working with the team to develop and implement an effective and coordinated trade marketing and sales plan in support of Pan-EU business strategies. The role is also a customer facing role representing the corporation with recognized distributors & retail customers within the market/s.

The ideal candidate combines Pan‑EU customer leadership, data‑driven commercial acumen, and the ability to influence without authority, staying current on trade trends, retail dynamics, and commercial enablers while continuously developing capabilities through ongoing learning.

Major Duties/Responsibilities:

STRATEGY & CUSTOMER LEADERSHIP

Working with the Business Development Managers this person will:

  • Build and execute customer strategies for Pan‑EU retailers and priority accounts; lead JBPs (through distributors where applicable).
  • Work to establish: “how to win” trade programs that deliver the outcomes required with clear marketing, sales and financial deliverables.
  • Translate category insights into assortment, pricing, promo, and activation plans.
  • Communicate and consistently monitor progress of the execution of the Pan-EU strategy with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop and execute joint business plans with retailers through distributor partners and identified key Pan-EU retailers within EU Europe.
  • Lead business reviews with distributors/retailers; escalate and resolve supply/commercial issues.

SALES AND TRADE MARKETING EXECUTION

  • Works with Business Development team to manage the total trade investment planning (trade send) for Pan‑EU customers: full‑year plan, budget control, course‑corrections, and ROI tracking.
  • Drive execution via distributor Key Account teams: distribution targets, shelf availability, planogram compliance, display & promo execution, and Perfect Store standards.
  • Partner with BDM Europe on route‑to‑market and pipeline; coordinate with Customer Marketing on sell‑in materials and activation calendars.
  • KPIs include but are not limited to: in-country sales, distribution, rate-of-sale, meeting retail driver standards, proper execution of in store activation strategies (perfect store blueprint execution, sales materials management).

FINANCE / Trade Spendings

Supports Business Development and Finance in the execution of a healthy P&L for the Pan-EU Accounts which includes but is not limited to: total ICS business, brands, channel and retailer P&Ls. Manages the appropriate levels of control and audit processes within the sales organization and with the distributor key account teams and coordinates both reporting and funding requirements with key internal and external partners with the Pan-Eu Business.

Competencies:

Effective Communicator and Collaborator

Influence without authority; stakeholder management across multi‑market distributor set‑ups. Strong communicator across multiple stakeholders within the business, both internal and external, and in various levels of seniority. Demonstrates an ability and enjoyment in working within a close team and liaising with colleagues on decision making and analysis.

Business Acumen

Commercial acumen & P&L ownership; trade investment governance. Understands how businesses work including how strategies and tactics work in the marketplace. Maintains working knowledge of competitors as well as current and possible future policies, practices, trends and information affecting his/ her business and organization.

Drive for Results

Pushes self and others to exceed goals and achieve breakthrough results. Recognizes the key actions necessary to achieve results; establishes and communicates the priorities to others; and, maintains own and others focus on achieving the important goals. Demonstrates persistence in overcoming roadblocks to achieving results and encourages others to do the same

modelling.

VIDIZMO is hiring a Business Development Representative to open new doors for our business. You'll bring 1 to 3 years of outbound sales experience, clear and confident English, and the energy to talk with new prospects every day. You'll win new business by contacting end customers directly and by bringing in deals through our partners. You'll set up meetings with the right people, make sure there's a real need, and hand qualified opportunities to our account team, with AI tools helping you research, prepare and follow up.

About VIDIZMO

Founded in 2009, VIDIZMO is an AI software company based in Tysons, Virginia. We build four products: Nexus, AI Intelligence Hub, AI Live Insight, and Redactor. They let organizations store, search, analyze, redact and share all kinds of unstructured data, including video, audio, images, documents and text, and they give every one of those formats equal weight.

Over 100 organizations rely on VIDIZMO in production. They work in public safety and justice, government, healthcare, financial services, education, legal, manufacturing and energy. Many of them deploy it on-premises, in air-gapped environments, or in FedRAMP High environments, and our architecture is aligned with the CJIS Security Policy.

We sell both directly and through channel partners around the world, so this team deals with end customers and partners every day. VIDIZMO is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, a Microsoft Solutions Partner for Data & AI, and an NVIDIA Inception partner. Customers can purchase through GSA, Carahsoft, and state and cooperative contract vehicles.

We use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot every day, and we expect you to use them well. You're responsible for reviewing anything AI helps you create for accuracy, completeness and compliance, and the final result is yours to own.

Your Responsibilities

  • Reach out to end customers and partners daily by phone and message, working from a prioritized call list.
  • Spend at least two hours every day in live conversations with new prospects and partners.
  • Set up meetings with key decisionmakers and confirm that they have a real need.
  • Convert qualified interest into opportunities and pass them to the account team with a clear summary.
  • Register partner opportunities on the day you learn about them and bring on a new partner when a deal requires one.
  • Record every call, email and meeting in HubSpot on the day it happens.
  • Use Claude or a similar AI assistant daily to research prospects, prepare for calls, write outreach and follow up.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
  • Clear, confident English, both spoken and written, and easy to understand on calls with US buyers.
  • 1 to 3 years in outbound business development, lead generation or inside sales, or clear proof that you can do the work.
  • Comfortable making a high number of calls and hearing "no."
  • Experience using HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo or similar tools.
  • A habit of recording every call and meeting on the same day.
  • A history of automating your own routine work with AI, for example with reusable prompts, Claude Projects, AI-assisted workflows or simple scripts. Share an example of something you automated.
  • Experience selling a SaaS product or service to US buyers, including outbound cold calling, is strongly preferred.
  • Able to make this a full-time commitment, without concurrent freelance work or outside business ventures.
  • Current US residence and authorization to work in the United States without visa sponsorship.

Why You'll Stand Out

Rejection doesn't stop you. After a "no," you're ready for the next call with the same energy. You're a good listener, you can tell the difference between real interest and politeness, and your pipeline and CRM are always organized. You use AI to prepare faster and follow up without missing a step, and you own your results without needing close supervision.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for highly motivated, self-driven, technical senior consultants dedicated to making a difference in global security by protecting organisations against the most advanced attackers in the world. Our CrowdStrike Services team offers opportunities to expand your skill set through a wide variety of engagements including front page incident response investigations for organisations you’ll find on the annual Fortune 100 list.


Am I a Senior Consultant Candidate?

  • Do you find yourself interested in and keeping up with the latest vulnerabilities and breaches?
  • Are you self-motivated and looking for an opportunity to rapidly accelerate your skills?
  • Do you crave new and innovative work that actually matters to your customer?
  • Do you have an Incident Response or Information Security background that you’re not fully utilising?
  • Are you capable of operating as an individual contributor and interacting with customers?
  • Do you love working around smart people who you can learn from and mentor on a daily basis?

What You'll Do:

  • Serve as part the technical team on incident response engagements
  • Develop and use new methods to hunt for bad actors across large sets of data.
  • Work under the direction of project leadership and outside counsel to conduct intrusion investigations
  • Perform host and/or network-based forensics across Windows, Mac, and Linux platforms.
  • Support the production of high-quality written and verbal reports, presentations, recommendations, and findings to key stakeholders including customer management, regulators, and legal counsel .

What You'll Need:

Successful candidates will have knowledge of or experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Incident Response: experience conducting or managing incident response investigations for organisations, investigating targeted threats such as the Nation-State, E-Crime, and Hacktivists.
  • Computer Forensic Analysis: a background using forensic analysis tools in incident response investigations to determine the extent and scope of compromise.
  • Network Forensic Analysis: strong knowledge of network protocols, network analysis tools like Bro/Zeek or Suricata, and ability to perform analysis of associated network logs.
  • Reverse Engineering: ability to understand the capabilities of static and dynamic malware analysis.
  • Incident Remediation: strong understanding of targeted attacks and able to support creating customized tactical and strategic remediation plans for compromised organizations.
  • Network Operations and Architecture/Engineering: understanding of secure network architecture and strong background in performing network operations.
  • Cloud Incident Response: knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP incident response methodologies.
  • Communications: strong ability to communicate executive and/or detailed level findings to clients; ability to effectively communicate tasks, guidance, and methodology with internal teams
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Additionally, all candidates must possess the following qualifications:

  • Capable of completing technical tasks with limited supervision.
  • Desire to grow and expand both technical and soft skills.
  • Ability to foster a positive work environment and attitude.

Education:


We are seeking candidates with the right combination of training and skills to join our team. Experience, drive, and results are key and advanced degrees are not required. Successful candidates coming from an academic background will likely have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Math, Information Security, Information Assurance, Information Security Management, Cybersecurity, Cybersecurity Policy, or a related discipline.


Applicants without a degree but with relevant work experience and/or training will be considered, and should apply their previous experience to the qualification areas above.

raw.description:
We are recruiting highly skilled linguists and creative thinkers for an exclusive content development project. Our goal is to evaluate and push the boundaries of advanced linguistic and reasoning capabilities by creating original, highly complex reasoning puzzles in various target languages. These puzzles must be solvable by a smart, educated native speaker, but resistant to standard automated solving techniques or web searches.

As a Puzzle Designer, you will write original reasoning prompts in your native language. You will focus on deep structural, cultural, and logical nuances that only a true native speaker can navigate.

You will create puzzles across three primary categories:

  • Linguistic Reasoning: Puzzles based on complex grammar rules, syntactic structures, or linguistic ambiguities unique to your language.

  • Cultural Reasoning: Logic puzzles grounded in deep cultural context, local traditions, or culturally-grounded mathematics that AI lacks the lived experience to understand.

  • Wordplay & Riddles: Advanced, original riddles, puns, or double-meanings that do not exist on the internet and cannot be easily translated word-for-word.

Deliverables per item:

For every puzzle you create, you will be required to submit the following:

  1. Native-Language Prompt: The original puzzle written flawlessly in the target language.

  2. Gold Answer: The definitive, correct solution.

  3. Rationale: A logical breakdown of why the answer is correct and how a native speaker arrives at it.

  4. English Translation: A high-quality English translation of the prompt, answer, and rationale for project managers to review.

  5. Difficulty Rating: An assessment of how challenging the puzzle is for a native speaker.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Native-level fluency in the target language with exceptional writing skills.

  • High proficiency in English to provide clear, accurate translations and rationales.

  • Background in Linguistics, Creative Writing, Translation, or Logic/Mathematics: You understand the mechanics of your language deeply.

  • Creative & Analytical Thinker: You can design problems that require lateral thinking, cultural context, and multi-step reasoning rather than memorized facts.

  • Advanced Problem-Solving Awareness: You understand how automated and computational systems process language, enabling you to design highly resistant, complex prompts.

What to Avoid (Disqualifiers)

  • Trivia questions or historical facts that can be Googled.

  • Translating existing English riddles or math problems into your native language.

  • Copying puzzles from books, websites, or existing online databases.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. If interested kindly submit your application on or before 30th October 2026

This role serves in a dual capacity, providing enterprise-level operational leadership as Deputy to the Service Reliability & Operations Manager while maintaining direct responsibility for the Major Incident Management (MIM) workstream.

As Deputy, this position will support the coordination, performance, and continuous improvement of enterprise monitoring and service reliability operations spanning monitoring, instrumentation, event management, incident response, and related operational functions. The Deputy will work closely with functional leaders to align priorities, address operational risks, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and ensure consistent execution across a large, distributed 24x7 operating environment.

Strategic Advisor – Bridges and Transportation Infrastructure

About us

At Niricson, we are redefining the future of civil infrastructure maintenance. Using proprietary sensing technology and AI-powered analytics, we help asset owners make smarter, faster, and safer decisions for critical infrastructure such as bridges, dams and spillways, tunnels, airfields, and more.

As we scale across North America and beyond, we are seeking experienced, well-connected industry advisors to guide our growth, validate our approach, and connect us with the people and problems that matter most.

About the role

We are looking for a Strategic Advisor with deep expertise in bridge asset management or transportation infrastructure management. Ideally, someone with experience in asset ownership, engineering leadership, public works, or large-scale infrastructure portfolios. The advisor will be expected to provide information on how specific clients make decisions, who the key decision makers are, and when key opportunities are expected to be announced. The advisor may also provide information on proper positioning and messaging to key decision-makers.

This is a flexible, advisory engagement. You will work closely with Niricson’s Chief Sales Officer and leadership team to provide strategic insights, industry credibility, and introductions that accelerate our market penetration and alignment with customer needs.

This role is perfect for someone semi-retired, transitioning from public service, or consulting independently, who wants to remain engaged in the industry in a meaningful capacity.

Key Contributions

  • Provide strategic information on proper messaging, decision-makers, and bidding opportunities for clients
  • Advise on engagement strategies with municipal, provincial, and federal infrastructure bodies
  • Offer industry insights on market trends, procurement processes, and regulatory considerations for positioning Niricson’s Product
  • Support credibility-building with potential clients (e.g., participate in key meetings, webinars, and white papers)
  • Introduce Niricson to relevant stakeholders and potential partners, including public works departments, ministries of transportation, and engineering consultants
  • Collaborate on industry events, speaking opportunities, or roundtables where relevant
  • Offer independent feedback on product-market fit and key customer pain points
  • Provide introductions to key decision makers and leadership

Who You Are

  • 15+ years of experience in bridge inspection, transportation infrastructure, public works infrastructure, asset management, or public sector leadership
  • Former Director, Executive, or Asset Owner in a relevant agency or organization
  • Deep understanding of government procurement processes and operational realities of asset management
  • Respected in the industry, with an established professional network
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to act as a trusted advisor
  • Comfortable working independently under a services agreement (not as an employee)

Engagement Structure

This is an independent contractor role and is not considered employment under Canadian law.

As such:

  • You will enter into a subcontract for services with Niricson
  • You will invoice for your time collaborating with the team
  • You are responsible for your own tax filings, business registration, and applicable insurance

What We Offer

  • A chance to influence the future of civil infrastructure and condition maintenance
  • A collaborative and respectful leadership team that values your expertise
  • Flexible, remote engagement
  • Competitive advisory compensation structure
  • Opportunity to help shape safer, longer-lasting infrastructure around the world

Diversity and Inclusion

Niricson values the unique experience of professionals from all backgrounds. We strongly encourage expressions of interest from equity-deserving groups, including indigenous peoples, racialized individuals, women, persons with disabilities, and 2SLGBTQIA+ communities.

We’re a close-knit, mission-driven team that celebrates curiosity, diversity, and excellence.

raw.title: Social Media Lead (Student Creator, Part-Time)
raw.excerpt: Knowt is the study app about 8 million high schoolers use to get through AP classes, the SAT and ACT, finals, and college apps.
raw.description:
Knowt is the study app about 8 million high schoolers use to get through AP classes, the SAT and ACT, finals, and college apps. We’re looking for someone to be the face and voice of Knowt’s high school social presence. You’ll own our TikTok and Instagram (@getknowt) end to end and make them the account students actually want to follow: funny, relatable, and useful.

This isn’t a brand marketing job. You’re not talking at high schoolers. You’re one of them, or close enough that you still speak the language. You know the 2am cram sessions, the group chat panic before an AP exam, the SAT score reveal, and the Common App essay spiral, and you know how to turn all of it into content that hits.

The basics

  • Part-time, 15–20 hrs/week

  • Fully remote

  • Base pay plus performance bonuses tied to account growth

  • You’ll report to our Student Marketing Manager and work with her every day

  • You’ll start with an established account: 476K followers, backed by a platform 8 million students use. You’re not building from zero.

What you’ll do

Create

  • Post one talk-to-camera video every day to TikTok and Instagram. You’re on screen.

  • Take each video from idea to posted: hook, script, filming, editing, caption.

  • Make content about what high schoolers are actually dealing with (AP exams, the SAT and ACT, finals, college apps, test stress) and make it feel like it came from a friend, not a company.

  • Work Knowt into content naturally, so students want to watch it and then use the app.

  • Keep every post native to the platform and to high school culture: current sounds, formats, humor, and slang that’s actually in use, not cringe.

Grow

  • Keep testing hooks, formats, storytelling angles, and CTAs to find winning formulas you can repeat.

  • Plan content around the school calendar so you reach students exactly when they need Knowt: AP season, SAT and ACT test dates, finals, application deadlines.

  • Turn trends, comment sections, and performance data into new content ideas.

Own the results

  • Send a weekly recap: what performed, what didn’t, and what you’re changing next.

  • Track views, watch time, saves, shares, comments, and signups, and make the call on what to scale, fix, or drop.

  • Stay ahead of the schedule. Film in batches so the account never misses a day.

How we work together

Every post is reviewed by our Student Marketing Manager before it goes live. That’s not a committee rewriting your hooks. It’s a fast feedback loop with someone who knows this audience and this account inside out. Expect notes on most videos early on, fewer as you find your rhythm. You’ll need to build time into your week for revisions and turn feedback around within 24 hours.

What we’re looking for

You need:

  • Experience running and growing an account, your own or a brand’s. Show us the numbers.

  • Real comfort on camera. You’ll be on screen every day, so this is non-negotiable.

  • Fluency in high school culture. You’ve lived AP classes, standardized tests, and application season recently enough that it still feels like your world.

  • An instinct for what goes viral on TikTok and Instagram, and the ability to explain why.

  • Reliability. You hit deadlines, respond to feedback quickly, and treat the account like it’s yours.

  • A data-driven approach. Your creative calls are backed by views and conversion data.

Nice to have:

  • Experience making content for edtech, test prep, or student audiences

  • Experience scripting for other creators

  • Strong AP, SAT, or ACT results of your own (credibility goes a long way with this audience)

Why this one’s worth it

  • A real audience from day one. Growing an account this size is something you can point to for years.

  • Real ownership. You set the creative direction, and your ideas don’t get lost in layers of approval. You get direct feedback from one person who wants you to win.

  • A small team that moves fast. You’ll work directly with our Student Marketing Manager, with access to our CMO.

  • Flexible hours, plus room to grow the role if it’s working.

How to apply and what happens next

Apply through the link. If you look like a fit:

  1. Interview with our Student Marketing Manager

  2. Skills screen: a short practical exercise (think scripting and filming a sample video)

  3. Final interview with our Student Marketing Manager and CMO

Alkirais a fast-growing cloud networking company that is transforming the way enterprise networks are deployed and managed. As we continue to reinvent networking for the multi-cloud era and as our customers continue to grow with us, we are expanding our Escalations team in the US.

We're looking for an Sr. Escalation Engineer to work on technical issues experienced by our highest-value customers. This is a full-time position with great benefits in a company that rewards innovation, respects diversity and encourages teamwork. You will be part of a team that is excited to support technical issues experienced by our highest-value customers that cannot be resolved through the normal Support process. This role will work closely with customers and internal teams to resolve any day-2 related activities.

Location: We are only considering US and Canada candidates at this time

Responsibilities:

  • Own root cause analysis for critical customer problems - be the point of contact that works with the Engineering and Customer Success team.
  • Provide support to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues that have been escalated from customer success team
  • Identify bugs, test, reproduce, report and work with the Engineers to assist with a fix and test/verify fix versions
  • Provide ideas and assist with creation of documentation and training material for external and internal Support Center content
  • Maintain clear, concise, and positive communication for all cases in a timely and efficient manner including follow-ups with customers, team members, and engineers
  • Learn in-depth the latest features and offering from Alkira
  • Work with the internal QA team to cover any gaps in testing and automation.
  • Work with development teams to provide feedback and guidance for new features/improvements.
  • Provide escalation support during off hours - on call will be required

Requirements:

  • Minimum 8+ years of experience in technical support, design or implementation
  • Strong networking fundamentals & expert troubleshooting skills with Routing, Tunneling & Security protocols, QoS, TCP/IP
  • Prior experience with AWS/Azure/GCP Cloud networking a plus
  • Knowledge of Python, Terraform or other scripting a plus
  • Conceptual knowledge of cloud native architecture with basic understanding of Kubernetes, REST APIs, various Databases.
  • Advanced experience with Linux - checking kernel logs and configuring networking components.
  • Experience using troubleshooting tools such as IXIA, tcpdump, Wireshark and iPerf3.
  • Must have the ability to learn new features and technologies as the industry evolves.
  • Strong leadership ability in managing complex engagements - a strong analytical mind and the ability to triage and think out of the box.
  • Excellent communication (both oral, written, and interpersonal) and customer service skills are a must.
  • Strong passion for providing exceptional support to our customers
  • Prior experience in large-scale network designing/deployment is a plus
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment while maintaining a positive attitude towards customers and team-members.
  • Proactively create and publish knowledge articles and internal troubleshooting guides.

Our platform helps customers move faster without managing hardware, stitching together providers, or operating fragmented cloud networks. Teams can build and scale connectivity on demand, apply consistent security and segmentation, and gain visibility across distributed environments from one place.

At Alkira, you’ll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud-like consumption, private-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build technology that changes how global businesses connect.

Join us and help build the future of networking.

As an AI-first innovation shop and AWS Advanced Tier Partner, RevStar builds cutting-edge cloud-native products that drive real client impact. We are seeking a senior Software Development Lead to act as a player-coach and technical standard bearer across our practice. In this role, you will raise the quality bar across all delivery teams through hands-on code contribution, architectural governance, developer enablement, and reusable technical accelerators. Above all, the ideal candidate embodies RevStar’s core values:

  • Self-Mastery: We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve.

  • Shared Destiny: We rise or fall together.

Your Impact Pillars

  1. Architectural Governance & Hands-On Engineering - Lead by example by writing high-quality production code, conducting code reviews, and solving complex architectural challenges across client engagements. Establish, document, and enforce modern engineering standards for ReactJS, NodeJS, and AWS cloud-native systems. Participate in the Product Development Standards Committee to define CI/CD, testing, security, and observability best practices while conducting periodic project audits to maintain compliance.
  2. Engineering Accelerators & AI Adoption - Build and maintain production-ready internal assets, including boilerplate repositories, reference architectures, and shared UI/backend components. Drive AI adoption across delivery teams using approved tool registries to accelerate development velocity and improve project profitability. Identify recurring technical friction points across client projects and engineer systemic, reusable solutions.

Lead company-wide Leadership Labs focused on technical decision-making, code maintainability, and trade-off analysis. Partner closely with Product Managers, DevOps, and QA leads to ensure technical solutions match product intent, business outcomes, and emerging cloud technologies.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with a track record of driving technical standards across multiple delivery teams.

  • Leadership & Influence: Proven ability to influence without authority, mentor senior engineers, and communicate complex technical trade-offs to stakeholders.
  • Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s in CS/Engineering (or equivalent experience); active AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect or Developer) are strongly preferred.

As the Creative Designer (DTC), you will execute DTC creatives (video editing & graphic design) for ads, web, email, and organic content by translating clear creative direction into fast, consistent, and high-quality outputs. You will contribute to the growth of the company's DTC channel by creating and iterating new creatives based on feedback, while keeping all assets organized and properly stored.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Execute DTC Ad Creatives for Meta Ads

  • Edit UGC videos and branded videos following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create static creatives following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create and iterate on variations of top-performing creatives based on DTC Lead feedback and performance insights.

Execute Web and Funnel Creative Assets

  • Design visuals for website pages and landing pages (images, banners, sections, etc.), ensuring designs are clean, clear, and aligned with brand and conversion goals.

Execute Email Creative Design

  • Design and update email creatives in Figma (or similar platform) for email flows and campaigns based on provided copy and direction, ensuring clear structure, strong visual quality, and alignment with brand and campaign needs.

Execute Organic Content Editing for Instagram

  • Edit and prepare video and photo content for Instagram (posts, reels, and stories), ensuring clear structure, strong pacing, and a clean, professional, and consistent visual style aligned with brand guidelines.

Maintain Creative Asset Organization & Hygiene

  • Maintain all creative assets organized, properly named, and stored within the defined folder structure, ensuring easy access, version control, and complete, ready-to-use deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience creating video and image creatives for ads, social media, or e-commerce, with a basic understanding of Meta Ads (hooks, pacing, clarity).
  • 1–3 years of experience using tools such as Figma, Adobe Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, including AI tools for image and video creation.
  • 1+ years of experience following creative direction and brand guidelines and translating them into clear and consistent designs.
  • 1+ years of experience creating ads, UGC videos, or social content, or a portfolio showcasing real client or brand work, with an emphasis on clear and effective creatives rather than polished perfection.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.

  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Efficiency: produces a high volume of creative assets quickly while maintaining quality and minimizing wasted effort.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changes in creative direction, feedback, and priorities without friction.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: keeps files, assets, and tasks well organized, ensuring easy access and clear structure.
  • Creativity / Innovation: develops variations and new ideas from top-performing creatives and DTC Lead feedback, improving and expanding existing concepts.
  • Teamwork: collaborates closely with the DTC team to stay aligned on creative direction, priorities, and execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through creative execution.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a creative professional who thrives in a fast-paced DTC environment, combines speed with consistency, and is motivated by clear creative direction, performance feedback, and continuous improvement.

raw.description:
WE’RE HIRING: SOCIAL MEDIA & PARTNERSHIPS COORDINATOR

Rumble Wellness Group | Independent Contractor | Remote, Canada

You create content. You build community. You bring brands to life.

You know what makes people stop scrolling, share a post, and want to be part of something.

You’re creative, organized, and hands-on. You can plan a content calendar, create engaging social content, capture the personality of a brand, and keep things moving without constant direction.

You understand that great social media is about more than posting consistently — it’s about building a recognizable brand and an engaged community.

WHO WE ARE

Rumble Wellness Group brings together two experience-driven brands: Rumble Boxing and PRML Social.

Rumble combines high-energy boxing and strength training with music, culture, and community. PRML Social brings together sauna, cold plunge, music, and social connection to create a different kind of wellness experience.

We're looking for someone who can bring both brands to life online while helping build meaningful local partnerships and community connections.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Social Media & Content Creation — Primary Focus

  • Own and manage the social media content calendar across Rumble Boxing and PRML Social.
  • Create, write, schedule, and publish engaging content that reflects each brand's personality.
  • Capture and edit short-form video, Reels, Stories, and other social-first content.
  • Turn classes, events, customer experiences, promotions, and behind-the-scenes moments into compelling stories.
  • Stay current on social trends, formats, and opportunities to keep our content fresh and relevant.
  • Coordinate with location teams to gather content and highlight local communities.
  • Monitor engagement and use performance insights to improve content and inform future calendars.

Partnerships & Community — Secondary Focus

  • Identify and coordinate local partnerships with businesses, creators, influencers, and community organizations.
  • Support collaborations, events, and activations that introduce new audiences to our brands.
  • Coordinate partnership deliverables, content collaborations, and social media promotion.
  • Build relationships that strengthen brand awareness and community engagement.

Collaboration & Execution

  • Work independently while collaborating with senior leadership and location teams.
  • Manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and keep projects moving.
  • Bring forward creative ideas and take ownership of execution from planning through delivery.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Creative: You have a strong eye for content, storytelling, and what works on social media.
  • Hands-on: You're comfortable filming, editing, writing copy, and publishing content yourself.
  • Organized: You can manage multiple content calendars, deadlines, and projects.
  • Social-savvy: You understand Instagram, TikTok, Reels, Stories, and emerging content trends.
  • Proactive: You take initiative, work independently, and don't need constant direction.
  • Collaborative: You're comfortable working with different teams, creators, and external partners.

Experience in social media management, content creation, fitness, wellness, hospitality, or lifestyle brands is an asset. Experience with tools such as Canva, CapCut, and social media scheduling platforms is a plus.

THE DETAILS

  • Location: Remote; with ability to get to site in Toronto.
  • Engagement: Independent contractor.
  • Hours: Approximately 15–20 hours per week, depending on business needs and agreed scope.
  • Compensation: Hourly contract rate based on experience.
  • Schedule: Flexible, with occasional evening or weekend availability for content capture and events.

THE BOTTOM LINE

We're looking for someone who can keep our brands visible, relevant, and connected to their communities — someone who can turn ideas into great content and consistently bring our social channels to life.

If you're creative, plugged into social culture, and love building brands through content, we'd love to meet you.

Salary: $25 – $30 / hour

  • Automated cloud SaaS backup and recovery (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, key business apps)
  • ITSM & ticketing (HaloPSA) for streamlined support

Expectations:

  • Complete client onboarding projects within defined timelines (typically 12 weeks per client)

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years experience in MSP, IT systems engineering, or cybersecurity roles
  • Strong hands-on experience with Google Workspace admin, EDR, and SaaS backup
  • Familiarity with PSA/ticketing systems (HaloPSA, ConnectWise, Autotask, etc.)
  • Excellent documentation and client communication skills
  • Self-starter, able to work independently and remotely
  • Relevant certifications (Google Workspace Admin, CompTIA Security+, etc.) preferred but not required

Compensation:

  • Project-based onboarding fee
  • Monthly retainer for ongoing support (scales with client/user count)
  • Opportunity to grow with the company as our MSP business expands

raw.description:
About Trideca

Trideca is Australia's trusted strategy, AI, and digital transformation partner, helping some of the nation's largest enterprises (including NAB, Suncorp, Optus, Medibank, and AGL) drive meaningful business impact through technology.

With offices in Melbourne and Sydney and projects spanning multiple industries, we thrive on solving complex challenges, delivering cutting-edge solutions, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

About the opportunity

Trideca is delivering the implementation phase of a large customer identity transformation for one of Australia's best known regulated enterprises. The program moves customer identity from Okta to Auth0 across web, mobile, API and IVR channels, serving millions of customers. Design is complete, and the Auth0 platform is now ready to be built. That means tenancies, token services, security configuration and CI/CD. We are looking for an Identity Platform Lead who has built Auth0 at enterprise, customer scale before and can lead that build from the first day. You will have to work in Sydney/Melbourne time

What you will do

  • You will design and stand up Auth0 tenancies across development, test, staging and production.
  • You will build the token issuance and validation services and define the token and session architecture for every channel.
  • You will set the WAF rules, rate limiting and security hardening around each tenancy, and build a CI/CD pipeline that deploys Auth0 configuration as code.
  • You will also define a blue/green cutover approach so the new Auth0 flows can run alongside Okta without disrupting live traffic.
  • You will own the technical migration path from Okta to Auth0, including how existing sessions and credentials move across.
  • You will work closely with the established API, iOS and Android squads to define the contract each channel builds against, and make sure machine to machine traffic stays correctly scoped on Okta during the transition.
  • You will be the senior technical voice on identity. That means resolving the remaining platform level questions, making the key technical calls, documenting the build so it can be operated and extended after handover, and raising go live risk early, given that some cutover changes cannot be rolled back.

What you bring

  • You have stood up Auth0 tenancies at enterprise, customer facing scale, not only integrated applications against an existing tenancy.
  • You have migrated an identity platform from Okta or a comparable enterprise IAM product to Auth0.
  • You know OAuth2, OIDC, token services and Auth0 Actions in depth from hands on work.
  • You have defined WAF and security configuration for a customer identity platform, and applied Terraform or an equivalent infrastructure as code tool to identity configuration.
  • You work well in ambiguity and can find the questions nobody has asked yet.
  • Experience in financial services, healthcare or another regulated industry is highly regarded.

What success looks like

A working Auth0 authorizer in a lower environment that unblocks API testing. Clear, documented ownership of the identity platform. A pipeline that deploys Auth0 configuration reliably and repeatably. A cutover plan in which outage and rollback risk is understood and mitigated. Delivery squads building against a stable, tested platform rather than mocked outputs.

Why Choose Trideca?

Empowering Women in Technology: We are committed to closing the gender gap in technology. With our dedicated road map for women, you'll find tailored opportunities to advance your career, supported by mentorship, leadership programs, Women in Technology Chapter and inclusive policies like menstruation leave and flexible working options.

Growth Through Learning: Your growth is our priority. At Trideca, you'll have access to a wide range of learning and development initiatives, from certifications and workshops to personal development programs, ensuring you are always at the forefront of technology and innovation.

Work Your Way: Our flexible work policy supports you to balance your personal and professional life.

Trideca Values

Clients Come First

We obsess over our clients; they mean everything to us and are central to everything we do. We take the time to understand them, so we can deliver outstanding experiences and create moments of WOW.

Achieve Greatness Together

Business is a team sport, and we are here to win. We respect, value, and inspire each other to bring our best to raise the bar. We will high-five you when you've nailed it and have honest discussions when you don't.

We Celebrate Our Differences

We are stronger and more successful when we include and appreciate different backgrounds, ideas, and experiences. Diversity helps us be more creative, solve problems better, and achieve more. By valuing everyone's unique contributions, we create a cohesive workplace where everyone can thrive and grow.

Own Your Space

We own our space, relationships, and client outcomes. We are fully committed and accountable to ourselves and each other; we deliver what we commit to. We adopt a commercial outlook and expect everyone to think and make decisions like we are the CEO.

Debate, Agree, Commit

We champion open dialogue where every voice matters and ideas are rigorously challenged to create stronger solutions. Once we reach alignment, we commit fully as one team and execute with excellence and accountability.

Have Fun, Go Nuts

No explanation is required, have fun, go nuts.

We also believe that the unique contributions of everyone at Trideca is the driver of our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to embrace everyone's perspectives and experiences, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We are passionate about creating a workplace that fosters active participation and provides an equal playing field, where merit and accomplishment are the sole criteria for success. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. We celebrate the diversity of our workforce and are dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels welcome, valued, and included.

They will be available to clients, family members, or community representatives to answer any questions regarding HTCC services. They are responsible for ensuring clients receive the best possible services for the best possible outcomes. As a licensed clinician or associate, they will effectively provide evidence-based substance misuse treatment modalities to clients through individual, group and/or family counseling sessions and development of treatment plans while working with multi-disciplinary team to provide continuity of care to the client.

Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

This role will lead efforts in forecasting demand, managing inventory levels, and optimizing stock for their entire catalog of products. As a key part of the Supply Chain team, this individual will ensure that the company maintains optimal stock levels while balancing cost efficiencies and operational requirements.

About the company:

The company is specialised on developing and upscaling Amazon-based brands across the USA, Canada, Europe, and the UK. With deep expertise in eCommerce and Amazon FBA, the company excels in buying, developing, and scaling brands to their fullest potential. The company navigates the complexities of international markets and high-performance marketing, ensuring seamless scalability and growth.

The company's portfolio includes several Amazon brands, primarily in the home and kitchen category, as well as some electronics. Its international team of 17 world-class talents manages all operations today.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Demand Planning: Analyze historical sales data, current product trends, and market insights to accurately forecast demand for all products.

  • Amazon Marketplace Management: Oversee inventory management for Amazon, ensuring accurate stock levels, fulfillment coordination, and alignment with marketplace demand trends.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in demand planning, inventory management, and supply chain operations, preferably in e-commerce.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and generate actionable insights.
  • Experience managing inventory for the Amazon Marketplace, including knowledge of FBA (Fulfilled by Amazon) and related processes.
  • High attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Experience working with international suppliers, especially from China, is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Google Spreadsheets, data analysis tools, and demand planning software
  • Experience with Inventory Planner would be a plus
  • This role is essential for maintaining efficient and cost-effective inventory management while supporting the companys growth through data-driven insights and precise demand forecasting.

  • Paid time off.
  • Yearly bonuses.
  • Professional growth opportunities, such as managing staff members and growing your skill set.
  • Competitive and timely salary.
  • Opportunity to work remotely in an international company.
  • Dynamic, creative work environments.
  • Flexible schedule.
