raw.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

We're seeking a Senior Brokerage Operations Associate (Canada). An experienced individual contributor who has lived dealer, clearing, and custody reality and designs every process as if manual work is temporary.

You turn CIRO-aligned operating requirements into scalable, automated, auditable workflows that Product and Engineering can build against. You partner closely with the ACCC President / UDP, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and global Ops. Someone who influences through expertise, crisp documentation, and decision logs, not through a team.

Success is measured by launch readiness, STP and control quality, registered-account / tax operability, and systems others can run and not by headcount or heroic spreadsheet ops.

What you'll walk into:

You won't be starting from zero. You'll be owning live problems:

  • Getting ready to open: figure out how we open and maintain accounts, process trades, and hold client cash and securities on day one. Build that for ACCC rather than copying a manual process from another firm.
  • Working with partner brokers: define how a partner firm and ACCC split the work on accounts, trades, and holding client assets, so it still works as volume grows.
  • After the trade: settlement in Canada (through CDS), trades that fail to settle, and corporate actions such as dividends and splits. Automate the routine cases and keep a clear list of exceptions, instead of running the book in spreadsheets.
  • Registered accounts and tax: TFSA, RRSP, RESP, and similar accounts. Cover who can open them, contribution rules, what a security cost, tax withheld on dividends and other income, and the reports clients and partners need.
  • The day after launch: written steps for daily work, checks that our records match the custodian and the market, contacts at vendors and custodians, and a plan if a system or vendor fails. Have these ready before real client volume shows up.
  • Building Canada: clear handoffs between product, engineering, and operations teams.

What you’ll own:

  • Account lifecycle & client/introducing-broker servicing (onboarding handoffs, KYC/AML ops interfaces, maintenance, transfers)
  • Trade lifecycle (capture, affirmation, clearing, settlement, fails, breaks)
  • Custody & asset servicing (segregation, security movements, corporate actions, cash)
  • Books & records, reconciliations, exception management, and operational controls
  • Registered accounts & tax ops: TFSA, RRSP, RESP and related wrappers; tax lots / cost basis; withholding; local reporting partners need to stay compliant
  • Day-2 production ops: runbooks, escalations, vendor/custody interfaces, BCP/DR operational playbooks

How you’ll work:

  • Translate Canadian reality into runnable process — CIRO-aligned dealer/clearing/custody expectations, introducing–carrying dynamics, custody controls, and operational risk into SOPs, RACI, controls, and exception paths Product and Engineering can build against
  • Automation-first by default —redesign high-volume / high-risk / high-friction work for straight-through processing, rules, exception queues, and measurable SLAs, instead of spreadsheet heroics
  • AI-first operating lens — Prototype and productize AI-assisted ops (exception triage, recon investigation, SOP Q&A, control-testing support, runbook copilots) with human oversight where risk or regulation requires it
  • Go-live and beyond — Readiness for ACCC launch and early production; continuous improvement after go-live
  • Raise the bar without managing a team — Coach partners through expertise, crisp documentation, and decision logs; leave systems others can run

How we'll measure success:

  • Launch readiness gates met with documented controls, SOPs, RACI, and runbooks Product / Eng / Ops can execute against
  • STP, exception, and reconciliation aging targets defined and trending the right way post go-live
  • Registered-account and tax workflows ready when partners launch, rather than added later
  • Specs and decision logs that remove re-discovery for Product and Engineering
  • Systems and playbooks others can run after you, so knowledge sticks in the org and not only in one person's head

Who you are (Must-haves):

  • 10+ years deep, hands-on Canadian brokerage operations experience at a CIRO dealer, carrying broker, custodian, clearing firm, or brokerage ops function in Canada
  • Fluent in the plumbing: clearing / settlement, custody, CDS / CDSX (or equivalent), fails, corp actions, tax, cash / securities ops, account servicing, introducing / carrying arrangements
  • Demonstrated depth in at least two of: clearing / settlement; custody & asset servicing; books & records / reconciliations; registered accounts & tax
  • Regulatory-literate (CIRO / provincial securities / CSA context). You design operable controls, and you are not the UDP or compliance sign-off owner
  • Builder: you've redesigned and shipped process + tooling changes that stuck, not only run BAU
  • Practical with automation and AI (workflow automation, rules engines, RPA, or AI-assisted ops). You know where AI helps and where controls must stay deterministic
  • Exceptional written communication: SOPs, RACI, decision logs, and requirements that cross-functional teams can ship against

Who you might be (Nice-to-haves):

  • Greenfield Canadian dealer / clearing / custody stand-up
  • API-first or broker-as-a-service / correspondent platforms
  • US and Canada dual-entity operations
  • Deep CDS / CDSX or Canadian market-infrastructure experience
  • Registered-account or Canadian tax-ops stand-up (TFSA, RRSP, RESP, tax lots, withholding, reporting)
  • AI-native ops workflow: recurring use of tools like Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or custom agents for SOP drafting, exception synthesis, and prototyping

How We Take Care of You:

raw.description:
THIS POSITION IS FOR A BUILDING ENGINEER. SOMEONE WITH SKILLS ON CONSTRUTING A NEW BUILD.

Position Summary

The Director of Facilities Engineering is responsible for the engineering strategy, design standards, reliability, and lifecycle management of mission-critical infrastructure supporting AI and high-performance computing (HPC) data centers.

We expect the Director of Facilities Engineering to lead the engineering strategy, design, reliability, and operation of mission-critical infrastructure supporting AI data center campuses. This role oversees multidisciplinary engineering teams and ensures highly available, scalable, and energy-efficient facilities that support next-generation AI and high-performance computing (HPC) environments.

This position requires critical thinking and adaptation to a fast-paced, always-changing, and evolving AI data center space. AI Factories are a new type of data center that requires a new, flexible approach but with a conservative engineering view. We expect the ideal candidate to be open-minded and not afraid to experiment.

Role Mandate:

  • Create and lead the portfolio-wide facilities engineering program for greenfield campuses, powered-shell projects, modular deployments, expansions and selected retrofit opportunities.
  • Develop a repeatable campus architecture and set of design standards that can be adapted intelligently to different utility systems, climates, site constraints, deployment schedules and customer requirements.
  • Serve as the senior technical owner from site screening and diligence through design, construction, commissioning, turnover and initial operating readiness.
  • Build the internal engineering capability and external partner network required to move multiple projects forward in parallel without compromising reliability, safety or capital discipline.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic direction and leadership for the facilities of operations of multiple AI Factories(data centers), ensuring 24/7 uptime and operational excellence for mechanical, electrical, and plumbing infrastructure.
  • Develop and execute the facilities engineering strategy for AI data centers distributed across multiple campuses across the county.
  • Plan and execute standardized infrastructurefor new data center buildouts, colocation expansions, and data center expansions, ensuring seamless integration of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing infrastructure.
  • Build and lead electrical, mechanical, controls, and reliability engineering teams.
  • Establish engineering standards, technical specifications, and design guidelines across multiple facilities to meet the constantly evolving AI data center for white space demand.
  • Oversee the engineering lifecycle of critical infrastructure, including electrical distribution, UPS, generators, cooling systems, BMS, EPMS, DCIM, and fire protection systems.
  • Design and optimize infrastructure for high-density GPU and liquid-cooled AI environments using the newest NVIDIA and AMD chip systems. Work with direct-to-chip cooling systems and high-density racks with up to 150 KW per rack.
  • Drive reliability engineering, predictive maintenance, root cause analysis, and asset lifecycle management across a portfolio of new deployments.
  • Provide technical oversight for new construction, expansion, commissioning, and modernization projects.
  • Improve energy efficiency through initiatives that optimize PUE, WUE, and sustainability.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, and engineering best practices.
  • Manage engineering budgets, technical vendors, consultants, and capital improvement programs.

Technical Expertise

  • Mission-critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure
  • Medium-voltage power distribution, UPS, generators, and power monitoring
  • Chilled water plants, liquid cooling, thermal management, and HVAC systems
  • BMS, EPMS, and DCIM platforms
  • Reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), FMEA, commissioning, and asset lifecycle management
  • AI/HPC infrastructure and high-density compute environments

Leadership Profile

  • Adaptive systems thinker: able to create standards without becoming rigid and to distinguish durable engineering principles from temporary market conventions.
  • Builder mentality: energized by ambiguity, early-stage platform development and creating processes, teams and technical infrastructure from the ground up.
  • Commercially grounded: understands how engineering choices affect land value, customer fit, capital requirements, delivery schedule, bankabilityand long-term returns.
  • Decisive and transparent: makes sound decisions with incomplete information, documents assumptions and escalates risks early.
  • Collaborative authority: can challenge customers, utilities, consultants, contractors and executives constructively while maintaining trust and momentum.
  • Hands-on executive: equally comfortable reviewing a one-line diagram, walking a site, negotiating an OEM strategy, presenting to investors and building a long-term organization.

Success Measures

  • Quality and speed of technical decisions across the site pipeline.
  • Reliability, maintainability, constructability, and adaptability of selected designs.
  • Accuracy and transparency of capital, schedule, and technical-risk assumptions.
  • Reduction in redesign, change orders, commissioning issues and avoidable lifecycle cost.
  • Ability to support evolving customer requirements without losing standardization or investment discipline.
  • Strength of the engineering team, consultant network, vendor relationships, and repeatable platform processes built under this leader.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of engineering experience in mission-critical facilities, data centers, industrial, or power infrastructure.
  • 7+ years leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Strong expertise in electrical and mechanical systems supporting high-availability environments.
  • Experience with hyperscale, AI, or HPC data center infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of engineering design, commissioning, and reliability engineering practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in engineering, Engineering Management, or MBA.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • Industry certifications such as CEM, CDCP/CDCMP, PMP, or LEED AP.

Why join this venture

This role offers the opportunity to shape a data center platform at the point where the most important technical decisions are still being made. The director will have direct influence over site strategy, campus architecture, customer solutions, capital deployment, team design, and the engineering identity of the company. We value practical judgment, intellectual honesty, and thoughtful experimentation. The right leader will be given meaningful authority to build a program—not merely inherit one.

Company Benefits:

-Health (medical, dental, vision)

-PTO

-Sick

-Maternal/Paternal Leave

-FSA/HSA

-401K

-Supplemental Options

Salary: $150,000-$180,000

With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

The Senior Lead, TA & PX Systems Administration supports Shield AI's entire Talent Acquisition technology ecosystem, including the ATS, CRM, sourcing tools, and other recruiting technology, along with third-party HR technology such as Lattice, Pave, Compa, and Carta. The role is hands-on, administering and continuously optimizing Ashby as Shield AI's ATS and CRM, and partners with People Technology leadership to build the roadmap for TA and HR technology.

The role is an individual, hands-on position at the start. As Shield AI scales, it is expected to grow into a player-coach role that builds and leads a TA and PX systems team. It works with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, People Experience Operations, Total Rewards, People Analytics, Finance, Procurement, IT, Security, and other cross-functional partners to turn business requirements into durable system design, and to keep TA and PX systems well-configured, well-integrated, and well-governed.

What you'll do:

  • Partner with People Technology leadership to build and maintain the roadmap for TA and HR technology, aligned with TA and PX priorities and Shield AI's growth plans, and lead execution of roadmap initiatives.
  • Support the full TA technology ecosystem, including the ATS, CRM, sourcing tools, scheduling, assessments, background check, interview intelligence, and related recruiting technology.
  • Personally administer, configure, and continuously optimize Ashby as Shield AI's ATS and CRM, including approvals, offers, requisitions, pipelines, interview plans, scheduling logic, scorecards, custom fields, and reporting objects.
  • Administer and support third-party HR technology, including Lattice, Pave, Compa, and Carta, covering configuration, permissions, integrations, and upgrade management.
  • Support TA and HR technology vendor management, including evaluations, implementations, contract renewals, license administration, business reviews, and performance against service commitments, in partnership with People Technology leadership, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and Security.
  • Define integration architecture across the TA and PX stack, including UKG, O365 / calendar, identity and SSO, and the PX data platform, and manage change control and monitoring.
  • Translate business and process requirements from TA and PX stakeholders into clear system design decisions, trade-offs, and configuration; recommend priorities across competing requests; and document the resulting workflows, permissions, and data model.
  • Establish and maintain data governance for TA and PX systems, including field taxonomies, PII classification, role-based access, retention, naming conventions, and reporting boundaries aligned to the broader PX Analytics Estate.
  • Lead release management and UAT for TA and PX system changes, including test plans, sandbox validation, rollout, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Keep recruiting and PX data pipelines reliable enough for executive reporting, with clean source data, consistent definitions, and reporting objects that downstream analytics can trust.
  • Track the TA and PX technology market, evaluate new capabilities and vendors, and build recommendations on where to configure, integrate, consolidate, buy, or hold.
  • Ensure TA and PX systems support compliance with applicable data privacy, security, and recordkeeping requirements, including EEO, OFCCP, and GDPR, by maintaining system controls and supporting audits.
  • As the function grows, help define future roles, then hire and lead a team as a player-coach while staying hands-on in configuration and design.

Required qualifications:

  • Direct hands-on Ashby administration experience, including configuration, workflows, approvals, offers, permissions, integrations, and reporting objects.
  • 8+ years of experience administering and optimizing recruiting and HR technology, including deep ownership of at least one modern ATS and its surrounding TA technology stack.
  • Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education, experience, skills, and knowledge.
  • Experience contributing to a TA or HR technology roadmap and supporting vendor relationships and renewals across multiple platforms.
  • A hands-on builder who enjoys doing the configuration work, with experience mentoring others or leading cross-functional implementations and an interest in growing into a people leader.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end talent acquisition processes, from sourcing and pipeline management through interviewing, offers, and the onboarding handoff, and how technology enables each stage.
  • Fluency in the TA technology landscape, including ATS, CRM, sourcing, scheduling, assessments, interview intelligence, and analytics.
  • Experience administering PX SaaS tools such as performance, compensation, equity, engagement, or HRIS-adjacent platforms.
  • A systems-thinking mindset: you look at a requirement and see the workflow, data model, permissions, and downstream reporting implications together.
  • Strong problem-solving instincts and the judgment to translate ambiguous requests into clear configuration decisions and trade-offs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present roadmaps, trade-offs, and business cases to TA and PX leadership, Finance, and senior stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience leading an ATS migration or major recruiting technology consolidation onto Ashby or a comparable modern ATS.
  • Experience building or scaling a People or HR technology function, including hiring and developing systems administrators or analysts.
  • Familiarity with data governance concepts for people data, including PII classification, role-based access, and reporting boundaries.
  • Experience with UKG, Workday, or another enterprise HRIS as an integration partner.
  • Working knowledge of no-code automation platforms (Workato, Zapier, Tray) or scripting.
  • Prior experience supporting people technology in a regulated, government contracting, technology, aerospace, or similarly complex environment.

What success looks like:

  • A clear, prioritized roadmap for TA and HR technology is built with People Technology leadership and delivered against.
  • Ashby, sourcing tools, and supported PX platforms are configured, integrated, and permissioned to reliably support current and future TA and PX processes.
  • TA and HR technology vendors, renewals, and licenses are supported proactively, with clear recommendations on where tools deliver value.
  • System changes go through a consistent release-management and UAT process, with clear documentation and minimal disruption.
  • TA and PX data is well-governed, well-classified, and trustworthy enough to support executive reporting and audits.
  • Stakeholders receive timely, effective support, and repeat issues decline over time.
  • As the function grows, a plan for future team roles is in place and the role transitions effectively into a player-coach.

As a Support Specialist you will function as a single point of contact for all technical support for internal and/or external customers across the entire enterprise.  In this capacity you will serve as liaison between customers, Technology Services functional areas, management, support groups, and the business units. You will utilize software solutions, knowledge base, personal knowledge, and computer systems to resolve and track user incidents.

The Support Specialist is responsible for end-to-end resolution and ownership of customer requests or concerns. To succeed, you will need to closely monitorrequests, communicate with customers, and deliver solutions to requests with a sense of urgency.   

Day to day, you'll...

raw.excerpt: About SparkSpark is a science-driven, philanthropically funded non-profit that accelerates progress on unsolvable climate challenges.
raw.description:
About Spark

Spark is a science-driven, philanthropically funded non-profit that accelerates progress on unsolvable climate challenges. Our goal is to enable a safer climate by filling target gaps in current climate actions. We look around the corner at the key blind spots that pose big climate risks or offer big climate opportunities, like major sources of unabated emissions. Then we work to speed up the development of the fields needed to address those challenges.

We are a team of scientists, policy experts, innovators, and systems thinkers working to build today’s foundations for the comprehensive climate solutions we will need tomorrow. Rather than betting on individual pathways or innovations, we work to grow a field as a whole so that the most effective science and solutions can be surfaced and scaled. We use a large suite of field-building tools to support new research, markets, policies, and talent development, through both in-house initiatives and building broader coalitions. We are currently focused on super pollutants from agriculture (specifically methane and nitrous oxide), warming-inducing greenhouse gas emissions, and methane removal.

Spark’s impact is made possible by a community of generous and pioneering individuals, foundations, and organizations that share our vision for a safer climate future.

Position Summary

Spark Climate Solutions is seeking a part-time Operations Coordinator to help keep day-to-day scheduling and administrative tasks organized and moving forward. This individual will be responsible for managing the Executive Director’s and organizational calendar, and provide additional support for meeting coordination, expense documentation, internal team gatherings, and event logistics. This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys keeping track of details and following through using established processes.

Who We’re Looking For

  • Organized, dependable, and attentive to detail.

  • A clear, friendly communicator who follows up and keeps people informed.

  • Comfortable completing routine tasks independently and asking questions when guidance is needed.

  • Able to handle sensitive information with discretion.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the Executive Director’s calendar, including scheduling, rescheduling, meeting details, and flagging conflicts.

  • Maintain and update the organization’s calendar, provide support for key meetings.

  • Own collection of pre-reads and dissemination of follow-ups for major internal meetings.

  • Help coordinate meetings across staff and external partners.

  • Help prepare slides for our organization’s All Hands and the weekly all staff email by collecting updates, formatting content, and sending reminders.

  • Coordinate scheduling of brownbags (learning sessions for staff) by managing invitations, and materials, with speaker introductions provided by team members.

  • Support event administration by updating participant trackers, sending reminders, and making approved bookings or orders.

  • Keep assigned trackers and documents current and flag missing information or upcoming deadlines.

  • Upload the Executive Director’s receipts to Bill.com and follow up on missing expense documentation.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience providing administrative, scheduling, or coordination support.

  • Experience managing calendars and coordinating meetings across multiple participants and time zones.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and reliable follow-through on deadlines, meeting details, and routine tasks.

  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills, including communicating with external contacts and following up on missing information.

  • Comfort using shared calendars, spreadsheets, presentation tools, and online meeting platforms, with the ability to learn new tools and follow established processes.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, keep track of assigned tasks, and communicate progress or capacity concerns.

  • Sound judgment in handling sensitive information, asking clarifying questions, and recognizing when a decision needs approval.

Why Join Us

Spark Climate Solutions is a nimble, impact-focused nonprofit driving urgent progress on underinvested climate solutions. You’ll join a team of scientists, strategists, and systems thinkers working to pull forward the timeline for high-impact climate solutions. This role offers the chance to make a material difference on some of the world’s toughest climate challenges.

Location and Eligibility

This position is 100% remote and open to candidates based in the United States who are legally authorized to work in the U.S.

Compensation and Contract Terms

Compensation is $28-38 per hour, depending on relevant experience, for up to 20 hours per week. This is a six-month, fixed-term, part-time employee position, with the possibility of continued employment beyond the initial term. Continued employment is not guaranteed.

raw.description:
The Company

Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

The Role

The Senior Demand Generation Manager is responsible for driving sustainable long-term pipeline growth and market engagement across Versaterm’s portfolio of public safety solutions. This role leads high-complexity, cross-departmental initiatives through expertise and influence, and brings deep functional and technical mastery of demand generation. The Senior Demand Generation Manager frequently represents the marketing function in cross-departmental and external engagements, contributes directly to decisions that shape the direction of the area, mentors others, and actively champions Versaterm’s values across the teams and work they influence.

What You Do

  • Designs and plans targeted go-to-market programs to build brand awareness and generate and nurture leads through the sales and marketing funnel.
  • Owns the strategy and execution of demand generation programs that drive qualified pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Defines and develops new demand generation approaches, frameworks, and best practices that raise the standard across the function.
  • Leverages digital platforms to automate marketing activities, including webinars, and determines the most effective points of interaction (POI) for marketing campaigns.
  • Utilizes Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, customer information, and marketing automation platforms like Marketo and SFDC to create and deploy effective marketing campaigns.
  • Partners with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to guide messaging, positioning, and content strategy, ensuring go-to-market alignment, optimizing campaign performance, and supporting product launches and market expansion.
  • Drives the creative development of content and communications that support demand generation campaigns and customer engagement, and optimizes ROI by establishing KPIs and reporting frameworks to measure campaign effectiveness and inform decisions.
  • Leads high-complexity, cross-departmental initiatives, ensuring alignment and execution against company goals and growth objectives.
  • Manages demand generation program spend, recommending investments that maximize ROI and scalability.
  • Creates a rolling calendar of campaigns that align to Sales leadership and Product pipeline goals.
  • Delivers a consistent experience for the Sales team with campaigns that are fully developed with content, lists, decks, and enablement to execute to plan.
  • Represents the demand generation function in cross-departmental and external engagements and contributes directly to decisions that shape the direction of the area.
  • Mentors colleagues across Marketing and partner teams, driving a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in B2B marketing, with deep, recognized expertise and authority in demand generation.
  • Proven success building and scaling demand generation programs in a high-growth SaaS environment.
  • Strong understanding of public safety or mission-driven technology markets is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence at all levels of the organization without direct authority.
  • Deep mastery of marketing automation, CRM, and analytics platforms (e.g., Marketo, SFDC), with experience establishing KPIs and reporting frameworks.
  • Exceptional communication, analytical, and mentoring skills, with a record of raising the standard for the function.

Note: This position requires a security clearance from the Government of Canada. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada and must successfully obtain and maintain a Reliability security clearance. Please note that specific customer contracts may impose additional security verification requirements. Obtaining and maintaining all required security clearances is a condition of employment. For more information on the Government of Canada's security screening process, please visit Public Services and Procurement Canada. Additionally, due to the nature of our work with public safety agencies, this position may require compliance with the FBI's Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy. Candidates must successfully pass a comprehensive, fingerprint-based background check. Please note that specific customer contracts may impose additional security verification requirements. Obtaining and maintaining all required security clearances is a condition of employment. For more information on CJIS security requirements, please visit the FBI's CJIS Security Policy Resource Center.

Versaterm is committed to fair and equitable compensation that is competitive, consistent, and aligned with the value each role contributes to our organization. The starting salary for this position will be dependent upon many factors, such as the successful candidate’s skills, experience, education, training as well as internal equity, market data, and business needs. In addition to base salary and our comprehensive benefits offering, some roles may also be eligible for variable compensation such as incentive plans or discretionary performance bonuses.

AI is central to how Versaterm builds and delivers solutions for our customers. Within Talent Acquisition, we use AI-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, helping our team work more efficiently and spend more time connecting with great talent. AI supports our work, but all hiring and employment decisions are made by people.

Versaterm is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to equity, diversity, inclusion, and a barrier-free workplace. Accommodations are available upon request throughout all stages of the recruitment process and apply to the terms and conditions of employment. For more information, please contact .

raw.description:
About Glooko

Glooko is a global digital health company on a mission to simplify diabetes and glycemic management across the care continuum. Our work connects people with diabetes, healthcare providers and diabetes devices through technology that makes diabetes care easier, more connected and more actionable.

At Glooko, we bring together people who are passionate about improving healthcare through innovation, collaboration and purpose-driven work. Our teams are building solutions that help clinicians streamline workflows, centralize diabetes data, support more informed decisions and improve care across outpatient and inpatient settings. At Glooko, employees have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful work that supports patients, providers and care teams around the world.

Glooko provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, or disability. In addition to federal law requirements, Glooko complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location where the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

About the Role

The Head of Product and Partner Marketing is responsible for defining how Glooko's Connected Care offerings are positioned, packaged, and taken to market with hospitals and health systems, and for building the external partnerships that extend Glooko's reach and accelerate growth. This leader will own the market-facing narrative for Glooko's combined inpatient and outpatient glycemic management capabilities, from EndoTool's inpatient insulin management platform to Glooko's outpatient remote patient monitoring and CGM data platform, and ensure that narrative is grounded in a deep understanding of customer needs and economics.

Working closely with Product, Strategy, and Sales Leadership, the Head of Product and Partner Marketing will act as the voice of the customer and the market in roadmap decisions. They will make sure every offering is both technically sound and makes clear business sense to health system buyers. On the partnership front, this leader will identify, evaluate, and cultivate channel, co-sell, and co-marketing relationships that create scalable paths to market.

This role leads a team of 3-4 product marketing professionals and requires a strategic, commercially minded marketer with deep experience in healthcare, digital health, or health IT. The ideal candidate can translate complex clinical and technology capabilities into compelling value propositions for clinical, financial, and operational leaders. In this role, you’ll partner closely with our dedicated brand and communications teams, while maintaining a primary focus on driving product strategy, positioning, market enablement, and commercial partnerships.

What you'll do

Product Strategy and Roadmap Alignment

  • Partner with Product and Strategy to ensure the product roadmap reflects the priorities, workflows, and buying criteria of hospitals and health systems
  • Bring structured market and customer insight into roadmap planning through win/loss analysis, customer research, competitive intelligence, and input from Sales and Customer Success
  • Evaluate new offerings and enhancements for business viability as well as technical feasibility, including customer ROI, pricing and packaging implications, and fit with health system budgets and buying processes
  • Define target segments, buyer personas, and use cases across inpatient, outpatient, and transitions of care

Positioning, Messaging, and Market Narrative

  • Own the overarching market narrative for Glooko's combined inpatient and outpatient glycemic management capabilities, articulating why an integrated, across-the-continuum approach matters to health systems
  • Develop positioning and messaging frameworks for each offering and for the combined platform, tailored to key buyers including CMIOs, CMOs, CFOs, quality leaders, and population health leaders
  • Build clear, evidence-based value propositions that connect clinical outcomes, such as glycemic control, hypoglycemia reduction, and length of stay, to financial and operational impact
  • Maintain competitive positioning and differentiation against alternative solutions and the status quo

Go-to-Market and Launch Leadership

  • Lead go-to-market planning and execution for new products, features, and bundled offerings
  • Define pricing and packaging recommendations in partnership with Product, Finance, and Sales Leadership
  • Ensure launches are coordinated across Product, Sales, Customer Success, Clinical, and Marketing teams

Sales Enablement

  • Equip Sales with the tools to win: pitch narratives, business case and ROI tools, competitive battlecards, objection handling, customer case studies, and proposal content
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to refine sales plays by segment and buyer, and support key strategic opportunities
  • Develop and manage customer evidence programs, including case studies, reference customers, and outcomes data, in partnership with Clinical teams

Partner Marketing and Strategic Partnerships

  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize external partnerships that can scale Glooko's business, including channel and reseller relationships, co-sell arrangements, co-marketing programs, and technology or ecosystem partners
  • Build business cases for priority partnerships and lead or support negotiations in partnership with Strategy, Legal, and Alliance Management
  • Develop joint value propositions, go-to-market plans, and enablement programs with partners
  • Establish metrics and governance to track partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, and manage partner performance over time

Market and Customer Insight

  • Monitor market trends affecting glycemic management and health system priorities, including regulatory, quality measure, and reimbursement changes
  • Serve as an internal subject matter expert on the market, customers, and competitive landscape for the Executive Leadership Team and Board as needed

Leadership Responsibilities

  • Lead, develop, and mentor a team of 3-4 product marketing professionals, setting clear priorities aligned to Connected Care's commercial objectives
  • Establish processes and frameworks for product marketing and partner management, including launch playbooks, messaging governance, and partner evaluation criteria
  • Define and report on success metrics such as pipeline influence, win rates, launch performance, and partner contribution
  • Work closely with Corporate Communications & Brand to ensure product and partner messaging aligns with Glooko's overall brand and corporate narrative

Qualifications

Education & Professional Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in product marketing, strategic marketing, or partnerships, with at least 5 years in healthcare, digital health, medtech, or health IT.
  • Enterprise Healthcare Expertise: Proven track record marketing enterprise solutions to hospitals and health systems, with deep insight into health system purchasing processes and stakeholders.
  • Partnerships: Demonstrated experience building and scaling commercial partnerships (e.g., channel, co-sell, co-marketing).
  • People Leadership: Proven success in leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing product marketing teams.

Competencies & Skills

  • Value Proposition Development: Demonstrated ability to translate clinical and technical capabilities into financially grounded, compelling value propositions for clinical, financial, and operational leaders.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Strong communication and influence skills within a highly matrixed organization across Product, Sales, Engineering, and Executive leadership.
  • Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with diabetes, glycemic management, or chronic condition management is strongly preferred.
  • Creative & Strategic Mindset: Ability to balance strategic vision with high-quality execution, agency/vendor oversight, and content governance.

Candidate Privacy
By applying for this position, you acknowledge that Glooko will process the personal data you provide as part of your application for the purpose of managing and evaluating your candidacy.

For more information about how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data, as well as your rights under applicable data protection laws, please see ourGlooko Privacy Notice.

Life on the team

Our Transition & Transformation team plays a critical role in the successful delivery of complex Managed Services transitions, service exits, large transformation programmes and sensitive in-life change projects. As Country Portfolio Director, you will operate at the heart of this environment, working closely with senior customer stakeholders, Country leadership, GMS leadership, Sales and Service Management, Service Delivery, People Leaders and the wider T&T community.

This is a senior leadership role requiring strong executive judgement, commercial awareness and the ability to build confidence and trust at pace. You will lead through influence, bring teams together around shared outcomes and help create a high-performing portfolio culture focused on quality, customer success and continuous improvement.

What you'll do

  • Contribute to the review and management of the T&T pipeline, ensuring the right level of support, governance and resource planning is in place during pre-sales, contract and delivery stages.

At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.

We are looking for a Cybersecurity Engineer to become a part of the Cybersecurity team reporting to the VP, Compliance and Information.
The Cybersecurity Engineer will contribute to reducing risk within the Dscout SaaS environment and internal IT systems. This includes planning and implementing cybersecurity controls, supporting cybersecurity operations, and monitoring the threat landscape. This role will ensure Dscout controls operate effectively over time.
What You Will Do:
  • Lead the process to build security into the Dscout SaaS environment. This includes applying security throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to plan and implement cybersecurity controls to protect the SaaS environment. This includes applying leading practices to secure AWS resources (e.g., VPCs, EC2 instances, and containers).
  • Continually enhance security monitoring of the SaaS environment and internal IT services by implementing SIEM and working with Engineering to continuously improve logging and auditability.
  • Assess evolving threats and develop recommendations to mitigate risk to Dscout. You will provide weekly threat intelligence reports highlighting potential risk to the organization.
  • Work side-by-side with Engineering to analyze, contain, and mitigate cyber attacks and other related incidents.
  • Perform vulnerability monitoring and, where appropriate, ensure remediation.
  • Participate in the development of security policies and processes.
  • Assist third party risk reviews.
  • Provide recommendations to continually improve security controls.
  • Assist in development of security programs and efforts to promote security awareness.

What You Will Need To Have (we can call them Desired Skills and Background):

  • Experience working with developers to conduct security reviews and provide strong recommendations to manage risk. This includes a strong understanding and practical use of OWASP Top 10 (web and AI).
  • Experience securing AWS cloud environments and infrastructure as code solutions such as Terraform.
  • Proven ability to implement security monitoring tools such as Datadog. This includes the ability to identify relevant scenarios and ensure proper logging.
  • Experience responding to cyber attacks such as bots and account compromise as well as threats like data leakage and infected computers.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud computing environments.
  • Working knowledge of security in software development and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD).
  • Experience documenting and implementing security policies and processes.
  • Knowledge of security frameworks and standards: ISO 27001, NIST, or SANS preferred.
  • Experience with HITRUST and/or SOC 2 certification is preferred.
  • Good communication, documentation and presentation skills.
  • Limitless curiosity and insatiable appetite to understand human behavior and relevant technologies.

Background

  • Bachelor's degree is preferred
  • CISSP, CCSP, or GIAC security certification preferred
  • A minimum of 3 years of security experience
Of course, what is outlined above is an ideal set of expectations; however, business needs and other projects and tasks may shift, and additional tasks could be assigned at the discretion of your manager.

Dscout is a team of passionate, empathetic, and curious professionals. As a recognized leader in the Forrester Wave, we’re at the cutting edge of experience research technology. The power of research drives us - how in-context insights from real people can build more enjoyable products and services.
We prioritize learning, sharing, and building. We also deeply value being a diverse and inclusive team and company and look for team members who align with that belief. Join our dynamic team and help shape product roadmaps and business strategies for the world’s most loved brands.

  • An incredible and progressive benefits package (for both you and your dependents) to support work/life balance, including flexible PTO, 15 company holidays, 12 weeks of paid parental leave, 401k match, and much more.
  • An education stipend to support your growth & development, and a remote work stipend.

Dscout is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity. We do not discriminate based on identity, including race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex, gender identity and expression, age, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, veteran or military status, unfavorable discharge from military service, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, order of protection status, citizenship status, arrest record or expunged or sealed convictions, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.

raw.description:
We are seeking a Lead - Data Engineer to lead the hands-on design, development, and operation of key components of Astrana’s enterprise data platform, including the Constellation Lakehouse, Connect API (GraphQL) layer, and Lakebase-backed applications.
This role will build scalable data pipelines, integrate healthcare data sources, and develop unified data models that support analytics, reporting, AI and machine learning, and operational applications. The position combines advanced data engineering with responsibility for platform reliability, performance, security, and automation within an Azure Databricks environment.
As a hands-on technical lead, you will translate complex requirements into reliable production solutions, establish engineering standards, and mentor other engineers. You will collaborate with analytics, software engineering, infrastructure, security, business stakeholders, and external vendors to advance the platform and support its growing adoption.

Our Values
  • Put Patients First
  • Empower Entrepreneurial Provider and Care Teams
  • Operate with Integrity & Excellence
  • Be Innovative
  • Work As One Team

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of core platform components, including the Constellation Lakehouse in Databricks, Connect API (GraphQL) layer, and Lakebase-backed applications.
  • Build and maintain scalable batch and incremental data pipelines using Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, SQL, and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate data from transactional databases, APIs, files, and external partners into governed datasets that support analytics and operational applications.
  • Design and maintain unified healthcare data models spanning membership, providers, claims, encounters, clinical data, and other business domains.
  • Develop reliable ingestion and transformation processes, including change data capture, schema evolution, deduplication, historical tracking, and reconciliation.
  • Build and optimize data access layers and APIs in partnership with software engineering teams, supporting consistent business definitions and reliable downstream consumption.
  • Develop and support Lakebase-backed applications and PostgreSQL data structures, including integration with lakehouse datasets and application services.
  • Maintain and optimize Databricks workspaces, compute resources, job orchestration, and environment configurations in collaboration with infrastructure and security teams.
  • Implement data governance and access controls through Unity Catalog and established organizational standards, including permissions, lineage, and auditability.
  • Establish automated data quality checks, source-to-target reconciliation, freshness monitoring, and alerting to ensure datasets are accurate, complete, and usable.
  • Apply DevOps practices, including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and repeatable deployment across development, testing, and production environments.
  • Tune pipelines, Spark workloads, SQL queries, and compute configurations to improve performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Own the investigation and resolution of platform incidents and pipeline failures; perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive improvements.
  • Partner with infrastructure teams on backup, recovery, and business continuity procedures, and maintain operational documentation and runbooks.
  • Conduct code and design reviews, establish engineering standards, and mentor engineers across internal and vendor teams.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of data engineering experience building and supporting enterprise data platforms and pipelines.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Databricks in production environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, PySpark, SQL, and Apache Spark.
  • Experience with Delta Lake and modern lakehouse architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure data services and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of data modeling, relational databases, and ETL/ELT best practices.
  • Experience integrating enterprise databases and APIs into scalable data solutions.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment practices.
  • Proven ability to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines and platform performance.
  • Demonstrated leadership in solution design, code reviews, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience administering and optimizing Databricks environments, including Unity Catalog.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, GraphQL APIs, and operational applications leveraging lakehouse data.
  • Healthcare data experience, including claims, eligibility, provider, or clinical datasets.
  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7, FHIR, and X12.
  • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Experience with streaming data pipelines and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience supporting AI, machine learning, or NLP data workloads.
  • Familiarity with regulated data environments and governance best practices.
  • Experience with cloud data platform migrations and modernization initiatives.
  • Azure, Databricks, or AWS certifications preferred.

Job Benefits

  • This position is remotely based in the U.S.
  • The total compensation target pay range for this role is: $170,000 - $240,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location (current or future), experience, and other job-related factors.

raw.description:
About ACLED:

Armed Conflict Location & Event Data (ACLED) is an independent, impartial conflict and protest monitoring organization providing real-time data and analysis on violent conflict and protest in all countries and territories across the world.

The consultancy opportunity:

ACLED is looking for a Yemen Researcher to assist in the collection, review and management of political violence and protest data across Yemen. Researchers must be available for a minimum of 30 to 40
hours per week. This opportunity is fully remote and can be done from any location with reliable internet service.

This is an entry-level, independent consultant opportunity, and may require submissions mid-week and on weekends.

This opportunity is open to nationals of any country. For more information, please review the Applicant FAQs.

Collection of data is conducted by reviewing news, international organization, NGO and security reports on a list of assigned countries, and recording the incidents of political violence into an Excel template. Researchers will focus on coding events to provide holistic coverage of current political violence, ranging from protests to battles.

Review and management of data involves ensuring the quality, consistency and reliability of the data produced. The researcher provides team members with experience conducting detail-oriented tasks, and producing and managing quantitative data.

Please note that this opportunity involves working with conflict-related media and reading about violent events.

Specific deliverables:

Candidates who are selected will undergo extensive ACLED training. The training consists of several exercises. Candidates' exercises will be scrutinized and only those who are delivering at the required level will be retained as Researchers.

For those selected, the initial consultancy period will be from 30 October 2026 to 30 June 2027. After this, continuation may be possible, pending evaluation of quality of deliverables and availability of funding.

Please note that we are looking for candidates based specifically in Asia or Americas Time Zones.

Remuneration:

Remuneration is 20 USD per hour.

Skills and competencies:

ACLED is seeking applicants who have the following skills and experience:

  • University degree in international relations, political science, conflict studies, peacebuilding, international development, or related field;
  • Familiarity with Excel (essential);
  • Fluency in English (essential);
  • Fluency in Arabic (essential);
  • Experience conducting desk-based research;
  • Experience working to deadlines with limited supervision;
  • A high level of attention to detail and ability to receive and incorporate feedback;
  • Research focus or professional experience in conflict research or peace-building in the Middle East generally, or country-specific studies is a strong advantage;
  • Familiarity with conflict and actors in the relevant countries;
  • Access to a computer, a reliable internet connection, email, and the Microsoft Office Suite.

Applications:

To apply for this opportunity, please submit a CV and cover letter detailing qualifications, experience and language proficiency to our career portal.Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Interested candidates are advised to apply as soon as possible. We will only review applications received through our career portal, so please make sure to use the application form on the portal. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a two-hour exercise as part of the evaluation of their coding aptitude.

Please make sure to check your spam folder for correspondence.

Further information is available online at acleddata.com.

Salary: 20 USD/hour

What is PerfectServe?

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:
  1. In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.
  2. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.
At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!
The Junior Accountant will support day-to-day accounting operations, including cash applications, account reconciliations, financial reporting, and accounts receivable activities. This role requires strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with internal teams to ensure accurate and timely financial transactions.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  • Accurately process and apply customer payments across multiple companies and bank accounts, including ACH transfers, wire payments, lockbox deposits, and credit card transactions.
  • Research and resolve unidentified receipts, unapplied cash, payment discrepancies, and posting errors to ensure accurate financial records.
  • Prepare and enter journal entries into NetSuite, ensuring accuracy and proper documentation.
  • Generate and assist with monthly and ad hoc financial reports using NetSuite to support accounting operations and business needs.
  • Review and research outstanding customer credits and discrepancies on accounts receivable (AR) aging reports.
  • Manage and coordinate the escheatment process, including researching outstanding balances, maintaining records, and supporting compliance with applicable requirements.
  • Collaborate with the Collections team to investigate and resolve customer payment issues, account discrepancies, and other AR-related inquiries.
  • Prepare and perform assigned balance sheet reconciliations, identifying and resolving discrepancies in a timely manner.
  • Assist with month-end closing activities, including account reviews, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
  • Maintain accurate and organized accounting records, ensuring proper documentation of financial transactions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, enhance efficiency, and maintain data accuracy.
  • Work collaboratively with other members of the Accounting and Finance teams to support daily operations and departmental objectives.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support evolving business needs and departmental priorities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 1–2 years of accounting experience, preferably in a corporate environment.
  • Previous experience with accounts receivable, cash applications, journal entries, or account reconciliations is a plus.
  • Experience with NetSuite is preferred but not required.

Skills and Competencies

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, with strong Excel skills required.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify solutions.
  • Excellent attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple responsibilities, and meet deadlines.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
  • Ability to learn and adapt quickly to new accounting systems, software, and processes.
  • Understanding of basic accounting principles and financial transactions.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
  • Strong commitment to maintaining confidentiality and accuracy when handling financial information.

Why Join PerfectServe?

At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.
We offer a compensation range at $45,000 to $55,000 USD / year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team. The salary range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support.We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations.

PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

You’ll play a key role in delivering sales, profit and execution plans, working closely with our Tesco Group SNAM and cross‑functional colleagues to strengthen customer relationships, drive commercial performance and ensure flawless execution across promotional, range and NPD activity.

If you’re commercially astute, highly organised and energised by a fast‑paced environment, this role offers a fantastic platform to develop your career across NAM, SNAM, Category or Customer Marketing.

What you'll be doing:

  • Support the Tesco Group SNAM in managing Tesco and One Stop, helping deliver agreed sales, profit, margin and volume targets

What we're looking for:

  • Experience in sales and/or buying, with strong commercial awareness

  • Confident analysing sales data and basic financials
  • Skilled in Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook
  • Energised by a fast‑paced working environment
  • Collaborative communicator with a clear, open style
  • Methodical, organised and able to plan workload effectively
  • Motivated by team achievement and aligned with our company values

We welcome applications from candidates who do not meet 100% of the requirements

What we offer:

  • Performance-related bonus
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Private health cover
  • 25 days annual leave + birthday day off

Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Admin & Client Support Coordinator

Compensation range: $1,400 AUD - $1,800 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: Split shift

Morning window: 7:00 AM-11:00 AM Sydney Time (4:00 AM–8:00 AM Philippine Time)

Afternoon window: 3:00 PM-7:00 PM Sydney Time (12:00 PM–4:00 PM Philippine Time)

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: An established Australian in-home care provider and federally funded community delivering services through aged care, NDIS, Department of Veterans’ Affairs, and Hospital Transition Care programs.

Role Overview: We’re seeking a calm, mature and organised Admin & Client Support Coordinator to be the first point of contact for clients, Care Workers and partners. You will answer calls, understand what each caller needs, and make sure every matter reaches the right person and gets resolved.

Alongside the phones, you will support the business with transactional roster updates, vendor follow-ups and agreements, appointment booking and general administration. This role suits someone who brings warmth to difficult conversations, keeps meticulous notes and takes ownership of follow-through.

Key Responsibilities:

Call Handling and Client Support

  • Answer incoming calls from clients, families, Care Workers, vendors and prospective clients.
  • Listen carefully, calm distressed callers and work with them towards a resolution.
  • Record accurate call notes: caller details, request, urgency and required action.
  • Direct each matter to the right team (Care Management, HR, Sales or Management) and confirm urgent items are received.
  • Resolve routine enquiries directly once trained on the relevant process.

Roster Support

  • Record client cancellations, Care Worker sick calls and other short-term changes.
  • Update approved systems and notify affected staff and the coordination team.
  • Confirm each change has been handed over and actioned.

Vendor, Documentation and Follow-up

  • Follow up vendors and support the preparation and tracking of vendor agreements.
  • Track documents awaiting signature, approval or information and chase them to completion.
  • Keep files organised, version-controlled and stored in the approved location.
  • Maintain a task tracker so every request is followed through to completion.

Sales, HR and General Admin

  • Record new enquiries and book sales calls, consultations and follow-ups.
  • Assist with recruitment admin, candidate scheduling and HR record keeping.
  • Manage calendars, prepare correspondence and provide regular progress updates.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • 2+ years in administration, client service, call handling or a similar role.
  • Experience supporting Australian clients or businesses.
  • Excellent spoken and written English with a warm, clear and professional phone manner.
  • High emotional intelligence and composure with distressed or demanding callers.
  • Strong note-taking, organisation and follow-up skills.
  • Confident across multiple systems, including cloud phone platforms, CRMs and shared drives.
  • Good judgement on when to act and when to escalate.
  • Highly trustworthy with confidential client and staff information.

Highly Regarded:

  • Experience in home care, aged care, disability (NDIS), health or community services.
  • Familiarity with RingCentral or similar cloud telephony.
  • Experience with rostering or care management software.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Callers feel heard, reassured and confident their matter is in hand.
  • Every call, referral and roster change is recorded accurately and promptly.
  • Urgent and sensitive matters reach the right person quickly.
  • Follow-ups are closed out and the business owner is kept informed.
  • Consistent, reliable availability across both call windows.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

raw.description:
Request for Proposals: User Experience (UX) Review and Redesign Recommendations for asiapacific.ca

Issued byAsia Pacific Foundation of Canada (APF Canada)RFP reference no.APFC-2026-UX-01Date issuedOctober 22, 2026Questions dueNovember 2, 5:00 p.m. PTProposals dueNovember 23, 5:00 p.m. PTSubmit to[]

1. About APF Canada

The Asia Pacific Foundation of Canada is Canada’s only national public‑purpose institution dedicated exclusively to Canada‑Asia engagement. Our vision is a prosperous, secure Canada shaping its future through high‑impact engagement with Asia, and our mission is to enable Canadians to understand, connect with, and succeed in Asia.

2. Background and Purpose

APF Canada is seeking a qualified UX consultant or firm to conduct an independent, evidence-based review of asiapacific.ca and to deliver clear, prioritized, and implementable recommendations for modernizing the site’s structure, usability, and visual design – without diminishing the visibility of our core research outputs, programs, and networks.

This engagement is a strategic re-design engagement. It is not an implementation contract (see Section 6).

3. Objectives
The successful proponent will help APF Canada achieve the following:

  1. Understand our audiences. Establish who actually uses asiapacific.ca, what they come for, and where the current experience fails them – grounded in analytics and primary user research, not assumption.
  2. Simplify the information architecture. Recommend a navigation and content taxonomy that is intelligible to a first-time visitor while still surfacing the full breadth of our research, programs, and networks.
  3. Make our research findable. Recommend search, filtering, and browsing patterns appropriate to a large and growing publications archive.
  4. Modernize the visual design. Recommend a contemporary, credible, distinctly APF Canada visual direction appropriate to a national policy institution – clean, readable, and confident rather than decorative.
  5. Clarify the digital ecosystem. Advise on the relationship between asiapacific.ca and our satellite properties.

4. Timeline

RFP issuedOctober 22, 2026Deadline for written questionsNovember 2, 2026Answers posted to all proponentsNovember 6, 2026

Proposals due

November 23, 2026, 5:00 p.m. PT

Anticipated engagement duration is [14–18] weeks from kickoff. Proponents should propose a schedule aligned to their methodology and flag any dependencies on APF Canada staff availability.

5. Budget

The total budget for this engagement is not to exceed C$30,000, inclusive of all professional fees, participant incentives, software and research tool costs, travel, and applicable taxes.

Proponents must provide a detailed cost breakdown by phase and by deliverable. Where a proponent believes the objectives cannot be fully met within this budget, they should identify which elements they would recommend prioritizing and price optional components separately.

6. Proposal Requirements
Proposals must not exceed 20 pages excluding appendices, CVs, and portfolio samples, and must include:

  1. Cover letter (1 page) – primary contact, firm overview, and a statement of interest.

Page of

  1. Understanding of the assignment – your reading of APF Canada’s challenge, based on your own review of asiapacific.ca. We are particularly interested in what you observe that we may not have.
  2. Proposed approach and methodology – including research methods, participant recruitment strategy, and how you will balance modernization against preservation of our core content.
  3. Work plan and schedule – phases, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.
  4. Team – named individuals, roles, time allocation, and relevant experience. Identify who will lead the engagement and who will conduct research and design. Note any subcontractors.
  5. Relevant experience – three comparable projects, ideally involving content-heavy, research-driven, mission-based, bilingual, or public-sector organizations. Include client references with contact information (references contacted only for shortlisted proponents).
  6. Portfolio – samples demonstrating both research rigour and design quality. Where possible, include evidence of measured outcomes.
  7. Bilingual and accessibility capability – describe your French-language research capacity and your accessibility expertise, including relevant certifications or auditing experience.
  8. Detailed budget – as described in Section 5.
  9. Assumptions, exclusions, and requirements of APF Canada.

7. Submission Instructions

Submit proposals as a single PDF to [] with the subject line “APFC-2026-UX-01 – [Proponent Name]” no later than November 23, 2026, 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time. Late submissions will not be considered.

Written questions may be submitted to the same address until November 2, 2026. Questions and answers will be compiled, anonymized, and circulated to all registered proponents to ensure fairness.

Contact: Michael Roberts, Communications Director, Asia Pacific Foundation of Canada,
