We are seeking a dynamic and highly organized Operations Associate to support the Strategic Advisory Group across business operations, marketing and business development, financial administration, and other practice defining activities. This is a highly visible, service-oriented role for someone who can move comfortably between detailed execution and higher-level coordination, interface professionally with colleagues at every level, and respond quickly as priorities change.

The successful candidate will bring an ownership mindset to every assignment, with the judgment to recognize what is urgent, the discipline to track commitments through completion, and the flexibility to take on work of any size and have the mentality of nothing is too big or small to jump in and take care of. This person will serve as a dependable team member who uses technology, organization, and clear communication to keep initiatives moving and ensure important details do not fall through the cracks.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provide responsive day-to-day operational support to SAG leaders and team members, shifting focus as business needs and deadlines evolve.
  • Coordinate work across senior leadership, practitioners, corporate functions, and external contacts while maintaining a polished and professional approach.
  • Support marketing and business development activities, including opportunity tracking, meeting preparation, follow-up actions, event support, and maintenance of marketing materials.
  • Create, update, and quality-check pitch decks, qualifications packages, presentations, and other client-facing materials in collaboration with subject-matter experts.
  • Administer CRM data and processes, including new opportunity entry, contact and account updates, pipeline hygiene, activity tracking, reporting, and follow-up reminders.
  • Monitor accounts receivable, work in process, billing status, collections follow-up, and related reporting; coordinate with project teams and Finance to resolve issues promptly.
  • Prepare and support client invoicing, including gathering backup, confirming billing details, tracking approvals, monitoring invoice status, and maintaining accurate records.
  • Develop and maintain trackers, dashboards, templates, shared workspaces, and process documentation that improve visibility, consistency, and accountability.
  • Coordinate recurring and ad hoc meetings, prepare agendas and materials, capture decisions and action items, and follow through with owners until items are closed.
  • Assist with onboarding, system access, internal requests, team communications, and other administrative or operational needs that help colleagues work effectively.
  • Use Microsoft 365 and other business systems to streamline routine tasks, improve data quality, and identify practical opportunities for automation and process improvement.
  • Handle confidential and sensitive information with care, sound judgment, and appropriate discretion.
  • Anticipate needs, identify risks or missing information early, and escalate appropriately while offering practical solutions.
  • Take on additional priorities as needed with a service mentality and a willingness to contribute wherever the team needs support.

The successful candidate will demonstrate the following professional abilities and experience:

  • Experience in operations, project coordination, team support, marketing and business development support, finance administration, or a comparable client-service environment.
  • Exceptional organization and follow-through, with a reliable system for managing multiple deadlines, requests, stakeholders, and recurring responsibilities.
  • Ability to shift between strategic, analytical, administrative, and hands-on tasks without losing visibility into existing commitments.
  • Strong service orientation and a consistent willingness to handle both high-profile assignments and routine details with equal care.
  • Professional presence and communication skills, with the confidence and judgment to work effectively across all organizational levels and with external contacts.
  • Working knowledge of marketing and business development workflows, presentation development, CRM administration, AR/WIP/billing management, and invoicing, or the ability to learn these areas quickly.
  • Advanced proficiency or strong aptitude with Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint; interest in using technology and automation to improve work.
  • Ability to produce accurate, polished, and client-ready work products, including presentations, trackers, reports, and written communications.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and accountability when handling financial, client, personnel, or other confidential information.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to learn unfamiliar systems, processes, and subject matter.
  • Ability to work independently, ask effective questions, collaborate across functions, and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities may change and timely execution is essential.

This role requires regular computer-based work, participation in virtual and in-person meetings, and the ability to manage time-sensitive priorities. Flexibility may be needed outside standard business hours when business or client needs require it. The work arrangement and any travel expectations will be determined based on team and business requirements.

Some of the Benefits We Have Include

J.S. Held understands that our employees are people and that life sometimes requires flexibility. We work to provide an environment that supports our team’s needs.

  • Generous FTO policy
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) match
  • Commuter benefit

Compensation

A reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role is $65,000-$80,000. Any offered salary is based on factors including skill set, experience, training, location, scope of role, and level of responsibility.

Other Duties

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read the J.S. Held Online Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as required and described therein. California residents can click here to learn more about the personal information we collect and here to learn about additional privacy rights that may be available.

raw.description:
Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

Compensation: The United States base salary range for this full-time position is $140,000-$200,000 + bonus + equity depending on experience

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Assist Lead/ Senior Scheduler in Time Impact Analysis reporting. Assist Lead/ Senior Scheduler in managing multiple scheduling projects and teams. Produce and distribute tailored schedule reporting to meet the project team’s needs that effectively communicates issues, status, health, and progress of the execution plan. Through guidance from Lead/ Sr. Schedulers, gain understanding of how to handle client facing meetings along with the project team. Understand and apply schedule change management. Proficiency in or have an advanced understanding of Critical Path Method (CPM) principles, as it applied to in Primavera P6 scheduling software. Proficiency in blueprint reading. Proficiency in navigating and general comprehension of contract and specifications. Solid analytic ability with excellent written and verbal communications skills required. Ability to organize and manage complex tasks, establish and meet schedules and maintain focus on goals. Knowledge of industry planning and scheduling practices and construction methods. Overview

Job Title: Business Development Manager - U.S. Market Expansion

About Nomos

Nomos (www.nomossystemes.com) is a niche manufacturer with over 20 years of experience designing and building control cabinets and integrated control systems for high-voltage equipment and power transformer applications. Our solutions are certified for the U.S. and canadian market and are currently used by several major North American players.

Nomos operates as a specialized business unit within the Asplundh group, a leading U.S.-based organization serving the utility and infrastructure sectors. As part of Asplundh Power division, Nomos combines the agility and technical focus of a niche engineering company with the financial strength and long-term stability of a well-established North American group.

Supported by an experienced engineering team that collaborates daily with North american customers, Nomos delivers customized, high-quality solutions tailored to the evolving needs of utilities, transformer manufacturers, and energy infrastructure providers.

As part of our long-term U.S. growth strategy, Nomos is accelerating its market expansion and seeking a senior-level business development professional to strengthen and diversify its presence.

Benefits:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Savings Plan with Company Match
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) and a Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Perks:

  • Competitive Pay
  • Talent Development – Instructor-Led Technical Courses and Online Learning
  • Career Path Planning
  • Incentives for Professional Certifications
  • Competitive Per Diem for Travel
  • Referral Bonuses
  • Tuition Reimbursement

Position Overview

This role is focused on strategic U.S. market expansion and new account development within the high-voltage and power transformer ecosystem.

The Business Development Manager will develop and execute a structured, multi-year U.S. market expansion plan aligned with long-term growth objectives. This position complements our existing U.S. sales presence by focusing specifically on proactive market development, new relationship creation, and strategic positioning.

This is a relationship-driven market with long sales cycles (12–36 months). Success requires persistence, technical credibility, and the ability to build trust over time.

This is not a transactional closing role. The focus is on prospecting, positioning, and generating qualified opportunities, working closely with Nomos’ internal engineering and technical teams who manage detailed technical discussions and proposals.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a structured U.S. market expansion plan aligned with long-term growth objectives
  • Identify and pursue new opportunities within investor-owned utilities (IOUs), municipal utilities, electric cooperatives (co-ops), OEM transformer manufacturers, EPC firms, and high-voltage service providers
  • Establish and grow relationships with engineering, asset management, and procurement decision-makers
  • Increase Nomos’ visibility and strategic positioning within the U.S. high-voltage ecosystem
  • Generate and qualify leads while building a strong, sustainable pipeline
  • Represent Nomos at key industry events (IEEE, CIGRÉ, Doble, regional utility forums, etc.)
  • Deliver technical presentations, white papers, and sales pitches
  • Provide structured market intelligence to leadership and engineering teams regarding trends, competition, and evolving customer needs
  • Collaborate internally to ensure smooth transition from opportunity identification to technical engagement and proposal development

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of experience in technical sales, business development, or market development within power transformers, high-voltage equipment, substations / protection & control, industrial control cabinets, or utility infrastructure
  • Demonstrated ability to develop new markets or expand territories in a structured and disciplined manner
  • Strong understanding of the U.S. utility and high-voltage ecosystem
  • Ability to engage credibly with technical and engineering stakeholders
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Willingness to travel extensively within the United States

Preferred

  • Electrical engineering background or strong technical foundation
  • Existing network within U.S. utilities, co-ops, OEMs, or EPC firms
  • Experience operating in long-cycle, relationship-driven sales environments

Candidate Profile

  • Strategic thinker with a disciplined, structured approach to market development
  • Hunter mindset with long-term relationship focus
  • Naturally proactive in identifying and shaping new opportunities
  • Resilient and patient in complex, multi-year sales cycles
  • Self-motivated and capable of building territory presence with limited supervision
  • Credible and confident representing Nomos at both technical and executive levels

NOMOS is an equal opportunity employer and gives consideration for employment to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, disability, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity and sexual orientation), political affiliation, military service, national origin, age or any other characteristics protected by state or federal laws.

NOMOS does not work with individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies and will not recognize claim to any unsolicited resumes or candidate information.

About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In this role

You will manage a portfolio of customer accounts, driving service renewals, identifying new sales opportunities, and negotiating agreements that support customer business goals. You will work independently to manage deals from pipeline development through close, partnering with account managers and internal business teams to develop proposals, address customer objections, and establish effective deal strategies. This role requires a proactive sales professional who can build customer relationships, maintain accurate forecasts, manage renewal timelines, and deliver measurable results in a remote, fast-paced environment. You will also contribute to expanding access to technology, training, and services that help education and nonprofit organizations succeed in an AI-driven economy.

  • A demonstrated record of achieving sales targets, improving renewal performance, or delivering measurable customer and business outcomes

  • In a groundbreaking collaboration, Microsoft licensed our product in June 2021, reaffirming our commitment to excellence.
  • Recognized among the top 100 solution providers in Canada, we're also honored to be part of the Microsoft Business Applications 2022/2023 Inner Circle.
  • We take immense pride in being certified as a great place to work in Canada, fostering a culture of collaboration and growth across our global teams.
  • Embracing a vibrant work culture, we offer a perfect blend of work-life balance, along with company-sponsored health insurance and a nurturing environment where your well-being is paramount.
  • With 27 leaves annually plus 11 festival holidays, we ensure you have ample time to recharge and celebrate life's moments.
  • Whether you prefer to work from our offices in Canada or Chandigarh or cherish the comfort of your home, we offer flexible arrangements to suit your preferences.

Excited yet? Here's where you come in:


Position Summary:

As part of the Customer Support Team, you will work alongside Support Analysts, led by the Customer Support Manager. As a member of the team, you will get the opportunity to work flexible hours, with a diverse team and cutting-edge technology. As an Escalation Engineer, you can expect to tackle new challenges every day, handling a wide range of issues and bugs. Acting as an intermediary between our Support and Development functions to prevent support issues from disturbing scheduled software production for our Dynamics Business Central products. You have a unique combination of advanced technical and communication skills, being able to manage complex customer and partner relationships effectively. By building meaningful relationships with clients, you have the ability to directly impact Binary Stream’s bottom line.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

Escalations & Technical Support

  • Lead escalations, act as the primary escalation point for complex or urgent customer cases.
  • Conduct advanced troubleshooting, debug & pinpoint issues in the code, complete root cause analysis, and provide timely customer updates.
  • Evaluate, develop and document alternative solutions or workarounds to software defects before involving Development.
  • Obtain and record all information needed to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve each issue.

Search Program Coordinator

Full-Time | Fully Remote | Evening & Weekend Flexibility Required

About the Opportunity

Forge Performance Group Inc. is a Recruitment & Talent Management solutions team located in Calgary, AB. We are currently recruiting on behalf of one of our clients for a Search Program Coordinator to support a time-sensitive search and response program focused on missing children.

This is an important operational role for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, responsive, and comfortable managing sensitive information in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will help coordinate alerts, monitor incoming tips and public communications, maintain accurate case records, and ensure critical information is reviewed and communicated promptly through established procedures.

This is a full-time, fully remote position, primarily focused on weekday daytime coverage, with flexibility required to support occasional evening and weekend coverage as operational needs arise.

Key Responsibilities

Search Program Coordination & Response

  • Receive, review, and process incoming requests from police agencies requiring search program support.
  • Enter, verify, and maintain accurate case information across approved databases, systems, and communication channels.
  • Coordinate the activation, distribution, updating, and closure of search alerts in accordance with established procedures.
  • Ensure case information is accurate, current, and consistent across internal and public-facing channels.
  • Monitor active cases and implement updates promptly as new information is received.
  • Escalate emerging issues, risks, and urgent matters to the appropriate leadership contact.

Tip Intake & Information Management

  • Monitor incoming tips, sightings, public messages, and other case-related information.
  • Review information promptly to identify relevant details, potential safety concerns, and updates requiring action.
  • Document and forward tips to the appropriate police agency in accordance with established protocols.
  • Maintain detailed records of information received, actions taken, and notifications made.
  • Recognize and escalate urgent, sensitive, incomplete, or unclear information.

Social Media & Public Communications Monitoring

  • Monitor social media messages, comments, mentions, and tags for tips, sightings, and case updates.
  • Review public interactions carefully and direct relevant information through the appropriate response process.
  • Monitor designated police information feeds and media-monitoring tools for new or updated case information.
  • Track developments involving active cases and communicate relevant changes promptly.

Reporting & Records Management

  • Prepare search alert reports and post-activation summaries.
  • Track alert reach and engagement across designated communication channels.
  • Maintain complete and accurate records of alerts, tips, updates, case closures, and actions taken.
  • Support reporting, quality assurance, and internal follow-up activities.
  • Identify recurring issues, information gaps, and opportunities to improve operational processes.

Additional Program Support

  • Assist with community awareness initiatives, public education campaigns, and outreach activities as required.
  • Support volunteer engagement and related program activities when operational demands permit.
  • Assist with other duties aligned with program priorities and operational needs.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and the ability to learn web-based databases, case management systems, alerting platforms, and content management tools.
  • Strong written communication, proofreading, documentation, and information-verification skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple digital channels simultaneously.
  • Ability to assess information carefully and distinguish verified details from unconfirmed content.
  • Working knowledge of confidentiality, privacy, records management, and responsible public communication practices.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize competing demands in time-sensitive situations.
  • Sound judgment, accountability, and the ability to follow established procedures while recognizing when escalation is required.
  • Professional communication skills when interacting with colleagues, external partners, police representatives, and members of the public.
  • A compassionate, respectful, and trauma-aware approach when working with sensitive information involving children and families.

Key Competencies

The ideal candidate is dependable, responsive, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment. They can remain focused during extended periods of monitoring, respond appropriately when urgent information is received, and maintain accuracy under pressure.

They understand the importance of discretion and safeguarding sensitive information and can be trusted to handle confidential material responsibly.

Work Arrangement & Schedule

  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Work arrangement: Fully remote
  • Schedule: Primarily weekday daytime coverage, with flexibility for occasional evening and weekend coverage as required.
  • Availability: Must be reachable and able to respond throughout assigned coverage periods, including during scheduled evening or weekend coverage.
  • Confidentiality: Strict adherence to privacy, information security, and records management requirements is essential.

How to Apply

If you are a detail-oriented and dependable professional who thrives in a structured, time-sensitive environment and wants to contribute to meaningful work, we encourage you to apply.

Please submit your resume through Forge Performance Group Inc. for consideration.

This opportunity is posted by Forge Performance Group Inc. on behalf of one of our clients.

Overview:

Vivi is the campus operating system that unifies every display and device across schools. Trusted by thousands of schools worldwide, Vivi helps schools improve teaching, strengthen communication, and enhance campus safety through a single, easy-to-manage platform.

From wireless screen sharing and digital signage to emergency alerts, live captions, and campus-wide communications, Vivi helps schools get more value from the technology they already own. Our platform empowers educators to create engaging learning experiences while giving school leaders the tools they need to communicate quickly, respond confidently, and operate more efficiently.

At Vivi, we're passionate about helping schools solve real-world challenges with simple, reliable technology. We're a global team that values collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact for educators and students every day.

The Role

The Support Engineer is responsible for Vivi’s IT Operations and Product Support in the US & EMEA region. Reporting into the Director, this role will focus on delivering Technical Support for the Vivi product to our customers mainly in the US as we continue to expand in this region. Some of the daily activities in this space will include responding to customer’s support requests via Jira Service Desk tickets, setting up online meetings, taking phone calls, testing, troubleshooting, and replicating issues prior to escalating to the Australian based Engineering team.

You will also be the main point of contact for internal day-to-day activities such as email, file share, desktop, software/hardware, system access requests, user onboarding/offboarding and end user training.

This role will work closely with a global technical team which includes Software Engineers, Product Managers, Sales Engineers and you will be expected to gain a broad knowledge of the Vivi product suite to become a go-to person for product and process knowledge and solving problems. You will also play a valuable part in building the Support function (internally & externally) and its processes as Vivi expands globally.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with fellow Support Engineers and the Support Team Leader, sharing knowledge and best practice
  • Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the Support Team Leader and Engineering, following correct escalation procedures
  • Provide technical support to all Vivi stakeholders with the priority being 1st - 2nd level to Vivi customers & 1st - 3rd level to internal staff. You will manage and resolve incoming requests and incidents in Jira Service Desk within SLA’s
  • Become an SME on the Vivi product for the US region
  • Understand network concepts & terminology and be able to diagnose and troubleshoot issues on customer networks. An ability to communicate networking issues and recommendations to customers is crucial to the success of this role
  • Providing superior support of the Vivi application across Mac, Windows & Android as well as supporting Vivi’s hardware
  • Manage user access and account provisioning for various SaaS applications as well as supporting and troubleshoot desktop/hardware/mobile issues across Mac and Windows platforms
  • Contribute to implementing modern technologies/tools/processes to improve efficiency and workflows globally
  • Contributing to planning/brainstorming new features or iterations of the IT support/service desk
  • Supporting onboarding and offboarding of Vivi employees
  • Assist with end user training and enabling stakeholders to self-serve – this is for both Vivi customers and internal staff
  • Creating documentation for internal and external stakeholders
  • Delivering on BAU and prioritised project initiatives in line with the Vivi’s OKR’s and the Support Teams initiatives and business priorities occasional travel required

Typical day to day activities may include...

  • Working with the Support Team Leader and fellow Support Engineers to share knowledge and escalate complex issues where required
  • Providing technical support to Vivi customers which range from supporting the Vivi Application across Mac, Windows & Android platforms, the Vivi hardware (running our customised firmware) and Vivi Central – our software management platform.
  • Testing & replicating customer reported faults across different platforms and providing solutions or workarounds in the event a bug has been found whilst following correct escalation procedures
  • Provide internal technical support, system configuration, incident management and training across a range of SaaS and cloud platforms which includes (but not limited to): Office365, Microsoft Azure, Slack, HubSpot, Atlassian suite, Zoom & others
  • Provide training to customers and staff around features or issues with the Vivi product
  • Providing systems training and support for Vivi staff for internally used SaaS applications
  • Installing, configuring, and maintaining Vivi’s Windows and Mac fleet with software and hardware solutions

Experience:

  • Minimum of 3+ years’ experience in a technical support role with a good understanding of networking technologies
  • Be able to demonstrate a high level of attention to detail in all areas of IT support and the ability to work autonomously to prioritise, multi-task and work in a fast-moving environment
  • Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills with strong customer service focus
  • Strong problem analysis and problem-solving skills
  • Strong understanding and experience supporting Apple, Windows & Android environments
  • Broad understanding of common desktop applications, systems administration and cloud technology

Required Skills:

  • Experience working in O365 & Azure AD
  • Atlassian Suite (Jira Service Desk and Confluence)
  • Diagnosing & troubleshooting networking issues across ethernet and Wi-Fi

Highly Desirable Skills:

  • Certifications: ITIL, CCNA, AWS, CompTIA
  • Prior experience within SaaS or EdTech environments
  • Agile ways of working
  • Exposure to Cyber Security and best practices
  • Exposure to AWS
  • Scripting, automation & PowerShell
  • Vendor Management experience

Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence. We have raised $77M and are backed by Craft Ventures (Tesla, Facebook, Airbnb ), Nexus Venture Partners ( Postman, Apollo.io,MinIO, Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( Redis, Rollbar, Gradle).

Location Preference: Remote, Anywhere in the US

About the Role:

Fingerprint is looking for an FP&A Manager to support financial and strategic operations behind a company that is scaling fast and selling to some of the largest consumer platforms in the world.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and continuously improve the consolidated corporate model in our FP&A tool Abacum — three-statement P&L, cash, headcount planning, non-personnel spend, SaaS metrics
  • Run our annual budget cycle and distribute monthly budget review decks with our FP&A tool Abacum

  • Build the board reporting packages
  • Own the SaaS metrics layer end to end — ARR bridge, gross and net revenue retention, cohort and expansion analysis, CAC payback, magic number, pipeline-to-revenue conversion, and sales capacity modeling
  • Head procurement with Tropic partner, managing the usage and spend complexities of our largest vendor contracts
  • Handle Revenue commissions process from plan implementation to commission payment
  • Provide strategic analysis on key operational questions: pricing scenarios, segment profitability, etc.

Qualifications:

  • 6-10 years of progressive finance experience, with real depth in modeling and forecasting
  • At least one stint at a startup or high-growth company (Experience at a company in the 100–1,000 person range preferred)
  • Direct experience with SaaS metrics and recurring-revenue mechanics: ARR bridges, retention, cohorts, and how a booking becomes revenue becomes cash
  • Enjoys problem solving with business partners
  • Detail-oriented, strong accountability to quality of work and deadlines
  • Passion for efficiency via process, systems and AI
  • Modeling and software craft that holds up to inspection: clean structure and auditable logic
  • Comfort with SQL, a BI tool (Sigma, Looker, Tableau) or Claude
  • Comfortable working fully remotely and proficiency with macOS using tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, Salesforce, NetSuite and FP&A Tool
  • Strong written communication
  • Value add Claude user

  • Strong preference for investment banking, management consulting, transaction advisory, private equity, or corporate development early in your career — the environments that force pace, precision, and the habit of defending your work
  • Exposure to a fundraise, audit, or diligence process from the company side highly preferred
  • Bonus: Systems implementation experience — an ERP migration, a planning tool rollout, or building the data pipeline that made reporting possible

Compensation & Transparency

At Fingerprint, we believe in pay transparency — it's part of how we operate as a distributed, remote-first team. Salaries are based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies.

Because this role is open across the United States and can be based anywhere our team members work from, the salary range reflects that geographic breadth: $118,000 - $160,000.

Some example salaries for specific locations are below:

New York City: $139,000 - $160,000

Chicago: $118,000 - $136,000

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including the successful candidate's location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Due to regulatory and security reasons, there’s a small number of countries where we cannot have Fingerprint teammates based. Additionally, because Fingerprint is an all-remote company and people can join our workforce from almost any country, we do not sponsor visas. Fingerprint teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location.

We are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives and cultural backgrounds that each employee brings to our workplace. Fingerprint strives to foster an environment where our employees feel respected, valued and empowered, and our team members are at the forefront in helping us promote and sustain an inclusive workplace. We highly encourage people from underrepresented groups in tech to apply.

If you are applying as a resident of California, please read our CCPA notice here.

If you are applying as a resident of the EU, please read our GDPR notice here.

raw.description:
What's the role?

At HERE Technologies, we are transforming the future of autonomous driving by combining one of the world's richest sources of map and drive data with cutting-edge generative AI. As ADAS and Automated Driving systems increasingly rely on model-driven intelligence, we are building the next generation of AI-powered spatial intelligence platforms that create scalable, high-quality synthetic driving environments for training and validation.

We are seeking a highly experienced AI scientist and technical leader who can bridge the worlds of generative AI and autonomous vehicle simulation. In this role, you will lead the development of map-grounded world foundation models, enabling the creation of realistic, controllable, and measurable synthetic driving scenarios that accelerate the next generation of perception and planning systems.

As a Senior Principal AI Scientist, you will:

  • Lead the technical strategy and development of map-grounded world foundation models, leveraging HERE map and drive data to generate realistic and controllable driving scenarios.
  • Train, fine-tune, and deploy advanced generative AI models, including diffusion models, transformer-based world models, and generative video architectures for autonomous driving applications.
  • Drive proof-of-concept initiatives with strategic technology partners, establishing measurable success criteria and translating research outcomes into actionable business recommendations.
  • Bridge generative AI workflows with AV simulation platforms such as CARLA, NVIDIA Drive Sim, and other industry-standard environments to support training and validation use cases.
  • Define and implement quality frameworks that evaluate synthetic data utility, controllability, coverage, and downstream model performance.
  • Collaborate across machine learning, perception, planning, simulation, and product teams to ensure synthetic data solutions deliver measurable improvements in real-world autonomous driving performance.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to engineering and business leaders, translating complex AI concepts into strategic opportunities and product roadmaps.

Who are you?

You are a recognized expert in both deep learning and autonomous vehicle simulation, with a proven record of turning advanced AI research into production-ready solutions. You are equally comfortable training large-scale world models, designing simulation-based validation strategies, and influencing technical direction across multidisciplinary teams.

You bring:

  • Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in machine learning, autonomous systems, simulation, robotics, or related disciplines, including significant hands-on experience developing and deploying AI models.
  • Deep expertise in generative AI, including diffusion models, generative video systems, transformer architectures, world models, or related foundation model technologies.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch, with experience building scalable research and production ML pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with autonomous vehicle simulation platforms such as CARLA, NVIDIA Drive Sim, or equivalent simulation environments.
  • Strong understanding of OpenDRIVE, OpenSCENARIO, ASAM OpenX standards, scenario-based validation, and sim-to-real methodologies.
  • Experience evaluating synthetic data quality for machine learning applications, including controllability, diversity, coverage, label fidelity, and downstream model effectiveness.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with NVIDIA Cosmos, Cosmos-Transfer, or other world foundation model platforms.
  • Background in reinforcement learning, end-to-end driving systems, or multi-agent simulation.
  • Experience in automotive, robotics, or other safety-critical domains, including familiarity with ISO 26262 and SOTIF concepts.
  • Contributions to research publications, patents, open-source AI projects, or industry-leading innovation initiatives.
  • Experience with Unreal Engine, Unity, sensor simulation, or large-scale training infrastructure.

What sets you apart:

  • You thrive at the intersection of research and execution, translating innovation into real-world impact.
  • You can communicate effectively with AI researchers, simulation engineers, product managers, and executive stakeholders.
  • You are hands-on, data-driven, and focused on measurable outcomes rather than theoretical perfection.
  • You bring a systems-thinking mindset, understanding how decisions in data generation affect downstream AI performance.
  • You are passionate about building technology that advances the future of autonomous mobility.

    The expected base salary range for this position is $170,600 to $250,000 per year. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as skills and experience. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, which is subject to company and individual performance.

    Life at HERE comes with generous benefits to support your health and overall wellness. Benefits available to US-based HERE employees include health (Medical/Dental/Vision) insurance, retirement savings plans, paid time off & leave policies.

    As part of HERE Technologies employment process, candidates will be required to successfully complete a background verification process. Offers of employment and any related claims are subject to the successful completion of a background verification. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, HERE will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

    HERE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

    Under Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 and VEVRAA, we have developed an affirmative action program (AAP) for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. Portions of the AAP are available for review by applicants and employees through our People Team.

Who are we?

HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower our customers to achieve better outcomes – from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely.

At HERE we take it upon ourselves to be the change we wish to see. We create solutions that fuel innovation, provide opportunity and foster inclusion to improve people’s lives. If you are inspired by an open world and driven to create positive change, join us. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel.

As ADAS/AD moves towards model-driven intelligence, industry value is extending from map delivery to model training and validation. HERE can convert its map and drive data into a scalable AI model-creation platform – capturing significant value from training, validation and next generation ADAS/AD performance.

It’s the growth of HERE’s AI-model creation platform that turns maps and drive data into reusable spatial intelligence – powering scalable training, validation, and next generation ADAS/AD performance.

DotWorld opère un portefeuille de produits SaaS B2C, 100 % autofinancés, utilisés chaque année par des dizaines de millions de visiteur(se)s. Ces produits encaissent des paiements, traitent des données personnelles et sont exposés à Internet en permanence : chez nous, la sécurité, c'est la confiance de nos utilisateur(rice)s et de nos partenaires de paiement.

Nous recherchons notre premier(e) Lead Security Engineer, la toute première personne dédiée à la sécurité chez DotWorld. Ta mission : rendre DotWorld difficile à attaquer, repérer vite celles et ceux qui essaient, et riposter calmement.

Ton rôle s'articule autour de trois axes :

  • La défense d'abord : sécuriser les accès, le cloud, la production et les postes de travail

  • L'offensif en appui : penser comme un(e) attaquant(e) et tester nos propres défenses

  • La structuration : diffuser une culture sécurité dans toutes les équipes et, à terme, accompagner nos démarches de conformité

C'est un poste de création : tu poses les fondations, tu choisis les priorités et tu as un vrai pouvoir de décision sur les choix sécu.

👥 Description de l'équipe

Tu seras rattaché(e) directement à Grégoire OHANESSIAN, notre CTO. Tu travailleras en binôme avec Aleksander FIELEK, notre DevOps, au service d'environ 25 développeur(se)s réparti(e)s en squads produit.

Tu feras partie du département Plateforme, qui travaille avec tout le monde : tu seras en lien régulier avec toutes les équipes tech et l'équipe Risk & Payment, puis, dans un second temps, avec les responsables de chaque département pour comprendre leurs enjeux sécu. L'équipe est full remote, orientée impact, avec une culture forte de l'autonomie.

📂 Tes responsabilités

Identité et accès

  • Construire une gestion des identités centralisée et robuste : SSO, provisioning (SCIM), MFA forte

  • Appliquer le principe du moindre privilège, avec des élévations de droits temporaires et tracées

  • Sécuriser les arrivées, changements d'équipe et départs, y compris pour les prestataires

  • Administrer le gestionnaire de mots de passe et les comptes de service

Cloud, production et secrets

  • Sécuriser nos environnements cloud (AWS multi-comptes, plateformes de déploiement, CDN / WAF)

  • Éliminer les secrets statiques au profit d'identités éphémères (OIDC, rôles IAM) et automatiser leur rotation

  • Durcir les configurations et faire la revue sécu des nouvelles briques d'architecture

Postes et réseau

  • Gérer la sécurité de la flotte de postes (MDM, chiffrement, mises à jour)

  • Déployer une approche zero trust pour l'accès aux outils critiques

Détection et réponse

  • Centraliser les logs de sécurité et construire des alertes vraiment utiles

  • Mener les incidents de sécurité de bout en bout : détection, confinement, correction, post-mortem

  • Contrer les attaques propres aux produits B2C : credential stuffing, account takeover, card testing, création de comptes en masse, scraping, DDoS

Offensif

  • Réaliser des pentests internes et des revues de code sécu, en tirant parti des outils IA

  • Piloter les pentests externes et, si pertinent, un programme de bug bounty

Culture et conformité

  • Sensibiliser les équipes : formations internes, guides de bonnes pratiques, exercices de phishing

  • Accompagner les squads sur le code sécurisé

  • Dans un second temps, mener des audits sécurité auprès de chaque département

  • À terme, contribuer aux démarches de conformité (ISO 27001 / SOC 2, PCI DSS) et à la relation avec les auditeur(rice)s et partenaires de paiement

⭐ Ton profil

Expérience

  • Tu as déjà eu la sécurité d'une entreprise ou d'un large périmètre sous ta responsabilité, en autonomie - souvent un parcours Dev / DevOps qui a évolué vers la sécurité par la pratique ou par passion

  • Pas besoin d'avoir déjà été lead, ni d'avoir travaillé dans un grand département sécu ou une Red Team

  • Tu as mené de vrais incidents de sécurité de bout en bout

  • Tu sais prioriser par le risque réel plutôt que par la checklist

  • Idéalement, tu as évolué dans une entreprise ou une équipe qui a mis en place une démarche de conformité, même si ce n'est pas toi qui l'as portée

  • Avoir mené ou accompagné un audit ISO 27001, SOC 2 ou PCI DSS est un bonus

  • Une expérience sur la fraude et les abus de produits B2C qui encaissent des paiements est un vrai plus

Compétences techniques

Indispensables :

  • Sécurité cloud AWS solide et son outillage sécu natif (IAM, Organizations, SCP, CloudTrail, GuardDuty…)

  • Pentest web et API (OWASP Top 10, exploitation de failles) et maîtrise des outils du pentester, idéalement augmentés par l'IA

  • Une forte culture de l'automatisation : Python, scripting, Go

Ce qui fera la différence :

  • Identité et accès : SAML, OIDC, SCIM, MFA, principe du moindre privilège

  • Sécurité des briques web modernes : CDN / WAF, DNS, plateformes de déploiement, gestion des secrets

  • Certifications (OSCP, OSWE, AWS Security Specialty, CISSP ou équivalent), bug bounty / CTF, gestion de flotte Mac (MDM), contributions open source, articles ou talks

Compétences interpersonnelles

  • Grande autonomie et ownership : tu avances sans attendre qu'on te trace le chemin

  • Pédagogue et bon(ne) communicant(e) : tu sais rendre la sécu accessible à des équipes non techniques, tout sauf un(e) expert(e) enfermé(e) dans sa grotte

  • Pragmatique : tu trouves le bon équilibre entre sécurité et rythme de livraison

  • Calme et méthodique sous pression

  • Curieux(se) et à l'aise avec un usage intensif de l'IA

Compétences linguistiques

  • Français courant - c'est notre langue de travail principale

  • Anglais niveau B2 minimum - c'est notre langue de travail secondaire, et il est évalué pendant le processus de recrutement. Tu échangeras notamment, surtout à l'écrit, avec nos partenaires cloud et fournisseurs

✅ Les avantages du poste

  • Création de poste : tu poses les fondations de la sécurité sur nos produits phares à fort trafic

  • Accès direct au CTO et vrai pouvoir de décision sur les choix sécu

  • Petite équipe, gros impact : binôme avec le DevOps, aucune lourdeur hiérarchique

  • Budget outillage dédié, et ton mot à dire sur le choix des outils à venir

  • Environnement pro-IA : accès aux principaux modèles cloud et à des modèles open source orientés sécurité pour décupler tes capacités de pentest - et on ne rechigne pas sur les coûts d'API

  • Un terrain de jeu rare : des produits B2C exposés, avec des enjeux concrets de paiement, de fraude et de scale

👣 Les défis du poste

  • Tu seras le/la premier(e) et seul(e) spécialiste sécu : à toi de poser le cadre et de faire grandir la culture sécurité

  • Un poste très hands-on : tu mets les mains dans le cambouis avant de pouvoir déléguer

  • Un périmètre très large (défense, offensif, culture, conformité) qui demande de prioriser en permanence

  • Des arbitrages réguliers avec des équipes qui livrent vite : la sécu doit accompagner la vitesse, pas la freiner

  • Une structure à taille humaine (une soixantaine de personnes) qui adresse des enjeux de grande entreprise

📋 Notre processus de recrutement

  • Entretien de découverte avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager, Noémie - 30 min

  • Étude de cas sécurité à préparer chez toi (environ 1 semaine), puis entretien technique avec notre CTO Grégoire et notre DevOps Aleksander : restitution de ton étude de cas, exercice pratique en live et échange sur ta vision du métier

  • Entretien culturel avec notre Head of HR & Finance, Matteo - 1h

  • Prise de références

ℹ️ A propos de DotWorld

Dotworld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio. Notre modèle est simple mais exigeant : nous concevons, lançons et scalons plusieurs produits SaaS en parallèle. Notre équipe, entièrement distribuée, évolue avec une culture forte : Test, Learn, Scale. Nous créons des outils concrets qui facilitent le quotidien de millions de personnes dans le monde entier. Aujourd'hui, notre activité est structurée autour de différents univers produits, allant d'outils RH à des solutions de gestion de contenus et de création design.

Notre approche

Nous construisons des SaaS robustes, intuitifs et techniquement solides. Une fois les bases maîtrisées, nous les déployons à l'international grâce à un travail poussé de traduction et de localisation. L'accélération se fait ensuite par une stratégie d'acquisition performante, pilotée par nos expert(e)s SEO et SEA.

Ce modèle fonctionne - et il fonctionne fort

Plus de 50 millions de visiteur(se)s par an 0 levée de fonds : une croissance 100 % autofinancée Rentables dès la première année De 1 à 50+ collaborateur(rice)s en 4 ans

Une équipe autonome, engagée et exigeante

Tout cela, nous le construisons en équipe. Notre force, ce sont des personnes autonomes, engagées, où chacun(e) a un vrai impact. 90 % de l'équipe travaille en remote, avec une culture fondée sur la confiance, la flexibilité et le respect des rythmes individuels. Nous cultivons un environnement bienveillant, stimulant et exigeant, où l'épanouissement individuel nourrit la réussite collective.

Une culture d'excellence

Chez Dotworld, nous visons des standards élevés : qualité, rigueur et efficacité au service de l'impact. Nous sommes orienté(e)s résultats : la performance et le dépassement de soi nous animent au quotidien. L'amélioration continue, l'innovation et la créativité sont au cœur de notre culture. Chaque produit est affiné de manière itérative jusqu'à atteindre la meilleure version possible. Nous intégrons les technologies les plus récentes de façon réfléchie, pour offrir des solutions modernes, performantes et conçues pour durer.

Et la suite ?

Nous recherchons des profils curieux, autonome, malins et enthousiastes - des personnes qui aiment faire, tester, construire, améliorer… tout en visant haut. 👉 Envie de nous rejoindre ? On a hâte d'échanger avec toi.

🌿 Environnement de travail

  • Des opportunités de développement professionnel : chez DotWorld, nous croyons que chaque employé(e) a le potentiel de se dépasser. Nous offrons des opportunités pour apprendre, grandir et influencer le futur de notre entreprise.

  • Une culture d'innovation : nous encourageons constamment nos équipes à penser en dehors des sentiers battus et à apporter de nouvelles idées.

  • Forte croissance de l'entreprise avec en conséquences des perspectives d'évolutions fortes dans les années à venir.

  • Tout est à créer : chaque idée, chaque initiative compte pour bâtir ensemble notre culture, nos projets et notre vision de demain.

👥 Diversité

DotWorld est une entreprise qui adhère pleinement au principe d'égalité des chances et d'accès à l'emploi pour tou(te)s. Nous croyons en un environnement de travail inclusif, où chacun(e) peut s'épanouir et contribuer à notre succès collectif, quelles que soient les identités ou origines de chacun(e). Nous remercions tou(te)s les candidat(e) pour leur intérêt et le temps qu'ils/elles investissent dans leur candidature.

⭐ Nos avantages RH

🗺️ Télétravail - Europe Travaille depuis n'importe quel pays d'Europe, en toute liberté et simplicité.

☕ Budget coworking Si tu préfères bosser hors de chez toi, on prend en charge ton espace de coworking à hauteur de 200 euros par mois pour plus de confort et de focus.

🌴 Vacances sur mesure Prends les congés dont tu as besoin pour te ressourcer. On te fait confiance pour gérer ton temps libre.

⌛ Horaires flexibles Organise ton emploi du temps comme tu le souhaites, parce que ton équilibre pro/perso est une priorité.

🌏 Télétravail - monde Change d'air et découvre le télétravail depuis un fuseau horaire différent pendant un mois.

🖥️ Budget équipement On te donne un budget pour t'équiper avec tout ce qu'il te faut : ordinateur portable, bureau, chaise, écran, casque… tout pour être au top !

🥳 2 séminaires par an Deux fois par an, on se retrouve en équipe pour des moments inspirants et fun : un au printemps et un à l'automne.

🌻 Nos valeurs

PERFORMANCE"Obsessed with Impact" Nous sommes une entreprise à haute performance. Nous ne confondons jamais le mouvement (être occupé) avec l'avancement (produire des résultats). Nous croyons que travailler avec des collègues excellents est le meilleur avantage social que nous puissions offrir. L'excellence n'est pas une option, c'est notre standard de base.

OWNERSHIP"Act like an Owner" Dans beaucoup d'entreprises, quand il y a un problème, les gens cherchent le coupable. Ici, nous cherchons la solution. "Ownership", c'est agir comme si c'était votre propre argent et votre propre entreprise. Il n'y a pas de "ce n'est pas mon job". Si tu vois un déchet par terre, tu le ramasses. Si tu vois un bug, tu t'assures que cela soit notifié.

INTEGRITY"We act with honesty, consistency, and professional courage." Dans une équipe, l'intégrité signifie que chacun est tenu responsable de sa performance, de son attitude et de l'impact de ses comportements sur le collectif. Nous nous soutenons, nous jouons collectif et nous prenons soin les uns des autres, tout en assumant que la confiance se construit par la fiabilité, la contribution et le respect des standards. L'intégrité, c'est dire les choses avec clarté et respect, même lorsque c'est inconfortable. C'est aligner ses paroles avec ses actes, accepter le feedback et comprendre que chacun doit mériter sa place sur le terrain par son engagement et son comportement. Nous croyons que la gentillesse sans exigence mène à la complaisance, et que l'exigence sans bienveillance mène à la tyrannie. L'intégrité est ce juste équilibre.

GROWTH"Always be Learning" Le monde change trop vite pour se reposer sur ses acquis. DotWorld est une école. Notre promesse est simple : tu travailleras dur, mais dans 2 ans, tu auras acquis 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle. Nous valorisons la courbe d'apprentissage (la pente) plus que l'expérience passée (le point de départ).

About the Role

In this role, you’ll partner with Compensation leadership, People & Culture, and business leaders to develop and deliver compensation solutions aligned with our business strategy and evolving market practices. You’ll lead key compensation programs and complex, organization-wide projects, bringing strong critical thinking, project management, and cross-functional partnership to the work. You’ll be part of a collaborative team of compensation professionals, each owning key business relationships and programs, with opportunities to mentor and develop more junior team members.

This individual serves as the primary compensation partner (end-to-end) for certain major departments and provides support for the Board's Compensation Committee and senior executives. This includes leading the design, administration, governance, and ongoing support of the Company's executive compensation programs and Compensation Committee meetings.

The position oversees the administration of the Company's equity programs, including grants, vesting, dividends, reporting, and analysis. The role partners closely with Payroll, Accounting, Legal, and P&C Systems to ensure accurate administration of stock-based awards, support audits and reporting requirements, maintain the Company's stock ownership guidelines, and certain schedules for the proxy.

While the ideal candidate brings experience across compensation consulting, executive compensation, and stock plan administration, we recognize these skillsets do not always develop together. We welcome candidates with deep expertise in two or more of these areas and are willing to tailor specific responsibilities based on the successful candidate's background and strengths.

Ideal Candidate Profile: We are looking for a self-starter with a passion for continuous learning and professional development. The ideal candidate will be a collaborative team player, eager to share innovative ideas and tackle new challenges. A proactive mindset is essential to advance our compensation programming. You will thrive in a supportive environment, able to work under guidance while navigating through ambiguity.

Day to day, you'll...

  • Serves as the compensation lead in support of the Compensation Committee. Develops analyses, recommendations, presentations, and supporting materials for Compensation Committee meetings and executive compensation decisions. (30%)
  • Expertly advises and consults with leadership (and the P&C team) on internal and external pay recommendations including those with job or team structure changes. Advises on job structure and creation as well as pricing individual jobs in the appropriate labor market. (20%)
  • Administers equity plans for US and global employees by working closely with legal, finance and payroll teams. This includes grants, vests, forfeitures/prorations. The position maintains our equity platform (through Fidelity PSW), executes transactions, and provides relevant reporting. (20%)
  • Leads the design and administration of compensation programs and strategies that attract, retain, and motivate associates and executives while supporting evolving business objectives. Evaluates programs and advocates for enhancements and evolution to improve their effectiveness. Includes the development of the communication and education strategy for both core and emerging compensation programs. (10%)
  • Assists and/or administers monthly, quarterly, and year-end processes, including maintaining blackout periods, schedules for proxy, and statutory reporting related to the company's equity plans and stock-based compensation. (10%)
  • Serves as a lead resource on special projects or areas of practice. (10%)

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related area or equivalent combination of education and work experience
  • Minimum of eight years of experience in compensation design and administration including program evaluation, analysis, implementation and business consulting/client interaction
  • An analytical mind with top-notch MS Office skills, including Word, PowerPoint, and especially Excel
  • Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Experience leading / coordinating highly impactful, enterprise-wide programs or projects
  • Experience presenting to executive-level stakeholders
  • Strong project management and finance skills, with ability to successfully manage multiple projects to established deadlines
  • Expert-level understanding of market surveys, benchmarking practices, and tools (BetterComp, Market Pay, etc.)
  • Excellent understanding of compensation job structures

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting executive compensation programs, Compensation Committee meetings, and Board-facing compensation materials
  • Experience with stock plan administration platforms such as Fidelity PSW
  • Compensation-related certifications such as Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) and Certified Equity Professional (CEP)
  • Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field
  • Expert analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and prioritization skills
  • Strong understanding of various types of incentives and incentive structures
  • Experience in Compensation & HR-related analytics
  • Extensive experience using HR-related systems such as Workday and NICE
  • Extensive experience in compensation administration in a large organization with diverse populations

Why work for us

At H&R Block, our purpose is simple: to provide help and inspire confidence in our clients and communities everywhere. For more than 70 years, we’ve led the tax industry and we continue to evolve through our Block Next strategy, blending human expertise with digital innovation.

That same commitment to care extends to our associates. When you join us, you become part of a High Performing, Connected Culture built on strong relationships, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful impact. We invest in your well-being through competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and support for life both in and outside of work.
Pay Range Information

The pay range for this position is listed below. Local minimum wage laws apply. This information is posted pursuant to local requirements to provide applicants with information about what they might be eligible to receive. Individual pay decisions will depend on job-related factors such as experience, education, skill, performance, and geographic location where work will be performed. Successful candidates may be able to participate in one or more incentive compensation or short-term incentive plans, which could generate additional earnings in accordance with the terms of each plan. Qualifying associates can enroll themselves and/or their eligible dependents in medical and prescription drug coverage; can participate in the H&R Block Retirement Savings Plan (401(k) Plan), the Employee Assistance Program, (virtual) fitness center programs, and the associate discount program; are automatically enrolled in Business Travel Accident Insurance; and receive Associate Tax Prep benefit.
Pay Range

$109,800.00 - $175,700.00/Yr.

Consultant – Data Engineering

Summary

We are seeking an experienced Consultant – Data Engineering professional with over eight years of industry tenure to lead critical data initiatives within our IT Services division. In this pivotal role, the successful candidate will architect, implement, and optimize robust data solutions leveraging the Microsoft ecosystem. The position demands a strategic thinker capable of bridging complex technical requirements with business objectives, ensuring seamless data flow, high-quality reporting, and efficient release management across the organization. This role is essential for driving data maturity and supporting advanced analytics through the effective utilization of Azure DevOps, Power BI, and ServiceNow platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable data pipelines and ETL processes using advanced T-SQL and SQL Server technologies.
  • Manage the full software development lifecycle for data solutions, utilizing Azure DevOps for version control, CI/CD pipelines, and release management.
  • Create interactive dashboards and comprehensive reports using Power BI to enable data-driven decision-making for stakeholders.
  • Implement and maintain automation workflows using Power Automate and SharePoint to streamline business processes.
  • Oversee data governance and master data management (MDM) initiatives using Microsoft MDS to ensure data integrity and consistency.
  • Administer and enhance ServiceNow ITSM reporting modules to improve service delivery and operational visibility.
  • Apply ITIL best practices to manage IT service improvements, incident resolution, and change management protocols.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate Git-based version control strategies into development workflows.

Requirements

Requirements:
  • Minimum of 8 years of professional experience in data engineering, IT services, or a related technical domain.
  • Proven expertise in Azure DevOps, including experience with Git repositories, build pipelines, and deployment strategies.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL Server and T-SQL for complex query writing, optimization, and data manipulation.
  • Strong capability in developing business intelligence solutions using Power BI and integrating them with enterprise data sources.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Automate and SharePoint for workflow automation and content management.
  • Solid understanding of Release Management principles and tools to ensure smooth software deployments.
  • Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and experience in applying these standards to IT service management.
  • Competence in utilizing Microsoft MDS for master data management and governance.
  • Experience with ServiceNow ITSM, specifically in configuring and analyzing reporting features.

Overview

Alliance Laundry Systems Distribution is a full-service commercial and industrial laundry equipment partner with over 110 years of industry experience. We offer comprehensive support services including installation, factory-trained service, genuine parts replacement, site selection, financing, and store design. The Sales Manager is responsible for growing and maintaining sales of commercial laundry products within our Direct Distribution channel. raw.description:
Wir haben unsere Hosting-Plattform von Grund auf neu gedacht. Echtes Re-Engineering: Weg von abstrakter Infrastruktur, hin zu Kubernetes-nativen Architekturen und Bare Metal Deployments. Als Tech Lead gibst du deinem Team die technische Richtung - nah am Betrieb und im engen Zusammenspiel mit Product Owner und Architektur.

Für alle Neugierigen, unser Stack:

Linux · Namespaces · cgroups · ZFS · BGP · CRI-O · CNI · crun · Kubernetes · Golang · REST · gRPC · OpenAPI · Netbox · IaC · Helm · Operator SDK · GitLab

Du solltest dich unbedingt bewerben, wenn:

  • du nicht nur unsere Plattform spürbar nach vorn bringen möchtest, sondern das Team als Ganzes, indem du technische Komplexität für Kolleg*innen auf jedem Level greifbar machst und sie fachlich weiterentwickelst

  • du Störungen und Kundenprobleme nicht als lästige Unterbrechung siehst, sondern als beste Quelle für gute Architekturentscheidungen

  • du systemische Auswirkungen von Veränderungen auch auf den untersten Ebenen erkennst und bei anderen Verständnis hierfür schaffst

  • du fundierte technische Entscheidungen mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch und Pragmatismus triffst und gern gemeinsam mit dem PO Prioritäten in machbare Technik übersetzt

Das bieten wir dir

Tiefgang statt Standard

Wir arbeiten mit zukunftsweisenden Technologien und bauen Systeme, wenn nötig, lieber selbst, statt auf Fertiglösungen zu setzen. Das bringt Herausforderungen und ein technisches Niveau, das nicht alltäglich ist und dich fachlich weiterbringt.

Expertise, die ihresgleichen sucht

Du diskutierst auf fachlich höchstem Niveau, teilst dein Wissen und lernst gemeinsam mit anderen Experten. Unsere Expertise geben wir nicht nur intern , sondern auch gerne auf Konferenzen, Camps und in der Tech-Community weiter und gestalten so die Zukunft der Branche mit.

Wir lieben Tech

Bei uns triffst du auf Menschen, die Tech genauso feiern wie du. Diese Leidenschaft leben wir im Alltag – und darüber hinaus. Ob Open-Source-Engagement, Community-Arbeit oder der Support von Tech-Events: Wir sind aktiv dabei und bringen uns ein.

Technologische Verantwortung

Deine Expertise zählt. Du prägst Entscheidungen und bleibst nicht beim Offensichtlichen stehen. Du bekommst den Raum, deine Ideen umzusetzen, Systeme mitzugestalten und Verantwortung zu übernehmen – auf Augenhöhe und mit Rückhalt.

Technik trifft Menschlichkeit

Bei uns findest du die coolsten Kolleg*innen, jede Menge Humor und echten Team-Spirit. Zusammenarbeit ist für uns ein fester Teil des Daily Business. Auch nach Feierabend gibt es jede Menge Möglichkeiten, ob Fußball, Padel oder D&D - wer Lust hat, ist dabei.

Rundum-sorglos-Setup

Bei uns soll´s dir richtig gut gehen. Freie Hardwarewahl? Check. Standardpaket an Benefits? Klar. Vitamine, Koffein & H2O? Safe. Und obendrauf: Unbefristeter Vertrag, Gleitzeit, 30 Urlaubstage, bAV , Schulungsangebote und ein faires Gehalt.

Requirements

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn:

  • du eine klassische Teamlead-Rolle mit direkter Personalverantwortung suchst

  • du nicht weißt, wie Kubernetes auf Bare Metal läuft und was passiert, wenn es das nicht tut

  • du dich eher darin siehst, Container zu orchestrieren und Cluster zu managen, als dich sicher auf Kernel-, Storage- und Netzwerkebene zu bewegen

  • es dir schwerfällt, fachliches Feedback offen zu geben und begründet zu widersprechen, wenn etwas im Betrieb nicht trägt

At Webdoctor, we’re making world-class healthcare accessible to patients across Ireland - right from their phone, tablet, or computer. Safe, confidential, and convenient, our platform connects patients with top-tier care for a wide range of medical needs.

Want to build/deliver the future of digital health? We’re hiring! Join our team today.

Why Join Webdoctor?

  • 100% remote working
  • Flexible scheduling around your commitments
  • Competitive remuneration
  • Fully funded medical indemnity cover
  • Dedicated administrative support
  • Sustainable consultation volumes
  • Opportunity to contribute to Ireland's fastest-growing digital health sector

What is the role?

We are recruiting experienced Primary Care GPs with a special interest in Dermatology to support patients with a wide range of skin conditions through our platform. If you're a registered General Practitioner (IMC Specialist Register preferred) with dermatology training and a passion for accessible healthcare, we'd love to hear from you!

Essential Qualifications & Experience100% Remote Working

  • Postgraduate Certificate, Diploma, or MSc in Dermatology
  • Completion of ICGP dermatology modules or equivalent structured CPD
  • Formal GP with Special Interest (GPwSI) accreditation, or working towards this
  • Minimum of 1 year focused dermatology experience in general practice or community dermatology settings

100% Remote Working

This role is fully remote - work from wherever suits you best, with no commute, no clinic overheads, and none of the friction of a traditional practice. All you need is a quiet space, a reliable internet connection, and a passion for patient care. Set your own environment, reclaim the hours you'd otherwise spend travelling, and join a growing digital-first practice at the forefront of Irish telehealth.

Hours That Suit You

We offer flexible working sessions across a 7-day service, with a minimum commitment of 12 hours per week, plus one additional weekend day per month. Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 8am–10pm, and 10am–6pm on weekends; giving you the flexibility to balance work with personal commitments.

  • Midweek Shifts: 8am–10pm
  • Weekend shifts: 10am–6pm

Market Leading Rates

We offer highly competitive rates, structured around a sustainable pace of approximately four consultations per hour, alongside fully funded medical indemnity cover.

Focus on patient care, not paperwork

Tired of the paperwork after your day is complete? Come work with us and focus on patient care — we provide support for follow-up reports and results.

Clinical Independence

Compensation is completely independent of treatment outcomes or prescription volume - allowing you to focus strictly on best-practice patient care.

Who We Are

Webdoctor is Ireland’s leading online GP service, delivering fast, affordable, and fully confidential healthcare from anywhere across the country. Founded and led by Irish medical professionals, we empower patients to access world-class virtual consultations, prescriptions, and health services seamlessly from any device.

Data Privacy & Security: This role involves handling sensitive personal health information with strict adherence to confidentiality, integrity, and asset security standards.
