raw.description:
The Growth Marketing Consultant will partner with marketing and business development leaders across M3's subsidiaries to identify growth opportunities, develop effective B2B outreach strategies, and implement campaigns that generate measurable business results.

This position combines B2B marketing strategy, persona-drive outbound targeting, multi-channel sequencing, and some hands-on campaign execution. The ideal candidate has experience developing targeted growth programs, identifying key decision-makers within prospective client organizations, and translating market insights into actionable outbound strategies that generate qualified sales opportunities.

We are looking for someone who understands how to reach the right decision-makers, develop compelling messaging, and build repeatable marketing programs that convert prospective clients into qualified commercial opportunities.

Experience developing outbound marketing and growth strategies for B2B services is particularly relevant, especially healthcare services, professional services, staffing and recruitment, research, or other relationship-driven industries.

This is not primarily a paid advertising or traditional digital marketing role. Success requires experience with B2B demand generation, outbound marketing, and sales-aligned growth strategies.

Key Responsibilities

B2B Growth Strategy & Consulting

  • Partner with marketing and business development leaders across M3’s subsidiaries to identify growth opportunities and build a targeted outbound strategy for each business.

  • Build and own a full digital outreach path for each subsidiary, from identifying decision makers for each product to qualified handoff to the BD team.

  • Define handoff criteria, follow-up cadence, and target account lists with each subsidiary’s BD and marketing leads, and gather their feedback on message performance.

  • Develop a repeatable outbound framework that can be adapted across business units, services, and buyer audiences.

Audience Development

  • Define buyer personas and target account segments for each business’s sales activity.

  • Identify the budget owners, decision makers, and influencers at target organizations, and grow contact lists from verified sources and research.

  • Develop personalized messaging that speaks to the priorities of each specific audience, tailored by subsidiary.

  • Convert M3’s proprietary data assets, such as its physician network and health-system relationships, into a repeatable pipeline of qualified conversations through referrals and warm introductions.

Outbound Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Run multi-channel outbound sequences across email, LinkedIn, and other social and digital channels, with messaging tailored to each subsidiary.

  • Design outreach sequences, messaging frameworks, and follow-up strategies that build familiarity before asking for time and generate qualified sales conversations.

  • Test and refine messaging to improve reply rates, positive-reply rates, and pipeline contribution.

Marketing Technology & AI

  • Operate each designated business unit’s outreach technology stack (sequencing, Sales Navigator), integrate it with their CRMs, and recommend new or more advanced tools.

  • Use AI-assisted research and personalization to build account and contact intelligence and personalize at scale, with human review and M3 brand standards applied before anything sends.

  • Coordinate with email deliverability specialists on authentication, IP warming, sender reputation, inbox placement testing, list hygiene, and compliance with Google, Yahoo, and Microsoft sender requirements.

Performance & Business Impact

  • Report weekly on placement, reply and positive-reply rates, and pipeline sourced by subsidiary and persona.

  • Use the data to retire what doesn’t work and scale what does, and translate results into clear recommendations for business leaders.

  • Identify successful outreach strategies that can be replicated across M3’s subsidiaries.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 7+ years in B2B digital outreach, demand generation, or sales development, including at least 3 years owning persona-based marketing for outbound revenue generation.

  • Demonstrated success reaching senior decision makers at complex B2B organizations.

  • Hands-on experience with sequencing platforms (e.g., Outreach, Apollo, HubSpot Sequences), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, contact enrichment and verification tools, and CRM integration.

  • Experience supporting or consulting for multiple business units, clients, or brands with distinct customers.

  • Ability to identify and verify the true buyer within a target organization (budget owner, decision maker, and influencers), distinguish them from adjacent or easier-to-reach contacts, and maintain a disciplined outreach cadence toward that person without defaulting to volume.

  • Strong writing skills: short, specific, and adaptable by persona and subsidiary brand.

  • Ability to use AI tools for research, personalization, and testing, with sound judgment about accuracy, brand, and disclosure.

  • Working knowledge of CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR/UK GDPR, TCPA, and LinkedIn terms of service as they apply to outbound outreach.

  • Ability to independently manage several concurrent programs, prioritize across businesses, and report clearly to sales and marketing leaders.

  • Analytical fluency with campaign, deliverability, and CRM data; comfortable building simple dashboards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience reaching senior decision makers in healthcare or health systems, or experience selling recruitment, staffing, or physician placement services.

  • Understanding of how health systems, medical groups, and staffing firms recruit physicians, and who owns those decisions.

  • Working knowledge of email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI), domain and IP warming, reputation monitoring, and inbox placement testing, and of how Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Proofpoint, Mimecast, and similar filters treat outbound mail.

  • Hands-on experience with deliverability monitoring tools.

  • Certifications in email deliverability, sequencing platforms, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

*M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization

About M3: A Japanese global leader in the provision of ground-breaking and innovative technological and research solutions to the healthcare industry. The M3 Group operates in the US, Asia, and Europe with over 5.8 million physician members globally via its physician websites which include mdlinx.com, m3.com, research.m3.com, Doctors.net.uk, medigate.net, and medlive.cn. M3 Inc. is a publicly traded company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (jp:2413, NIKKEI 225) with subsidiaries in major markets including the US, UK, Japan, South Korea, and China, and in 2020 was ranked in Forbes’ Global 2000 list. The M3 Group provides services to healthcare and the life science industry. In addition to market research, these services include medical education, ethical drug promotion, clinical development, job recruitment, and clinic appointment services. M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.

We are seeking a Growth Marketing Consultant – B2B Strategy to help our businesses develop scalable, targeted marketing strategies that drive qualified sales conversations, client acquisition, and commercial growth.

raw.excerpt: MissionThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
raw.description:
Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

Compensation: The United States base salary range for this full-time position is $140,000-$200,000 + bonus + equity depending on experience

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

raw.description:
Staff Full-Stack Engineer
US-Based | Remote | Full-Time | Engineering Team

About Azira

Azira is on a mission to reinvent how brands use data to make smarter decisions, from where to open their next location to how they connect with customers in the real world. We blend marketing, location analytics, and strategy into a single platform, helping leading brands take action with confidence. We move fast, think boldly, and care deeply about building things that matter.

Why This Role Matters

We’re bringing our products and technology together under Azira One. As Staff Full-Stack Engineer, you’ll provide hands-on technical leadership to make that platform scalable, intuitive, and connected. You’ll report to our Technical Manager, Engineering. Your work will span the whole stack, from front-end architecture to APIs, services, data, and cloud systems, turning complex customer and business needs into thoughtful solutions. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and SRE. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Your influence will come from technical judgment, hands-on execution, and making the entire engineering organization more effective.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build high-quality product experiences across the front end and back end, writing production code and staying involved from design through deployment and iteration.
  • Lead the technical delivery of complex, cross-functional initiatives that span multiple products, services, and engineering teams.
  • Shape the architecture and integration of the Azira One platform, simplifying fragmented systems and reducing unnecessary complexity.
  • Partner with Product and Design to turn customer and business needs into scalable solutions, including intuitive, responsive, and accessible experiences for complex data and analytics products.
  • Design and evolve APIs, services, and data flows that are reliable, secure, and easy to maintain.
  • Help develop and improve our practical engineering standards for architecture, code quality, testing, documentation, and delivery.
  • Improve performance, reliability, observability, and security, working with our SRE team to make sure new capabilities are ready for production.
  • Lead technical discovery, break large and ambiguous initiatives into clear plans, and surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early.
  • Raise the bar through thoughtful code and architecture reviews, and mentor engineers as they grow into broader technical leadership.
  • Champion responsible AI adoption, both in how we build software and in the AI-driven capabilities we bring to our products.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams across the US, India, and France.

What You’ll Bring

Your profile

  • You’re a builder and a systems thinker. You enjoy solving difficult technical problems, and you care just as much about whether the solution is useful, intuitive, and right for the business.
  • You’re fluent across the stack. You move comfortably from user experience and front-end architecture to APIs, services, data, and cloud infrastructure.
  • You bring structure to ambiguity. You take large, undefined problems and turn them into clear, achievable plans.
  • You lead without taking over. You help teams reach stronger decisions, raise the quality of the work around you, and stay personally accountable for execution.
  • You’re a pragmatist. You can set long-term architectural direction while making practical decisions that help the team deliver today, and you know when to simplify.
  • You’re a clear communicator. You explain complex technical decisions and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • You have strong product instincts. You appreciate usability, design quality, and a great customer experience.
  • You’re AI-forward. You use AI tools to improve how you build and look for ways AI can make our products better.
  • You care about outcomes. You don’t measure success by lines of code or the complexity of the architecture. You measure it by whether the product works, scales, and creates real value for customers and the business.

Your experience

  • Significant experience building and operating modern, customer-facing software products at a Staff, Lead, Principal, or equivalent senior IC level.
  • Deep expertise across front-end and back-end engineering, including modern JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks and component-based architecture.
  • Experience designing APIs, services, and distributed systems, with a strong understanding of relational and non-relational data models, application security, and system integration.
  • Experience building cloud-based applications on AWS or another major public cloud.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing, CI/CD, and production observability, plus a strong grasp of performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • A track record of leading technically complex initiatives across multiple teams and influencing without formal authority.
  • Ability to navigate existing systems, improve legacy code thoughtfully, and make sound calls on when to rebuild versus evolve.
  • Experience working effectively in a distributed, global environment.

Not a perfect match on paper? If you’ve built and shipped great software and you’re excited about this work, throw your hat in the ring. We care more about what you can do than about checking every box.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Base salary of $160,000-180,000, plus eligibility for an annual performance bonus. Final compensation is based on experience and is negotiable.
  • Health, dental, and vision benefits, plus flexible PTO
  • Fully remote work environment (US-based)
  • Big opportunity, small ego, high impact
  • A mission you can feel good about, and a team that makes the work fun

How to Apply

Sound like a fit? Apply here or send us your resume and an optional short note/cover letter on why this role feels right for you.

At Azira, we don’t hire for the box. We hire for the spark.

We’re building boldly. Join us.

Azira is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

raw.description:
Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. We work hard to create the easiest and safest banking* experience possible to simplify entrepreneurs' and business owners’ financial lives.The challenge is to do so while ensuring we protect Mercury, customers and the broader financial ecosystem from bad actors and harmful, illegal or unauthorized activities.

Our AML Investigations team is crucial in this mission and is responsible for detecting suspicious activity, conducting thorough investigations, and shutting down bad actors. This team is growing and we’re looking to hire an additional AML Risk Investigator to help us with Bank Partner Requests for Information, Transaction Monitoring, Financial Crime Investigations, Case Management and drafting Unusual Activity Reports. As a member of our Investigations team, you’ll help handle our transaction monitoring queues while balancing an eagle eye for risk with excellent user experience. To begin with, you’ll work to help make sure we have smart, risk-based monitoring in place and help build out our case management technology and processes.

You’ll need to learn how a really wide range of businesses work and bring your knowledge to bear on our processes and product. Some of this work is repetitive and requires close attention to detail, so we need someone who loves working fraud and anti-money laundering transaction queues and managing a variety of complex investigations.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

As part of the journey, we would expect you to:

  • Provide input as we implement new transaction monitoring rules and tune existing ones
  • Review AML, and other financial crime alerts in our transaction monitoring queue and take action as needed
  • Contact our users for information on their account usage and transactions
  • Work with our partners and internal team members to review and assess information received from users
  • Investigate and respond to Requests for Information (RFIs) from our Partner Banks, delivering clear, well-supported AML reviews on customer’s account activity
  • Decision user accounts as needed, including locking or closing accounts
  • Develop an understanding of expected activity for each type of user we work with
  • Document investigative findings and escalate unusual or potentially suspicious activity to our Partners for SAR consideration
  • Develop an unfailing eye for potential fraud or money laundering
  • Investigate tools that would make your job easier
  • Write clear documentation on current processes and help train future teammates

Some things that might make you successful in a role like this:

  • Have experience in identifying money laundering, detecting fraud, or other financial crimes related behavior in banking, fintech, or other financial services through vendor AND in-house developed transaction monitoring rules
  • Be fluent in the language of bank transactions, including ACH, check, debit card, credit card, and wire transfers, both domestic and international
  • Understand the business banking landscape and have familiarity with international activity and ownership
  • Exercise empathy and understanding when communicating with users
  • Communicate complicated concepts with efficiency and clarity, both in speech and writing
  • Manage relationships with external parties with confidence and kindness
  • Work with efficiency and focus
  • Understand how to keep an organized and clean inbox
  • Love problem solving and making teams, product, and processes more efficient
  • Derive joy from customer joy
  • Enjoy thinking about how to automate as much of your job as possible
  • Be curious about the US banking system, startups, and ecommerce companies

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

Total Rewards
The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.

Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following:

US employees in New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area:
$121,700—$152,100 USD
US employees outside of New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area:
$109,500—$136,900 USD

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

AS AN AWS MANAGER / SR. MANAGER, YOU WILL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO EXECUTE THE FOLLOWING:

Managerial Roles & Responsibilities

  • Act as the AWS subject matter expert, providing leadership and guidance to internal teams
  • Coach, mentor, and develop junior AWS team members while setting clear goals and expectations
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, 1-on-1 meetings, and personal development planning
  • Manage project resource staffing, utilization, and capacity planning while actively contributing to talent acquisition
  • Drive hiring strategies to support organizational growth
  • Build and lead high-performing teams, fostering a collaborative and motivated work culture
  • Establish and oversee OKRs, ensuring alignment with business objectives
  • Collaborate with business leaders to prioritize initiatives and drive impactful outcomes
  • Represent the company and team in talent acquisition efforts, analyzing cultural fit and promoting an engaging and inclusive workplace
  • Balance people management responsibilities with individual contributions as an AWS Solution/Technical Architect

Technical Roles & Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate deep expertise in AWS infrastructure, security, and compliance, ensuring alignment with best practices and regulatory requirements
  • Architect, implement, and optimize AWS solutions, focusing on scalability, cost-efficiency, and resilience
  • Oversee cloud governance, automation, and DevOps best practices to enhance operational efficiency
  • Lead complex AWS projects, integrating services like Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex, AWS SageMaker, Amazon Q, and Amazon Bedrock
  • Drive innovation in Cloud Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) by leveraging AWS and third-party platforms (Genesys, Twilio, Avaya, NICE CX, TalkDesk, Five9, RingCentral)
  • Ensure seamless integration between Amazon Connect and Salesforce Service Cloud (SCV BYOA, SCV Bundle)
  • Identify and address technical challenges, proactively resolving roadblocks for teams
  • Advocate for AWS best practices and provide technical leadership in solution design

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of experience leading and managing technical teams
  • For Sr Manager roles, experience managing Manager(s) is an added advantage
  • AWS Solution Architect Associate Certification
  • Strong expertise in AWS cloud architecture, security, compliance, and automation
  • Proven track record of leading technical teams while driving innovation and efficiency
  • Experience in the Contact Center domain, particularly with Amazon Connect
  • Knowledge of AI/ML-driven solutions and AWS services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, and Amazon Q
  • Experience integrating Amazon Connect with Salesforce Service Cloud models (SCV BYOA, SCV Bundle) is a plus
  • Background in Cloud Contact Center solutions such as Genesys, Twilio, Avaya, NICE CX, TalkDesk, Five9, or RingCentral is preferred

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

  • Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
  • Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
  • Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
  • Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
  • Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

Licensed Mental Health Therapist — Bilingual English/Spanish Strongly Preferred

📍 Remote | Maryland License Required | Part-Time or Full-Time | 💰 Monthly Bonus Potential

💜 Your Language Can Change the Way a Family Experiences Care.

Many of the families we serve want therapy in Spanish. We need clinicians who can meet them there.

At Backpack Healthcare, we're making behavioral healthcare more accessible for children, teens, young adults, and their families. Our care is delivered virtually, covered by most insurance, and grounded in the belief that families deserve care that reflects who they are, how they communicate, and what they value.

As a clinician-led, minority-owned organization, we're growing — and we're looking for therapists who understand that culturally responsive care isn't a bonus feature. It's essential.

If you speak English and Spanish and want your language skills to make a real difference in the lives of families, we want to meet you.

🎒 The Role

Choose the schedule that works best for you — part-time or full-time — while building a meaningful caseload of 15–36 sessions per week.

You'll provide individual, family, and group therapy through telehealth, with the flexibility to create a schedule that works for your life.

Most clinicians work weekday afternoons and evenings, typically 2–9 PM. Weekend availability is a plus.

You'll:

  • 🧠 Conduct clinical intakes and assessments
  • 📝 Develop individualized, trauma-informed treatment plans
  • 💻 Provide individual, family, and group therapy via telehealth
  • 🤝 Collaborate with therapists, PMHNPs, psychiatrists, and other members of our interdisciplinary team
  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Support parents and caregivers through education and care coordination
  • 📋 Maintain timely and accurate documentation in our EHR
  • 🌎 Provide culturally responsive care that considers each family's language, culture, and unique needs

💰 Compensation + Monthly Bonus Potential

We believe great clinicians deserve to be fairly compensated and recognized for the work they do.

  • 💵 $45–$65 per billable hour, based on license level
  • 🎯 Monthly bonus potential for eligible clinicians based on applicable productivity and performance criteria
  • 🏥 Medical, dental, and vision for eligible full-time employees
  • 💵 401(k) with 3% company match
  • 🌴 Paid time off
  • 📚 $300 annual CEU reimbursement
  • 🎓 Free clinical supervision for eligible LMSW/LPC roles
  • ❤️ $25,000 company-paid life insurance
  • 🌱 Employee Assistance Program
  • 🚀 Clinical leadership opportunities, including our Residency & Fellowship Program

⭐ Earn More While Making an Impact

Eligible clinicians have the opportunity to earn an additional monthly performance-based bonus on top of their regular billable compensation.

Bonus eligibility is based on applicable productivity and performance expectations, giving you another opportunity to increase your earnings while being recognized for consistently providing high-quality care.

🔎 What We're Looking For

We're looking for clinicians who bring strong clinical skills, cultural humility, and a genuine commitment to children and families.

Required:

  • Active Maryland license: LGPC, LCPC, LMSW, LMFT, or LCSW-C
  • Experience working with children, adolescents, and families
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Strong clinical judgment, communication, and documentation skills
  • Commitment to trauma-informed and culturally responsive practice

Strongly Preferred:

Bilingual English/Spanish clinicians

This isn't simply a "nice-to-have." We're intentionally growing our ability to provide high-quality care in Spanish and want clinicians who can help families feel understood from the very first conversation.

💜 Why Backpack Healthcare?

Since 2020, we've served 12,000+ children and families through accessible behavioral healthcare.

78% of families report that their child is doing better after three months of care.

We're proud of that number — but we know the numbers only tell part of the story.

Behind every outcome is a clinician who listened. A parent who felt supported. A child who finally felt understood.

That's the work we're building around.

At Backpack, you won't just be another provider on a roster. You'll be part of a growing clinical community with opportunities to learn, collaborate, mentor, and grow into leadership.

🎒 When clinicians thrive, kids thrive.

That's not a tagline. It's how we build.

Ready to Make Care More Accessible?

If you're a Maryland-licensed therapist who wants flexibility, competitive compensation, monthly bonus potential, professional growth, and the opportunity to provide care in both English and Spanish, we'd love to hear from you.

Backpack Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity in age, background, identity, experience, ability, and perspective — and we're committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve.

raw.description:
We’re thrilled you’re interested in joining our clinical team! While we don’t have immediate openings in your specific state just yet, we are growing quickly and constantly opening new opportunities for Part-Time therapists. Please share your details below, we’d love to have your information on hand so we can reach out the moment a role opens up in your area.

Two Chairs is building a new kind of mental health system based on the idea that the status quo isn’t good enough. Industry-best clinician experiences, better client outcomes, groundbreaking innovation, and access to the highest quality care are how we’ll raise the bar for the entire industry. With that, we're excited and honored to have been recognized as a 2025 Great Place to Work and 2025 Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare.

One of our company values is "Embrace Differences" and diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are the principles guiding how we build our business and teams. We encourage interested candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't think they meet some expectations of the role.

About the Part-Time Role

  • Deliver remote, evidence-based therapy to adult clients (18+), practicing modalities like CBT, DBT, ACT, MBCT, TLDP, IPT, EFT, and MI.
  • Maintain a caseload of 7-20 attended ongoing therapy and consult sessions per week
  • Use data to drive effective treatment and adjust your approach based on client progress
  • Collaborate with other mental health providers as needed and refer clients when appropriate
  • Maintain progress notes and documentation in compliance with HIPAA and state regulations

Requirements

  • License: Active license as an LCSW, LMFT, LPC, LMHC, or Licensed Psychologist (PhD or PsyD) in the state where you will be practicing.
  • Cross-licensure: Willing and motivated to become licensed in other states. We will cover the cost.
  • Caseload: Available for 8-24 hours per week, with 85% of time in client sessions. Sessions will include ongoing therapy and new client consults appointments.
  • Experience: 2+ years of clinical experience with adults (18+), at least six months of teletherapy experience, and proficient with clinical assessments (e.g., PHQ-9) for tracking client progress
  • Tech: At least six months of teletherapy experience and experience with electronic health record (EHR) systems
  • Schedule: Select 7-10 session hours between 8am and 9pm PST, Monday through Friday. Available during regular business hours for a minimum of 1 hour per week during the first 6 weeks for training, followed by 30 minutes per month for ongoing support.
  • Documentation: All documentation to be completed, signed, and locked in EMR within 48 hours of client contact. Option to use an AI-assist tool.

At Blueprint, we believe in the power of possibility and are passionate about bringing it to life. Whether you join our bustling product division, our multifaceted services team or you want to grow your career in human resources, your ability to make an impact is amplified when you join one of our teams. Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Sr. Staff Integration Engineer (Security Platform and Data Pipelines) to join our team. This is a remote based in India role, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Technical Implementation and Integration department. You will be responsible for connecting and onboarding diverse cybersecurity data sources, mapping and normalizing security data to power exposure and threat management use cases, and customizing workflows to deliver measurable outcomes. This role requires technical depth, comfort with complex datasets, and the ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Quickly get up-to-speed on Zscaler’s SecOps platform, utilizing Python and APIs to configure, customize, and automate data transformations and workflows
  • Partner with cybersecurity subject matter experts (SMEs) to onboard new data pipelines and map diverse IT and security sources to fulfill specific customer use cases
  • Proactively troubleshoot pipeline health and audit customer data across environments to identify quality issues, flag security gaps, and define clear remediation steps
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Services teams to translate customer needs into actionable implementation and integration plans
  • Communicate technical findings clearly to stakeholders and feed valuable, field-based insights back to Engineering to drive continuous product improvements

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • Hands-on experience managing the complete data pipeline lifecycle, including ingestion, mapping, deduplication, normalization, merging, and unification
  • Specialized experience working with data pipelines within cybersecurity platforms (e.g., SIEM, Unified Vulnerability Management) alongside a broad understanding of vulnerability, exposure, and threat management
  • Proven ability to integrate diverse security tools and data sources, such as EDR, vulnerability scanners, CNAPP/CSPM, ticketing systems/CMDB, identity providers, and cloud logs
  • Strong proficiency in data modeling, SQL, and Python to handle data parsing, execute transformations, interact with APIs, and troubleshoot complex data issues from end to end

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience designing or optimizing security data pipelines that feed AI-driven anomaly detection models or automated threat-hunting systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and a high level of attention to detail

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

We're hiring a Data Scientist focused on natural language processing to build models that turn unstructured text into product features and business insight. You'll own problems end-to-end — framing, data, modeling, evaluation, and shipping — and work closely with engineering and product to put your work in front of users.

What you'll do

  • Design and train NLP models for tasks like classification, entity extraction, retrieval, summarization, and semantic search

  • Build robust evaluation harnesses — offline metrics, human-in-the-loop review, and online A/B tests
  • Partner with ML engineers to productionize models (latency, cost, monitoring, drift detection)

  • Hands-on experience fine-tuning transformer models (LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning, preference optimization) and/or building production RAG systems
  • Solid grounding in evaluation: knows the difference between BLEU/ROUGE/BERTScore/LLM-as-judge and when each is misleading

Our client, a fast-growing fintech company, is hiring their first dedicated Payroll Manager. This is a foundational, individual-contributor role: you take full ownership of payroll company-wide, standardize the process, and build the function as the company scales into new countries. You report to the Head of Finance and work daily with Legal, HR, and Finance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end payroll processing for the Latvia entity, plus oversight of outsourced payroll in the UK and Poland
  • Own the B2B/contractor payment cycle globally, including crypto (USDT) settlement, as a distinct process from employee payroll
  • Ensure payroll compliance with Latvian labor law, tax withholding, and social security obligations
  • Review and quality-check payroll calculations prepared by the outsourced UK and Poland providers
  • Partner with Legal and HR on employment terms, cross-border considerations, and worker classification (employee vs. B2B contractor)
  • Partner with Finance on payroll cost accounting, accruals, and reconciliation to the general ledger
  • Own the payroll system(s)/HRIS: selection, implementation, and administration
  • Administer benefits tied to payroll (medical insurance, L&D budget, etc.)
  • Own payroll data privacy and security in line with GDPR
  • Ensure accurate, on-time payroll runs every cycle, no exceptions

What We Expect

Must-have:

  • Proven payroll management experience, ideally across more than one country
  • Experience with both direct employee payroll and B2B/contractor payment structures
  • Comfortable managing and reviewing the work of outsourced payroll providers
  • Fluent in English and Latvian
  • High ownership and autonomy: this is an individual-contributor role from day one
  • Located in ﻿Latvia

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in fintech, crypto, or another fast-growing company
  • Experience with UK and/or Polish payroll
  • Russian language
  • Familiarity with payroll/EOR platforms (e.g., Deel, Remote, Rippling)

What's in it for you:

  • A founding opportunity: build the payroll function from the ground up and own it end-to-end, across jurisdictions, as the company scales
  • Salary: €2,500 gross/month, performance-based bonus
  • Medical insurance, L&D budget, English classes, regular team-building activities
  • A fast-paced, self-funded fintech company with no investor-driven pressure

Interview Process:

1. Teamence - Initial screening
2. HR screen (30–40 min): career narrative, communication style, autonomy fit
3. Hiring manager interview (60–90 min): payroll technical depth, past ownership examples, chemistry

raw.description:
JOB OBJECTIVE: Work in conjunction with Product Development & Adoption (PDA), R&D, and Product Marketing Teams to develop, plan, communicate, execute, and lead worldwide marketing strategies (short and long-term) and tactics for the market segments using clearly defined goals, objectives, critical success factors, timelines, budgets, and metrics. Responsible for creating and managing the programs and communications about our products and services to internal and external customers in assigned market segment area(s). Translate and coordinate Product Management and Product Marketing goals and strategies into successful global market segment marketing plans and activities that achieve business objectives. Work closely with branch marketing and marketing services to ensure successful adoption and execution of global marketing plans and sales activities. Critically, this person must be able to perform the below duties showing credibility and industry knowledge to the customers and to internal stakeholders.

CORE DUTIES:

Duty 1: Develop Go-to-Market Strategies for the Pharmaceutical Market Segment
Independently develop comprehensive go-to-market strategies for the pharmaceutical industry segment. This requires deep knowledge of how pharmaceutical companies operate, make purchasing decisions, and allocate budget. The strategy must address:
• Growth projections and realistic revenue targets for the segment.
• Target company identification (which pharmaceutical companies and which therapeutic areas represent the best growth opportunities).
• Product area prioritization (e.g., small molecules, biologics, cell and gene therapy, etc.).
• Value positioning and competitive differentiation for each product area.
• Tactical approaches and marketing initiatives aligned with pharma customer needs.

Duty 2: Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration and Field Engagement
Lead close collaboration with internal product management groups (PDA for new products, CES for established products), R&D, Marketing Services, SCMT, and Sales to execute marketing initiatives and campaigns. This duty includes two distinct directions:

Direction 1 – Marketing Execution:

  • Take an active role in generating customer-facing materials and promotional campaigns.
    • Drive marketing initiatives that support company focus areas.
    • Lead the development of campaigns, collateral, and promotional programs in partnership with internal stakeholders.

    Direction 2 – Market Intelligence:
    • Attend industry conferences and conduct customer visits to identify emerging trends and unmet needs.
    • Monitor pharmaceutical industry activity, particularly new biotech acquisitions and market shifts.
    • Gather field insights into customer priorities and competitive threats.
    • Co-travel with SCMT to strengthen market understanding and drive strategy refinement.

    Duty 3: Provide Global Leadership and Regional Guidance
    Operate with a global mindset and serve as the strategic leader for the pharmaceutical segment across all regions. Act as the authoritative voice on pharmaceutical segment strategy and market positioning across the organization. This includes:
    • Work with global branches and regional marketing teams to develop tactics that are both strategically aligned and regionally appropriate.
    • Provide guidance and support to branches, other Segment Marketing Managers, and business units on segment strategy and best practices.
    • Ensure consistent execution of global strategy while enabling regional flexibility where appropriate.
    • Monitor and measure the effectiveness of marketing strategies and initiatives across regions and business units.
    • Maintain extensive and effective communication across the organization—from core product management teams to global colleagues—to ensure alignment and accountability.

    Duty 4: Train, Coach, and Mentor Colleagues
    Build marketing capability across the organization by training, coaching, and mentoring colleagues on pharmaceutical segment marketing strategies, tactics, and best practices. Develop a culture of continuous learning and strategic rigor within the segment marketing function.
    This includes:
    • Mentor other Segment Marketing Managers and business unit colleagues on go-to-market approaches.
    • Coach team members on market analysis, competitive positioning, and strategic thinking.
    • Share industry knowledge and pharmaceutical customer insights with colleagues.
    • May include direct management responsibility for junior marketers or team members as needed.

    Duty 5: Compliance and Integrate into Promega Culture
    • Demonstrates inclusion through their own words and actions and is accountable for a safe workspace. Acts with kindness, curiosity, and respect for others.
    • Embracing and being open to incorporating Promega’s 6 Emotional & Social Intelligence (ESI) core principles in daily work.
    • Understands and complies with ethical, legal and regulatory requirements applicable to our business.

    KEY QUALIFICATIONS:

    1. PhD in life sciences or chemistry + 5+ years of pharmaceutical R&D experience, with clear progression in the scientific career ladder, demonstrating strategic thinking, cross-functional influence, and deep knowledge of pharmaceutical customer workflows.

    2. Ability to comprehend, present, and discuss scientific content at an advanced level.

    3. Demonstrated success with a variety of marketing functions including strategic and tactical marketing, marketing communications, market research, distribution channels, competitive intelligence, and customer communications.

    4. Strong public speaking skills needed to represent Promega at external meetings, conferences, and organizations. Able to present high-level information for multiple audiences ranging from scientists to marketers.

    5. Attend industry trainings, workshops, conferences, focus groups and other activities associated with marketing tactics as a presenter or Promega representative.

    6. Proven ability to analyze issues, think strategically and creatively and execute innovative ideas for the portfolio in target market and customer segments.

    7. Demonstrated effective written and verbal communication skills.

    8. Demonstrated ability to work on multiple detailed projects and assignments simultaneously and independently.

    9. Highly motivated self-starter and goal-oriented professional who can adapt style and approach to suit different audiences.

    10. Demonstrated proficiency in digital tools and technology, including Microsoft applications and mobile platforms, with the ability to adapt and leverage emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, to improve efficiency, automation, and collaboration.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

1. PhD or MBA preferred.

2. For candidates applying from pharmaceuticals R&D background, progression to the Associate Principal Scientist level or equivalent is preferred.

3. In-depth understanding of the pharmaceutical drug development process.

4. Experience working in a global organization with regional branch and/or distributor marketing and sales teams.

5. Experience or familiarity with sales strategies and techniques.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

1. Ability to move objects up to 25 pounds.

2. Ability to use computer and Microsoft Office applications.

3. Ability to travel as needed, domestic and international, up to 30% of the time.

raw.description:
The Role

At Treewalk, you'll run the day-to-day finance engine for the Indigenous governments, organizations and businesses we serve: clean books, a disciplined month-end close, timely funder reporting and year-end files that sail through audit. You'll own a portfolio of clients, acting as their fractional controller. Some will lean on you to keep operations running smoothly month to month; others will need you to get a backlog cleaned up and audit-ready. Either way, every file is yours to run.

Deadlines are real; overtime isn't a lifestyle. We staff sensibly, treat extra hours as the rare exception, and back that up with true schedule autonomy and remote flexibility, so your evenings stay yours.

If you've managed controllership or audit-prep engagements at a small- to mid-size firm, or run finance operations inside a First Nation, Tribal Council or Indigenous organization, and you're ready for high-impact work, tangible ownership and genuine balance, then we would love to hear from you.

How You'll Create Impact Day-to-Day

  • Run a disciplined close – Lead month-end and year-end close across your portfolio: reconciliations, accruals, deferred revenue, capital assets and journal entries, on time and review-ready.
  • Keep operations humming – Oversee AP, AR, payroll and cash management processes, and step in hands-on when a client needs a fractional controller's precision and speed.
  • Make audits painless – Build year-end audit files and lead schedules, prep airtight support, clear PBC lists and quarterback conversations with external auditors so leadership can sleep at night.
  • Get the hard files back on track – Clean up backlogs and prior-year issues, so clients go from catch-up mode to a clean, audit-ready position.
  • Run the engine of multi-entity groups – Keep the books straight across Nations' governments, economic development corporations, limited partnerships, trusts and societies, including intercompany and fund accounting.
  • Keep funding on track – Track funding by program, manage deferred and restricted funds, and prepare reporting for ISC, CIRNAC, FNHA and other funders.
  • Build strong controls – Design practical processes, internal controls and financial policies that hold up to auditor and funder scrutiny.
  • Grow the team – Coach and review the work of accountants, bookkeepers and CPA students, and build checklists and templates that scale across clients.

Result: clients see you as the calm, trusted voice who keeps their books clean, their funders satisfied and their audits uneventful, while you build deep, meaningful expertise without the grind of traditional public practice.

Requirements

Our ideal candidate...

• CPA designation required.

  • Significant experience in controllership, month-end close and year-end audit preparation, ideally with Indigenous governments, organizations or not-for-profits.
  • Strong working knowledge of PSAS / ASNPO, fund accounting and funding agreement reporting.
  • Experience leading engagements and supervising staff.
  • A respectful, relationship-based approach and an understanding of Indigenous histories, governance and the impacts of colonization.
  • After the base experience requirements are met, we hire first and foremost strong analytical thinkers and problem solvers.

Please mention these bonus skills if you have them

  • Audit experience at a firm serving First Nations or public-sector clients
  • Cloud accounting and payroll systems (e.g., QuickBooks Online, Sage, Xero)
  • FMB Financial Administration Law or certification experience
  • Lived experience as a First Nations, Métis or Inuit person, or connection to Indigenous communities

Benefits

Why Treewalk Feels Different

It's Treewalk for a reason: we invest in your growth, trust your judgment, and protect your life outside the ledger.

  • No-Strings Learning Fund – We pay 100% of your CPA modules, annual dues, and any pro-dev courses you choose, and we'll never claw it back if you move on.
  • Freedom Over Face-Time – Own your deadlines, shape your schedule. Hit a midday workout, do the school run; just bring the results.
  • Day-One Peace of Mind – Extended health, dental, vision, and parental-leave benefits start the moment you join.

Who We Are

Treewalk is Vancouver-born and scaling nationwide. Our Indigenous Services group runs the finance operations of Nations and Indigenous organizations and gets them audit-ready, so leadership can focus on their community's goals while we keep the numbers strong.

But labels like "accounting firm" don't capture our DNA. Picture a tech startup powered by CPAs:

  • Holacracy over hierarchy – Ideas outrank titles, and ownership lives on every desk.
  • Relationships first – We earn trust over the long term and work in a way that respects each community's priorities and protocols.
  • Growth at warp speed – One of Canada's fastest-rising advisory practices, we set audacious goals, then sprint past them.
  • Training ground for tomorrow's leaders – Whether you're two years post-designation or a seasoned finance lead, Treewalk is where accountants level up.

The Values That Power Us

Mastery: We hunt knowledge relentlessly and build expertise into every engagement.

Support: No one goes it alone; collaboration is our default setting.

Ownership: We celebrate wins and own slip-ups with equal conviction.

Kaizen: Continuous improvement isn't a buzzword; it's our daily operating system.

Annual Salary - $110,000

Overview: Quality and Test Automation

The Automation QA Engineer is vital for ensuring the reliability, performance, and correctness of our entire supply chain e-commerce platform. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive automated test suites across the e-commerce user interface, complex internal business workflows (MES, WMS, OMS), and the logic governing our next-generation AI agents.

Internship Details

Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote

Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will embed quality assurance directly into the development and deployment lifecycle, serving as the gatekeeper for production releases.

  • Test Suite Development: Develop and maintain robust, end-to-end automated test suites covering critical e-commerce flows (catalog navigation, checkout, payments, invoicing) and complex internal tool workflows (OMS/WMS operations).

  • Quality Gates (CI/CD): Integrate automated test suites into the CI/CD pipeline (managed via Makefile) to enforce quality gates, ensuring no regressions are introduced and the platform adheres to performance standards before deployment.

  • Performance & Load Testing: Implement and execute performance testing and load testing protocols to validate the scalability and resilience of the NestJS modular monolith, especially for high-traffic scenarios and intensive SCM transactions.

  • API Integration Testing: Design and execute automated tests for API integrations between the core supply chain modules (e.g., testing the data contract integrity between WMS and OMS) and external payment services.

  • Test Data Management: Create and maintain reliable test data factories to simulate complex multi-tenant and domain-specific scenarios (e.g., various HS codes, tenant feature flags).

  • Regression Management: Continuously maintain and optimize the regression test suite to provide fast, reliable feedback to development teams operating within the Monorepo structure.

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess strong expertise in automated testing frameworks, CI/CD integration, and performance validation:

  • Automation Frameworks: Experience selecting, building, and maintaining E2E (e.g., Playwright, Cypress) and API testing frameworks.

  • Programming: Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js for writing high-quality, maintainable test code.

  • Performance/Load: Experience with tools for performance and load testing (e.g., JMeter, K6).

  • CI/CD: Practical experience integrating tests into automated pipelines and working within a Monorepo environment.

  • Data & Database: Ability to query PostgreSQL 15 directly to validate data integrity.

AI Agent Focus

You will be responsible for validating the behavior and accuracy of our AI systems.

  • Agent Behavior Testing: Develop tests to validate the deterministic and non-deterministic behaviors of AI agents, ensuring they accurately process inputs, access data securely, and perform their intended functions (e.g., workflow optimization, customer support responses).

  • Integration Validation: Verify the quality of data retrieval and the security of the API layers connecting AI agents (using LangChain/LlamaIndex) to the core WMS/OMS data.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Test Coverage: Measurable increase in automated functional and regression test coverage across critical application paths.

  • Defect Escape Rate: Reduction in the number of critical and high-severity defects escaping to production.

  • Pipeline Reliability: Maintenance of stable, non-flaky test runs within the CI/CD pipeline.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Technical Architect or Engineering Lead, working directly with development teams across the Catalog, OMS, and WMS modules.

Company Background/Culture:

The Hindu American Foundation (HAF) is a non-profit advocacy organization for the Hindu American community. Founded in 2003, HAF's work impacts a range of issues — from the portrayal of Hinduism in K-12 textbooks to civil and human rights to addressing contemporary problems by applying Hindu philosophy.

The Foundation educates the public about Hinduism, speaks out about issues affecting Hindus worldwide, and builds bridges with institutions and individuals whose work aligns with HAF's objectives. HAF's three areas of focus are education, policy, and community. Through its advocacy efforts, HAF promotes dignity, mutual respect, and pluralism to ensure the well-being of Hindus and for all people and the planet to thrive.

Position Summary:

Reporting to the Senior Director of Marketing & Creative Strategy, the Video Content Producer will be directly involved in pushing the HAF brand forward by transforming existing and future content into polished, engaging short-form and long-form videos. This role is ideal for a creative storyteller who thrives in a fast-paced environment, understands social-platform trends, and can independently own the video production pipeline—from concept to final export.

Essential Duties:

The Video Content Producer will be able to perform the following duties with or without reasonable accommodations:

  • Repurpose existing and future materials and resources (blog posts, Slack threads, webinar recordings, reports, presentation decks, interviews) into short-form and long-form video content.

  • Collaborate with writers and subject-matter experts to extract key ideas and turn them into scripts or video narratives.
  • Collaborate with relevant team members to quickly create compelling video content on relevant, time sensitive issues that pop up in the news cycle.
  • Create motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and simple animations to support storytelling.
  • Optimize videos for multiple platforms, including YouTube, Instagram Reels, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Facebook.
  • Ensure consistent branding across all video output (intros, outros, typography, color, and tone).
  • Manage a content pipeline to efficiently deliver multiple pieces of video content each week.
  • Stay current on platform trends and recommend new formats, editing styles, and creative approaches.
  • Organize and maintain video assets, including raw footage, audio clips, and project files.

Required Education and Experience:

  • 2+ years of experience in video editing or digital content production (agency, nonprofit, or media experience is a plus).
  • High level of proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite of video editing software for editing, animation, motion graphics, and captioning tools.

  • Super selection in music and sound design - treat audio like 50% of the edit and utilize sound to craft a truly cinematic experience once paired with video
  • Strong understanding of Meta and YouTube editing styles, social-first storytelling, and audience engagement strategies.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to extract stories from written or conversational content.
  • Comfortable managing multiple projects and meeting tight deadlines..
  • Technical fluency with workplace productivity applications including, but not limited to: Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and online collaboration tools (e.g., Zoom, Teams, Slack).
  • Strong proficiency in the following competencies: strategic planning, time and priority management, organization, administration and evaluation, team development, influence, and self-management.

Day to day, you’ll…

  • Research, analyze, and evaluate current developments on federal and state tax issues preparing documentation and analysis for use by internal departments and external tax practitioners
  • Monitor and coordinate the day-to-day activities of a tax research project team to identify and resolve tax related issues, ensure adherence to research standards, and provide training and assistance to Tax Research Analysts, Associates, and Assistants
  • Perform independent research, analysis, and planning on complex federal and state tax and financial issues; interpret situations, draw conclusions, identify fundamental tax points, research and interpret tax code, regulations, and case law, and make recommendations as to the best tax treatment for the client
  • Research, analyze, and evaluate current year tax forms to identify and document tax changes that impact forms supported in H&R Block’s tax software products
  • Research and answer tax questions from chat, phone, and tax office support functions as needed to meet service level agreements (SLAs); ascertain the exact nature of the issue, research applicable tax law and regulations, and make recommendations as to the best tax treatment
  • Monitor and analyze new tax developments to determine effects; develop written analysis of new tax law, rulings, case law, and regulations for dissemination to tax office associates, other FSO (Financial Service Organization) departments, and the general public
  • Research tax and financial issues and provides explanations, analysis, and recommendations to other departments
  • Plan, research, develop, and write research projects and training materials related to tax topics, tax advice, or other financial issues; ensures projects are completed within established time frame
  • Coordinate, develop, and/or assist in researching tax issues to support other departments; provide technical assistance as required

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or the equivalent through a combination of education and related work experience
  • 3-5 years minimum related work experience in tax preparation and/or tax research or similar
  • Ability to clearly explain complex tax situations
  • Ability to interpret, analyze, and correctly formulate solutions to highly complex tax situations
  • Credential regulated under Circular 230 (Enrolled Agent, CPA, or Attorney) or Certified Financial Planner (CFP) credential
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively research complex tax issues and effectively communicate findings
  • Demonstrated critical, conceptual, intellectual, and problem-solving skills
  • Effective project management skills to complete assignments on time and within budget
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Knowledge of tax research principles, procedures, and techniques
  • Operational knowledge of tax law and regulations sufficient to understand and explain elements of personal, corporate, partnership, fiduciary, estate, gift, and international taxation
  • Writing skills to explain complex tax information in a clear manner and in plain language

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Federal and State tax administration to include litigation, tax compliance, and auditing
  • 5 years of experience in tax preparation and/or tax research

Why work for us

At H&R Block, our purpose is simple: to provide help and inspire confidence in our clients and communities everywhere. For more than 70 years, we’ve led the tax industry and we continue to evolve through our Block Next strategy, blending human expertise with digital innovation.

That same commitment to care extends to our associates. When you join us, you become part of a High Performing, Connected Culture built on strong relationships, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful impact. We invest in your well-being through competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and support for life both in and outside of work.

raw.description:
About Trideca

Trideca is Australia's trusted strategy, AI, and digital transformation partner, helping some of the nation's largest enterprises (including NAB, Suncorp, Optus, Medibank, and AGL) drive meaningful business impact through technology.

With offices in Melbourne and Sydney and projects spanning multiple industries, we thrive on solving complex challenges, delivering cutting-edge solutions, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

About the opportunity

Trideca is delivering the implementation phase of a large customer identity transformation for one of Australia's best known regulated enterprises. The program moves customer identity from Okta to Auth0 across web, mobile, API and IVR channels, serving millions of customers. Design is complete, and the Auth0 platform is now ready to be built. That means tenancies, token services, security configuration and CI/CD. We are looking for an Identity Platform Lead who has built Auth0 at enterprise, customer scale before and can lead that build from the first day.

What you will do

  • You will design and stand up Auth0 tenancies across development, test, staging and production.
  • You will build the token issuance and validation services and define the token and session architecture for every channel.
  • You will set the WAF rules, rate limiting and security hardening around each tenancy, and build a CI/CD pipeline that deploys Auth0 configuration as code.
  • You will also define a blue/green cutover approach so the new Auth0 flows can run alongside Okta without disrupting live traffic.
  • You will own the technical migration path from Okta to Auth0, including how existing sessions and credentials move across.
  • You will work closely with the established API, iOS and Android squads to define the contract each channel builds against, and make sure machine to machine traffic stays correctly scoped on Okta during the transition.
  • You will be the senior technical voice on identity. That means resolving the remaining platform level questions, making the key technical calls, documenting the build so it can be operated and extended after handover, and raising go live risk early, given that some cutover changes cannot be rolled back.

What you bring

  • You have stood up Auth0 tenancies at enterprise, customer facing scale, not only integrated applications against an existing tenancy.
  • You have migrated an identity platform from Okta or a comparable enterprise IAM product to Auth0.
  • You know OAuth2, OIDC, token services and Auth0 Actions in depth from hands on work.
  • You have defined WAF and security configuration for a customer identity platform, and applied Terraform or an equivalent infrastructure as code tool to identity configuration.
  • You work well in ambiguity and can find the questions nobody has asked yet.
  • Experience in financial services, healthcare or another regulated industry is highly regarded.

What success looks like

A working Auth0 authorizer in a lower environment that unblocks API testing. Clear, documented ownership of the identity platform. A pipeline that deploys Auth0 configuration reliably and repeatably. A cutover plan in which outage and rollback risk is understood and mitigated. Delivery squads building against a stable, tested platform rather than mocked outputs.

Why Choose Trideca?

Empowering Women in Technology: We are committed to closing the gender gap in technology. With our dedicated road map for women, you'll find tailored opportunities to advance your career, supported by mentorship, leadership programs, Women in Technology Chapter and inclusive policies like menstruation leave and flexible working options.

Growth Through Learning: Your growth is our priority. At Trideca, you'll have access to a wide range of learning and development initiatives, from certifications and workshops to personal development programs, ensuring you are always at the forefront of technology and innovation.

Work Your Way: Our flexible work policy supports you to balance your personal and professional life.

Trideca Values

Clients Come First

We obsess over our clients; they mean everything to us and are central to everything we do. We take the time to understand them, so we can deliver outstanding experiences and create moments of WOW.

Achieve Greatness Together

Business is a team sport, and we are here to win. We respect, value, and inspire each other to bring our best to raise the bar. We will high-five you when you've nailed it and have honest discussions when you don't.

We Celebrate Our Differences

We are stronger and more successful when we include and appreciate different backgrounds, ideas, and experiences. Diversity helps us be more creative, solve problems better, and achieve more. By valuing everyone's unique contributions, we create a cohesive workplace where everyone can thrive and grow.

Own Your Space

We own our space, relationships, and client outcomes. We are fully committed and accountable to ourselves and each other; we deliver what we commit to. We adopt a commercial outlook and expect everyone to think and make decisions like we are the CEO.

Debate, Agree, Commit

We champion open dialogue where every voice matters and ideas are rigorously challenged to create stronger solutions. Once we reach alignment, we commit fully as one team and execute with excellence and accountability.

Have Fun, Go Nuts

No explanation is required, have fun, go nuts.

We also believe that the unique contributions of everyone at Trideca is the driver of our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to embrace everyone's perspectives and experiences, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We are passionate about creating a workplace that fosters active participation and provides an equal playing field, where merit and accomplishment are the sole criteria for success. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. We celebrate the diversity of our workforce and are dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels welcome, valued, and included.

Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.
