  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.

  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

raw.description:
About the Company

Correlation One is the largest provider of AI and data workforce development programs globally, having trained over 500,000 professionals across 11 countries. As the largest training provider for Amazon Career Choice, and a growing partner to state governments building registered apprenticeship programs, Correlation One sits at the intersection of employer talent needs and scalable workforce training.

We work with Fortune 500 enterprises, federal and state government agencies, and leading employers to close skills gaps in AI, data analytics, cybersecurity, and operations leadership. Our programs produce job-ready graduates who are prepared to contribute from day one.

About the Role

Graduates of our Amazon Career Choice programs receive up to 18 months of post-program support: career coaching, an alumni community of roughly 9,000 members, and connections to employer partners. This role owns the systems that make that support work. That includes how alumni hear from us, how they move through our community, how coaches are deployed, and how outcomes data moves from our warehouse into decisions. The role is part communicator, part builder, part analyst, with AI built into how you do all three. It suits someone who writes a warm launch post in the morning and debugs an Apps Script trigger in the afternoon.

What You'll Do

Alumni Engagement & Communications

  • Own the alumni communications calendar, planning multi-channel outreach (Slack, email, SMS, LinkedIn) for cohort graduations, coaching milestones, events, and support-window reminders.
  • Write and launch campaigns end to end: copy, audience segmentation, cadence, forms, and follow-up tracking. This includes welcome campaigns for new cohorts and promotion of live programming such as mock interview labs and career co-working sessions. Use AI tools to draft, personalize, and translate messaging at scale, with human review before anything goes out.
  • Manage the alumni Slack community, including tenure-based channels, invite links and their limits, welcome messaging, and the alumni LinkedIn network. Keep these spaces accurate, active, and limited to eligible members.
  • Run outcomes and profile-update campaigns that collect placement data, resumes, and LinkedIn profiles from alumni. Use Typeform logic (e.g., hidden fields) so one message can serve several eligibility groups.
  • Partner with coaches on newly placed alumni and contributor stories to strengthen peer-to-peer engagement.

Automation & Workflow Systems

  • Design, build, and maintain automations that remove manual work from alumni and coach operations. Examples include channel lifecycle automation that moves alumni between tenure-based Slack channels, welcome bots, personalized coach-to-alumni DM tools, coach assignment, and welcome email sequences.
  • Build with Google Apps Script, the Slack API, Connected Sheets, and no-code tools, working within platform constraints such as plan limits, rate limits, and execution timeouts.
  • Engineer for reliability: dry-run and test modes, validation before writes, run logs, safe-failure logic, and manual override paths.
  • Write clear maintainer documentation so each system can be supported by someone other than its builder.
  • Build and own the AI-powered steps in these workflows, such as LLM-based resume review, message drafting, and response triage, including the prompts, quality checks, and human-review points that keep output accurate.

Data Warehouse & Reporting

  • Maintain BigQuery datasets and views that feed alumni operations, including rosters, program and tenure dates, and email matching across systems.
  • Connect warehouse data to Sheets, Tableau, and Hex, and own dashboards for outcomes (by country, month, and transition type) and coach performance.
  • Own data quality across the alumni record: validate form ingestion, resolve duplicates, and keep resume, LinkedIn, and profile updates in sync across the admin app, Recruit CRM, Airtable, and the warehouse. Use AI-assisted methods to speed up record matching, deduplication, and cleanup, validating results against source data.
  • Produce recurring and ad hoc analyses, such as half-year alumni support reviews and placement trend lines. Clearly lay out methodology tradeoffs, such as reporting by processed date versus reporting date.

Coach & Program Operations

  • Manage day-to-day operations for a contracted bench of career coaches: learner assignments, onboarding and offboarding, booking links, coverage during transitions, tracking sheets, and the coach operational guide.
  • Coordinate professional development session facilitation for active cohorts, including scheduling presenters and confirming sessions with program teams.
  • Build employer-partner candidate pipelines. Match alumni and learners to partner role requirements, confirm interest, and deliver clean shortlists with resumes and LinkedIn profiles.
  • Maintain the PD Ops project tracker and team playbooks so priorities, owners, and status stay visible.

What You Bring

Required

  • 2+ years in program operations, alumni relations, career services, community operations, or operations analytics, ideally in education, workforce development, or a high-volume learner environment.
  • Strong SQL and hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred).
  • Scripting ability in Google Apps Script/JavaScript or Python, and comfort working with REST APIs (Slack API experience is a plus).
  • Excellent written communication, with a track record of messaging that drives action, and judgment about tone, timing, and audience fatigue.
  • Ability to manage many concurrent workstreams across internal teams, contracted coaches, and external partners.
  • A builder's mindset: you notice repetitive work and propose a system for it, then document it so others can run it.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini) to real operational work, such as drafting communications, cleaning data, or automating reviews, and the judgment to know where human review is needed.

Preferred

  • Experience with Tableau or Hex, Typeform, Airtable, Notion, and an ATS/CRM such as Recruit CRM.
  • Familiarity with Amazon Career Choice or similar employer-funded upskilling programs.
  • Experience coordinating contractor or vendor teams.

Tools You'll Use

  • Slack (admin and API), Google Workspace and Apps Script, BigQuery, Tableau, Hex, Typeform, Airtable, Recruit CRM, Notion, Calendly, Zoom, Canva, and AI tools such as Claude

Where you are

  • This role is remote and can be located anywhere in MENA. Working hours must be compatiblewith the EST time zone.

How we support our people

  • Insurance or subsidies based on country
  • Unlimited Time Off
  • Company-paid holidays
  • Official company-wide week long holiday for the last week in December
  • Access to free data skills training through our programs
  • A company culture that empowers individuals and embraces diversity through its core mission

The compensation range for this position is specific to location and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. These factors include (but are not limited to) location, experience, education and skill sets.

Correlation One’s Commitment

Correlation One is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal opportunity for all employees and applicants. Correlation One provides a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Employment decisions at Correlation One are based solely on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We encourage applicants to bring their unique skills, experiences, and outlook to our work environment.

Correlation One is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As a Security Architect (Consultant) in Kainos, you’ll be responsible for the design and application of good security practices in the platforms and services we build for our customers. You’ll work with Agile delivery teams to develop good security practices throughout the software development journey. You’ll learn about and apply new technologies and approaches, with talented colleagues who will help you develop and grow. 

You’ll share knowledge and help educate people – both customers and Kainos team members.  You’ll manage, coach and develop a small number of staff, with a focus on managing employee performance and assisting in their career development. You’ll also provide direction and leadership for your team as you solve challenging problems together.

MINIMUM (ESSENTIAL) REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience in the secure design and delivery of new cloud services and solutions. 
    • Experience in identifying security issues in existing system designs or products, including recommending sensible mitigations that balance cost, risk and usability. 
    • Knowledge of security standards and regulations (e.g. NCSC, ISO, SoC, NIST, PCI, GDPR).
  • Deep architectural xxperience in one of the following specialisms: AI/ML Security/Cloud/M365/DevSecOps Security Architecture
    • Experience in application architecture, software development and/or infrastructure architecture. 
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience mentoring engineers and architects
    • Experience testing the security of software and infrastructure using appropriate security tools.
    • Experience with Continuous Security, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery techniques.
    • Experience of network security (e.g. OSI, TCP/IP), web application security (e.g. OWASP) and cryptographic controls (e.g. PKI, TLS).
    • We are passionate about developing people – a demonstrated ability in managing, mentoring and coaching members of your team and wider community is important
    • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey security complexities to audiences of various technical abilities (e.g. senior stakeholders, development teams).

DESIRABLE

  • Experience of Identity management and authentication/authorisation products and patterns. 
  • Industry experience in Public /Commercial/Defence/Healthcare Sector(s)
    • End-to-end security involvement, including governance, risk and compliance, operational security, supply chain security and secure user management.
    • Penetration testing qualifications (e.g. OSCP, CREST, TIGER or equivalent)
    • Experience leading security engineers and other junior members of staff
  • Involvement across the full security lifecycle

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

About the Role

We're looking for an Agency Partnerships Lead who can make Writesonic the default GEO platform for agencies worldwide. You'll own the full agency lifecycle: finding the right partners, onboarding them, and helping them win clients with AI search visibility services.

This isn't a traditional partnerships role. You'll build relationships with decision-makers at holding companies like Omnicom, WPP, and Dentsu while also helping boutique agencies pitch GEO services to their first clients. We need someone who can close six-figure agency deals and then jump on a webinar to teach 50 agency owners how to sell AI search optimization.

What You'll Do

Build Agency Revenue (60%)

  • Own the agency partner pipeline from prospecting to close
  • Develop tiered partnership programs (referral, reseller, white-label)
  • Build relationships with holding company leaders (Omnicom, WPP, Publicis, Dentsu, IPG, Havas)
  • Close agency deals ranging from $10K to $100K+ annual contracts

Enable Agency Success (25%)

  • Build pitch workspaces that help agencies win new clients with GEO services
  • Develop training programs that turn agency teams into GEO experts
  • Host monthly agency webinars and roundtables
  • Build case studies that agencies can use in their sales process

Scale the Partner Ecosystem (15%)

  • Create co-marketing playbooks for agency partners
  • Build a partner community where agencies share wins and learn from each other
  • Represent Writesonic at agency-focused events and conferences
  • Develop referral programs that drive inbound partner interest

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Experience

  • 5+ years selling SaaS to agencies (social listening, analytics, or MarTech preferred)
  • Track record closing deals with holding company networks (Omnicom, WPP, Dentsu, Publicis)
  • Built or scaled an agency partner program at a Series A/B company
  • Deep understanding of how PR, digital, and marketing agencies operate and bill clients

Domain Knowledge

You're not joining to manage existing partners. You're here to make Writesonic the platform agencies recommend when clients ask about AI search visibility. We have the product (white-label reporting, multi-client dashboards, pitch workspaces). We need someone to turn these features into a partner program that scales.

raw.description:
The National Medical Director leads and develops a team of Medical Directors and Clinical Directors responsible for clinical strategy across the Enterprise book of business. This role is accountable for the performance, growth, and coordination of that team — setting priorities, allocating clinical resources across portfolios, and ensuring consistent execution of Aledade's programs and technologies across ACOs. In addition to owning individual strategic market relationships directly, this leader builds the team's capability to develop and sustain relationships, influence clinical workflows, and drive value-based healthcare outcomes. This role requires demonstrated excellence in leading and coaching physician leaders, and in creating buy-in with internal and external stakeholders to promote and affect change in how healthcare is delivered.

Primary Duties:

  • Clinical Outcomes:
    Lead and drive Performance Excellence clinical outcomes across all contracts within your portfolio.
    Strategically align and coordinate with Aledade’s national Enterprise strategy leadership on Performance Excellence clinical drivers of shared savings aligned with the Aledade Annual Operating Plan, currently including but not limited to driving clinical performance in Risk and Hypertensive-based initiatives, while assisting in the launch of newly signed practices.
    In coordination with Executive Directors, account leads, the VP, Enterprise Partnerships, and the SVP of Strategic Initiatives, own clinical strategy goals and objectives and deploy resources including but not limited to clinical contracted extenders, coaching, and Aledade tools to drive successful clinical outcomes across your portfolio.
  • Team Leadership:
    Lead, coach, and manage a team of Medical Directors and Clinical Directors, setting clear performance goals tied to Performance Excellence clinical outcomes across all contracts within the collective portfolio. Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and development planning for direct reports. Strategically align the team with Aledade's national Enterprise strategy leadership on Performance Excellence clinical drivers of shared savings, consistent with the Aledade Annual Operating Plan — including Risk and Hypertensive-based initiatives and the launch of newly signed practices.
  • Resource Deployment & Market Coordination:
    In coordination with Executive Directors, account leads, VPs, Enterprise Partnerships, and the SVP of Strategic Initiatives, translate clinical strategy goals into team assignments and deploy resources — including clinical and medical directors’ coaching capacity and Aledade tools — across the portfolios managed by direct reports. Own escalation and troubleshooting when a Medical Director or Clinical Director needs additional support to drive successful clinical outcomes in their assigned portfolio.
  • Talent Development & Clinical Bench Strength:
    Recruit, onboard, and develop Medical Directors and Clinical Directors, building a strong clinical leadership bench across the Enterprise team. Mentor direct reports on serving as thought partners to VPs, Enterprise Partnerships and the SVP of Strategic Initiatives, and on championing clinical strategy within growth, local policy, and other market-level initiatives. Ensure direct reports serving as ACO Medical Directors are equipped and supported in that responsibility.
  • Represent the Clinical Voice:
    In coordination with Aledade's Chief Medical Director, serve on strategic workgroups or committees shaping Aledade's clinical performance strategy across the company. Represent the perspective and needs of the Medical Director/Clinical Director team in these forums, and translate outcomes back to the team as leadership, insight, and piloting opportunities that enhance Aledade's clinical resources and initiatives.
  • Adapt to evolving organizational needs and priorities by taking on additional clinical leadership responsibilities as necessary, including representing the team in cross-functional or company-wide initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Doctorate in Medicine (MD or DO)
  • Additional Training: residency in an adult primary care specialty (family medicine, general internal medicine, geriatric medicine, combined internal medicine/peds)
  • 2+ years of experience directly managing and developing physician or clinical leaders (e.g., Medical Directors, Clinical Directors)
  • 2+ years of direct clinical (patient care) experience, with consideration given to quality improvement activities, participation in cost containment initiatives and other population health experiences
  • 5+ years of experience working in partnership with hospitals and health systems as a medical director or clinical strategy lead.
  • Board Certified in their speciality (ABFM, etc)
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously and coordinate activities to consistently meet deadlines and expectations within Market(s) of responsibility
  • Ability to span from high level strategy to tactical work required to deliver results within market portfolio assignments

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Excellent organizational and project management skills, and team-building skills.
  • Familiarity with process mapping and work-flow analysis tools.
  • Excellent computer skills and willingness to learn additional software applications.

Physical Requirements:

  • Sitting for prolonged periods of time.
  • Extensive use of computers and keyboard.
  • Occasional walking and lifting may be required.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time, as needed

Who We Are:

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

What Does This Mean for You?

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.
In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)
Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays
12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service
Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options
And much more!
At Aledade PBC, we don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We strive to attract, develop and retain highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities where we live and work. Aledade is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Employment policies and decisions at Aledade are based on merit, qualifications, performance and business needs. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or sexual orientation.

Build What Matters at RevStar

Position: Game Design Subject Matter Expert

  • Reports To: Product Manager/Engineering Lead
  • Location: Remote
  • Employment Type: Contract

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Game Design Subject Matter Expert (Visual & Systems) to serve as an independent contractor. In this capacity, the Contractor will drive the evolution and abstraction of our interactive learning modules and graphics systems.

The primary objective of this engagement is to take existing game engines and visual templates and evolve them into modular, scalable, and configurable frameworks. The Contractor will exercise independent professional judgment to establish visual standards, system abstractions, and technical specifications for interactive content.

Our Core Values:

  • Self-Mastery: We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve.
  • Ownership: We own outcomes, not just effort.
  • Shared Destiny: We rise or fall together.

Your Impact Pillars

The Contractor will be responsible for producing and executing the following key project deliverables:

1. Graphics & Systems Template Abstraction

  • Audit existing game assets, UI systems, and visual layouts to architect reusable, modular graphics templates.
  • Abstract visual components and core gameplay mechanics into configurable parameters for non-technical content creators.
  • Consult with engineering and art teams to define specifications for scalable asset and content pipeline tooling.

2. Visual & Mechanical Design Integration

  • Architect intuitive gameplay loops, progression frameworks, visual feedback loops, and reward structures for interactive modules.
  • Establish and document comprehensive UI/UX standards, visual design patterns, and aesthetic consistency benchmarks across all game templates.
  • Translate complex subject matter into clear visual communication frameworks.

3. Technical Strategy & Documentation

  • Act as the Subject Matter Expert for game design and visual layout during client scoping and custom configuration reviews.
  • Execute iterative visual design reviews, aesthetic audits, and usability assessments to ensure high production standards.
  • Produce comprehensive documentation, including style guides, asset specifications, and technical configuration parameters.

Requirements

To successfully complete the deliverables for this engagement, the Contractor must possess:

  • 4+ years of professional game design experience, specializing in visual design systems, UI/UX, or graphics template evolution (over pure standalone indie development).
  • Demonstrated history of architecting or modularizing visual game assets, level templates, or UI framework systems.
  • Deep technical expertise in visual communication, graphic asset pipelines, integration workflows, and user-centric design principles.
  • Ability to work with complete autonomy, providing high-level technical direction and self-directed execution in a collaborative environment.

Benefits

  • Remote-First Working Environment – Collaborate from anywhere while staying connected with our global team.
  • Collaborative, Innovative Culture – Work alongside top talent in a fast-paced, supportive environment that values curiosity and initiative.

raw.title: Senior Financial Planner
raw.excerpt: About the Role﻿Our client ﻿is a fee-only Registered Investment Advisor and multi-family office.
raw.description:
About the Role

﻿Our client ﻿is a fee-only Registered Investment Advisor and multi-family office. They work with a select group of households on the whole picture — investments, financial planning, estate, retirement and tax coordination — and they do it with a small, senior team rather than a large one.

The Senior Financial Planner works directly with the Founder/Lead Advisor and carries genuine client ownership early on. You will be trusted with households to run rather than assigned to shadow someone else's. For a planner who has been one of many at a larger firm, that is the appeal: your judgment matters here, and clients feel it.

Where This Role Leads

﻿They ﻿are building a bench rather than filling a seat — paraplanner, to planner, to advisor. This is the planner rung, and for the right person, it is a defined path to a full advisory role with your own client relationships. They ﻿ promote from within because they would rather develop an advisor who already knows their clients and their standards than recruit one who doesn't. The planners who make that step there are the ones who have mastered the craft first — they can run the trade, close the estate file, and see an outstanding document all the way in. If that is the path you want, this role is built to take you there.

Hours & Location

Fully remote, open to candidates anywhere in the United States. The firm runs on Pacific time, with client meetings concentrated in the Pacific morning and early afternoon.

  • Standard schedule: 8:00am–4:00pm Pacific.

  • East Coast: 7:00am–3:00pm Pacific (10:00am–6:00pm Eastern). We are flexible on the exact shift.

The first part of the day is largely uninterrupted heads-down time, and the day finishes early by Pacific standards — one of the quieter benefits of working here. Candidates in Pacific and Mountain time find the rhythm most natural. If you are further east, we would simply encourage you to look at the local hours and feel confident they suit you; we want this to work well for the long run.

You Team and You Support

You will not carry all of this alone. Their operations team handles account opening, custodial paperwork, notary coordination and document filing. One of their Directors of Operations is studying for the CFP® and moving toward a paraplanning role — data collection, entry into Right Capital, estate plan summaries, and follow-up on tax and insurance items.

Where exactly that division falls is something you and she will shape together over your first ninety days. We would rather you draw that line from experience than have us guess at it now. Helping her develop is part of this role and one we value highly: a planner who can teach is a planner who scales, and it is the clearest signal we have that someone is ready for an advisory seat.

Ownership stays with you. You can hand off the work; the outcome remains yours. Every open item on your household is yours to track, including the ones someone else is executing. That accountability is what makes delegation work — and it is what their clients feel.

How They Work Together

  • Weekly one-on-ones with the Lead Advisor through your first sixty days, moving to every other week as you settle in.
  • Substantive feedback happens on video rather than over email — it is faster, clearer, and recorded so you can revisit it.
  • Put time on the Lead Advisor's calendar whenever you need it. Fifteen minutes of am I on the right track beats two hours of rework, and no one there has ever been unwelcome for asking.

What You Will Own

1. Client Ownership & Follow-Through

Nothing falls through. Every open item has a name and a date on it.

An active week generates a lot of open items, and keeping them moving is central to the role. You will have support on the collection work, and the judgment about what matters stays with you.

  • Track every open item to completion in Wealthbox, with clear ownership, a defined next action and a due date.

  • Pursue documents and data from clients, custodians, insurance carriers, third-party administrators and tax preparers until they arrive.

  • Escalate anything stalled before it becomes visible to the client. When something doesn't get implemented, the client looks to us regardless of where the delay sat.

  • Conduct proactive outreach and field client questions through to resolution.

  • Maintain client records in Wealthbox and connected systems.

  • Help onboard new clients and households alongside operations.

2. Planning & Advice

The plan is right, the client understands it, and the recommendations get implemented.

  • Complete data collection and request supporting documents ahead of annual review meetings.

  • Enter and maintain financial details in Right Capital.

  • Fact-check and present financial plans fluently to clients over Zoom, without reading from a script.

  • Prepare recommendations using their Recommendations Template and present them to the client.

  • Prepare the full financial plan and recommendations to send after the annual planning meeting.

  • Email recommendations and action items after meetings, and document them in Wealthbox with client, assignee, and due date.

  • Complete planning analyses as assigned — real estate, home affordability, and health insurance.

  • Prepare the Lead Advisor for in-person meetings and handle the follow-up.

  • Lead year-end tax planning: request reports and retirement plan estimates, prepare tax projections, and shape strategy.

  • Handle tax document collection and support Business Management through the high-volume tax seasons (March/April and September/October).

  • Manage company retirement plans: beginning-of-year data requests, year-end projections through the TPA, and liaison between the client, the TPA and the tax preparer.

3. Trading & Portfolio

Trades are right the first time. This is where an operational mind pays off.

  • Master the trading process and serve as backup to the primary trader through iRebal.

  • Identify trades, build the trade blotter, review for accuracy, execute and document.

  • Handle non-routine trading independently: allocating a newly funded account, and raising cash from a concentrated or tax-sensitive portfolio where the obvious sale is the wrong one.

  • Assist with asset allocation reviews.

  • Maintain margin balance oversight on applicable client accounts.

4. Estate & Specialty Projects

Estate files get finished, not just opened.

  • Manage the estate planning process end to end: schedule time with clients to create, update, and review their plans, and produce clear summaries.

  • See documents through processing, notary and execution, with originals filed in the client record.

  • Conduct beneficiary, estate and insurance reviews.

  • Coordinate with clients and insurance companies for in-force illustrations, and obtain 401(k) information to facilitate rollovers.

  • Lead planning projects with defined deadlines, and prepare market updates and the Periodic Table of Investment Returns for clients and prospects.

5. Efficiency & Automation

The repetitive parts of the work get lighter every quarter.

They intend to stay small and still grow, and thoughtful use of technology is how that works. This is a genuine part of the role, not an afterthought.

  • Identify the recurring, low-judgment parts of the planning workflow and reduce them — meeting notes into

    Wealthbox, document requests, data collection prep, first-draft recommendations, and client correspondence.
  • Build repeatable, documented processes rather than personal shortcuts: prompt libraries, templates, and workflow automations the whole team can use.
  • Work within the firm's compliance boundaries. No client PII goes into consumer AI tools, and anything touching client communication or advice stays under human review and is retained per our books-and-records obligations.

﻿What They're Looking For

  • Certified Financial Planner (CFP®) designation, with at least five years of client-facing experience.

  • Comprehensive planning experience at a fee-only Registered Investment Advisor.

  • Practical, day-to-day use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in professional work — processes you have genuinely put into practice — along with sound judgment about their compliance limits in a regulated advisory setting.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through. This is the single most predictive trait for success in this role.
  • A thoughtful approach to delegation — you can describe how you keep ownership of work you have handed to someone else.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and comfort representing the brand with clients.

  • The ability to work effectively and independently in a fully remote setting, on the schedule described above.

We would rather hire the right person and teach the software than screen on platform names. If you have several of these, please tell us:

  • Hands-on experience with iRebal, Black Diamond, Wealthbox CRM, Right Capital or Charles Schwab Advisor Center.

  • A background in investment operations, portfolio administration or on a trading desk.

  • Experience building workflow automations with ChatGPT, Claude, Zapier or similar tools.

  • Tax preparation or tax planning experience.

  • Estate planning knowledge and experience.

  • Experience mentoring or developing a junior planner or paraplanner.

This role suits someone who enjoys getting into the details and takes real satisfaction in a clean file; who wants to grow into an advisory role and is glad to earn it through the technical work; who would rather be trusted with responsibility than eased into it; who looks at a repetitive task and wonders whether it could run itself; who enjoys bringing someone else along; and for whom a day anchored to Pacific hours fits well.

It is a less natural fit for someone whose primary strength and interest is business development and building a book, or who would prefer a role with a fixed, narrowly defined scope. At a firm our size, scope moves — and we would rather say so now than have it surprise you later.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary $120,000–$140,000, depending on experience, plus a target annual bonus of 15–20% of base. Total target compensation $140,000–$165,000.

The bonus is based on an individual scorecard and has been paid at target in the last year.

Benefits include a monthly health stipend, 401k, Defined benefit plan, unlimited PTO, and full support for continuing education and CFP® renewal.

Financial Planner Recruiting, LLC and Firm ﻿﻿is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital or familial status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

  • Manage functional support and enhancement work for multiple client environments, balancing priorities, service expectations, timelines, budgets, and quality.

raw.description:
Our client, a fast-growing fintech company, is hiring their first dedicated Payroll Manager. This is a foundational, individual-contributor role: you take full ownership of payroll company-wide, standardize the process, and build the function as the company scales into new countries. You report to the Head of Finance and work daily with Legal, HR, and Finance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end payroll processing for the Latvia entity, plus oversight of outsourced payroll in the UK and Poland
  • Own the B2B/contractor payment cycle globally, including crypto (USDT) settlement, as a distinct process from employee payroll
  • Ensure payroll compliance with Latvian labor law, tax withholding, and social security obligations
  • Review and quality-check payroll calculations prepared by the outsourced UK and Poland providers
  • Partner with Legal and HR on employment terms, cross-border considerations, and worker classification (employee vs. B2B contractor)
  • Partner with Finance on payroll cost accounting, accruals, and reconciliation to the general ledger
  • Own the payroll system(s)/HRIS: selection, implementation, and administration
  • Administer benefits tied to payroll (medical insurance, L&D budget, etc.)
  • Own payroll data privacy and security in line with GDPR
  • Ensure accurate, on-time payroll runs every cycle, no exceptions

What We Expect

Must-have:

  • Proven payroll management experience, ideally across more than one country
  • Experience with both direct employee payroll and B2B/contractor payment structures
  • Comfortable managing and reviewing the work of outsourced payroll providers
  • Fluent in English and Latvian
  • High ownership and autonomy: this is an individual-contributor role from day one
  • Located in ﻿Latvia

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in fintech, crypto, or another fast-growing company
  • Experience with UK and/or Polish payroll
  • Russian language
  • Familiarity with payroll/EOR platforms (e.g., Deel, Remote, Rippling)

What's in it for you:

  • A founding opportunity: build the payroll function from the ground up and own it end-to-end, across jurisdictions, as the company scales
  • Salary: €2,500 gross/month, performance-based bonus
  • Medical insurance, L&D budget, English classes, regular team-building activities
  • A fast-paced, self-funded fintech company with no investor-driven pressure

Interview Process:

1. Teamence - Initial screening
2. HR screen (30–40 min): career narrative, communication style, autonomy fit
3. Hiring manager interview (60–90 min): payroll technical depth, past ownership examples, chemistry

raw.description:
JOB OBJECTIVE: Work in conjunction with Product Development & Adoption (PDA), R&D, and Product Marketing Teams to develop, plan, communicate, execute, and lead worldwide marketing strategies (short and long-term) and tactics for the market segments using clearly defined goals, objectives, critical success factors, timelines, budgets, and metrics. Responsible for creating and managing the programs and communications about our products and services to internal and external customers in assigned market segment area(s). Translate and coordinate Product Management and Product Marketing goals and strategies into successful global market segment marketing plans and activities that achieve business objectives. Work closely with branch marketing and marketing services to ensure successful adoption and execution of global marketing plans and sales activities. Critically, this person must be able to perform the below duties showing credibility and industry knowledge to the customers and to internal stakeholders.

CORE DUTIES:

Duty 1: Develop Go-to-Market Strategies for the Pharmaceutical Market Segment
Independently develop comprehensive go-to-market strategies for the pharmaceutical industry segment. This requires deep knowledge of how pharmaceutical companies operate, make purchasing decisions, and allocate budget. The strategy must address:
• Growth projections and realistic revenue targets for the segment.
• Target company identification (which pharmaceutical companies and which therapeutic areas represent the best growth opportunities).
• Product area prioritization (e.g., small molecules, biologics, cell and gene therapy, etc.).
• Value positioning and competitive differentiation for each product area.
• Tactical approaches and marketing initiatives aligned with pharma customer needs.

Duty 2: Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration and Field Engagement
Lead close collaboration with internal product management groups (PDA for new products, CES for established products), R&D, Marketing Services, SCMT, and Sales to execute marketing initiatives and campaigns. This duty includes two distinct directions:

Direction 1 – Marketing Execution:

  • Take an active role in generating customer-facing materials and promotional campaigns.
    • Drive marketing initiatives that support company focus areas.
    • Lead the development of campaigns, collateral, and promotional programs in partnership with internal stakeholders.

    Direction 2 – Market Intelligence:
    • Attend industry conferences and conduct customer visits to identify emerging trends and unmet needs.
    • Monitor pharmaceutical industry activity, particularly new biotech acquisitions and market shifts.
    • Gather field insights into customer priorities and competitive threats.
    • Co-travel with SCMT to strengthen market understanding and drive strategy refinement.

    Duty 3: Provide Global Leadership and Regional Guidance
    Operate with a global mindset and serve as the strategic leader for the pharmaceutical segment across all regions. Act as the authoritative voice on pharmaceutical segment strategy and market positioning across the organization. This includes:
    • Work with global branches and regional marketing teams to develop tactics that are both strategically aligned and regionally appropriate.
    • Provide guidance and support to branches, other Segment Marketing Managers, and business units on segment strategy and best practices.
    • Ensure consistent execution of global strategy while enabling regional flexibility where appropriate.
    • Monitor and measure the effectiveness of marketing strategies and initiatives across regions and business units.
    • Maintain extensive and effective communication across the organization—from core product management teams to global colleagues—to ensure alignment and accountability.

    Duty 4: Train, Coach, and Mentor Colleagues
    Build marketing capability across the organization by training, coaching, and mentoring colleagues on pharmaceutical segment marketing strategies, tactics, and best practices. Develop a culture of continuous learning and strategic rigor within the segment marketing function.
    This includes:
    • Mentor other Segment Marketing Managers and business unit colleagues on go-to-market approaches.
    • Coach team members on market analysis, competitive positioning, and strategic thinking.
    • Share industry knowledge and pharmaceutical customer insights with colleagues.
    • May include direct management responsibility for junior marketers or team members as needed.

    Duty 5: Compliance and Integrate into Promega Culture
    • Demonstrates inclusion through their own words and actions and is accountable for a safe workspace. Acts with kindness, curiosity, and respect for others.
    • Embracing and being open to incorporating Promega’s 6 Emotional & Social Intelligence (ESI) core principles in daily work.
    • Understands and complies with ethical, legal and regulatory requirements applicable to our business.

    KEY QUALIFICATIONS:

    1. PhD in life sciences or chemistry + 5+ years of pharmaceutical R&D experience, with clear progression in the scientific career ladder, demonstrating strategic thinking, cross-functional influence, and deep knowledge of pharmaceutical customer workflows.

    2. Ability to comprehend, present, and discuss scientific content at an advanced level.

    3. Demonstrated success with a variety of marketing functions including strategic and tactical marketing, marketing communications, market research, distribution channels, competitive intelligence, and customer communications.

    4. Strong public speaking skills needed to represent Promega at external meetings, conferences, and organizations. Able to present high-level information for multiple audiences ranging from scientists to marketers.

    5. Attend industry trainings, workshops, conferences, focus groups and other activities associated with marketing tactics as a presenter or Promega representative.

    6. Proven ability to analyze issues, think strategically and creatively and execute innovative ideas for the portfolio in target market and customer segments.

    7. Demonstrated effective written and verbal communication skills.

    8. Demonstrated ability to work on multiple detailed projects and assignments simultaneously and independently.

    9. Highly motivated self-starter and goal-oriented professional who can adapt style and approach to suit different audiences.

    10. Demonstrated proficiency in digital tools and technology, including Microsoft applications and mobile platforms, with the ability to adapt and leverage emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, to improve efficiency, automation, and collaboration.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

1. PhD or MBA preferred.

2. For candidates applying from pharmaceuticals R&D background, progression to the Associate Principal Scientist level or equivalent is preferred.

3. In-depth understanding of the pharmaceutical drug development process.

4. Experience working in a global organization with regional branch and/or distributor marketing and sales teams.

5. Experience or familiarity with sales strategies and techniques.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

1. Ability to move objects up to 25 pounds.

2. Ability to use computer and Microsoft Office applications.

3. Ability to travel as needed, domestic and international, up to 30% of the time.

Deadlines are real; overtime isn't a lifestyle. We staff sensibly, treat extra hours as the rare exception, and back that up with true schedule autonomy and remote flexibility, so your evenings stay yours.

If you've managed controllership or audit-prep engagements at a small- to mid-size firm, or run finance operations inside a First Nation, Tribal Council or Indigenous organization, and you're ready for high-impact work, tangible ownership and genuine balance, then we would love to hear from you.

How You'll Create Impact Day-to-Day

  • Run a disciplined close – Lead month-end and year-end close across your portfolio: reconciliations, accruals, deferred revenue, capital assets and journal entries, on time and review-ready.
  • Keep operations humming – Oversee AP, AR, payroll and cash management processes, and step in hands-on when a client needs a fractional controller's precision and speed.
  • Make audits painless – Build year-end audit files and lead schedules, prep airtight support, clear PBC lists and quarterback conversations with external auditors so leadership can sleep at night.
  • Get the hard files back on track – Clean up backlogs and prior-year issues, so clients go from catch-up mode to a clean, audit-ready position.
  • Run the engine of multi-entity groups – Keep the books straight across Nations' governments, economic development corporations, limited partnerships, trusts and societies, including intercompany and fund accounting.
  • Keep funding on track – Track funding by program, manage deferred and restricted funds, and prepare reporting for ISC, CIRNAC, FNHA and other funders.
  • Build strong controls – Design practical processes, internal controls and financial policies that hold up to auditor and funder scrutiny.
  • Grow the team – Coach and review the work of accountants, bookkeepers and CPA students, and build checklists and templates that scale across clients.

Result: clients see you as the calm, trusted voice who keeps their books clean, their funders satisfied and their audits uneventful, while you build deep, meaningful expertise without the grind of traditional public practice.

Requirements

Our ideal candidate...

• CPA designation required.

  • Significant experience in controllership, month-end close and year-end audit preparation, ideally with Indigenous governments, organizations or not-for-profits.
  • Strong working knowledge of PSAS / ASNPO, fund accounting and funding agreement reporting.
  • Experience leading engagements and supervising staff.
  • A respectful, relationship-based approach and an understanding of Indigenous histories, governance and the impacts of colonization.
  • After the base experience requirements are met, we hire first and foremost strong analytical thinkers and problem solvers.

Please mention these bonus skills if you have them

  • Audit experience at a firm serving First Nations or public-sector clients
  • Cloud accounting and payroll systems (e.g., QuickBooks Online, Sage, Xero)
  • FMB Financial Administration Law or certification experience
  • Lived experience as a First Nations, Métis or Inuit person, or connection to Indigenous communities

Benefits

Why Treewalk Feels Different

It's Treewalk for a reason: we invest in your growth, trust your judgment, and protect your life outside the ledger.

  • No-Strings Learning Fund – We pay 100% of your CPA modules, annual dues, and any pro-dev courses you choose, and we'll never claw it back if you move on.
  • Freedom Over Face-Time – Own your deadlines, shape your schedule. Hit a midday workout, do the school run; just bring the results.
  • Day-One Peace of Mind – Extended health, dental, vision, and parental-leave benefits start the moment you join.

Who We Are

Treewalk is Vancouver-born and scaling nationwide. Our Indigenous Services group runs the finance operations of Nations and Indigenous organizations and gets them audit-ready, so leadership can focus on their community's goals while we keep the numbers strong.

But labels like "accounting firm" don't capture our DNA. Picture a tech startup powered by CPAs:

  • Holacracy over hierarchy – Ideas outrank titles, and ownership lives on every desk.
  • Relationships first – We earn trust over the long term and work in a way that respects each community's priorities and protocols.
  • Growth at warp speed – One of Canada's fastest-rising advisory practices, we set audacious goals, then sprint past them.
  • Training ground for tomorrow's leaders – Whether you're two years post-designation or a seasoned finance lead, Treewalk is where accountants level up.

The Values That Power Us

Mastery: We hunt knowledge relentlessly and build expertise into every engagement.

Support: No one goes it alone; collaboration is our default setting.

Ownership: We celebrate wins and own slip-ups with equal conviction.

Kaizen: Continuous improvement isn't a buzzword; it's our daily operating system.

Annual Salary - $110,000

raw.description:
Overview: Quality and Test Automation

The Automation QA Engineer is vital for ensuring the reliability, performance, and correctness of our entire supply chain e-commerce platform. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive automated test suites across the e-commerce user interface, complex internal business workflows (MES, WMS, OMS), and the logic governing our next-generation AI agents.

Internship Details

Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote

Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will embed quality assurance directly into the development and deployment lifecycle, serving as the gatekeeper for production releases.

  • Test Suite Development: Develop and maintain robust, end-to-end automated test suites covering critical e-commerce flows (catalog navigation, checkout, payments, invoicing) and complex internal tool workflows (OMS/WMS operations).

  • Quality Gates (CI/CD): Integrate automated test suites into the CI/CD pipeline (managed via Makefile) to enforce quality gates, ensuring no regressions are introduced and the platform adheres to performance standards before deployment.

  • Performance & Load Testing: Implement and execute performance testing and load testing protocols to validate the scalability and resilience of the NestJS modular monolith, especially for high-traffic scenarios and intensive SCM transactions.

  • API Integration Testing: Design and execute automated tests for API integrations between the core supply chain modules (e.g., testing the data contract integrity between WMS and OMS) and external payment services.

  • Test Data Management: Create and maintain reliable test data factories to simulate complex multi-tenant and domain-specific scenarios (e.g., various HS codes, tenant feature flags).

  • Regression Management: Continuously maintain and optimize the regression test suite to provide fast, reliable feedback to development teams operating within the Monorepo structure.

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess strong expertise in automated testing frameworks, CI/CD integration, and performance validation:

  • Automation Frameworks: Experience selecting, building, and maintaining E2E (e.g., Playwright, Cypress) and API testing frameworks.

  • Programming: Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js for writing high-quality, maintainable test code.

  • Performance/Load: Experience with tools for performance and load testing (e.g., JMeter, K6).

  • CI/CD: Practical experience integrating tests into automated pipelines and working within a Monorepo environment.

  • Data & Database: Ability to query PostgreSQL 15 directly to validate data integrity.

AI Agent Focus

You will be responsible for validating the behavior and accuracy of our AI systems.

  • Agent Behavior Testing: Develop tests to validate the deterministic and non-deterministic behaviors of AI agents, ensuring they accurately process inputs, access data securely, and perform their intended functions (e.g., workflow optimization, customer support responses).

  • Integration Validation: Verify the quality of data retrieval and the security of the API layers connecting AI agents (using LangChain/LlamaIndex) to the core WMS/OMS data.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Test Coverage: Measurable increase in automated functional and regression test coverage across critical application paths.

  • Defect Escape Rate: Reduction in the number of critical and high-severity defects escaping to production.

  • Pipeline Reliability: Maintenance of stable, non-flaky test runs within the CI/CD pipeline.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Technical Architect or Engineering Lead, working directly with development teams across the Catalog, OMS, and WMS modules.

ABOUT THE ROLE

AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market.

The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated entirely to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will own AI Security in your territory, from the first conversation through close, hunting the largest new logos while working alongside the Account Executives who already know our customers best. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it.

The timing matters. Abnormal is growing about 50% year over year, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up in close to 80% of customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. Demand is outrunning capacity. You will step into a deep pipeline on day one, and you will have real say in how this category gets sold.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own AI Security in your territory. Carry the AI Security quota and run the full sales cycle end to end, from first conversation through close, including significant upsell campaigns across our existing customer base.
  • Hunt the largest new logos. Take Abnormal's AI Security story into the biggest enterprises in the world, and open doors beyond the customers who already trust us.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly. Inbound interest will outpace your calendar. Decide where your time moves the needle, and where it does not.
  • Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your territory, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most.
  • Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on behavioral AI, cloud security, and agent security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch.
  • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table.
  • Shape the product and the playbook. Feed what you hear in the field back to product leadership in a fast loop, and help build how AI Security gets sold as the suite matures from early availability to GA.
  • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace.

WHAT YOU’LL SELL

Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability:

  • AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost.
  • AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.
  • AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions.
  • AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended.
  • AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW

Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open.

For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of winning new logos and expanding accounts.
  • Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers.
  • A hunter's drive paired with the judgment to prioritize when demand exceeds capacity.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on.
  • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories.
  • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders.
  • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals.

Alkira is growing our Solutions Architect team and looking for high-energy, dedicated professionals who can help new and existing clients succeed on our Network-Infrastructure-as-a-Service platform.

Solutions Architects (SA) are hands-on technologists who embed directly with our largest strategic Enterprise accounts — from pre-sales technical validation through production deployment, adoption, and expansion.

The ideal candidate can demonstrate the key technical differentiators of the Alkira service, architect and build alongside customer teams, and help enterprises transform their network to become disruptive, creative, and innovative. As an FDE, you sit at the intersection of Sales, Engineering, and the customer: you win technical evaluations, deploy real solutions in customer environments, and shape the product roadmap with a deep understanding of customer technical needs.

Location:

This role is remote and open to candidates located anywhere in the UK.

Responsibilities

  • Embed with strategic customers as the hands-on technical owner from evaluation through production deployment
  • Lead network architecture discussions with customers and partners
  • Design, build, and deploy Alkira-based solutions in customer environments using best practices
  • Develop automation, integrations, and tooling (Terraform, APIs, scripting) to accelerate customer deployments
  • Collaborate directly with customer networking, cloud, and platform teams
  • Conduct technical workshops, trainings, and whiteboard sessions for customers and partners
  • Create design and architecture best practices, reference architectures, and deployment guidelines
  • Provide deep technical support and troubleshooting for customers, escalating and driving resolution with Engineering
  • Own customer success on key accounts from adoption and expansion perspective
  • Work with Alkira Product Management and Engineering to provide feedback on upcoming features from the customer's lens
  • Track and drive key customer features/asks with Product Management through to implementation

Minimum Requirements

  • Strong cloud and networking fundamentals
  • 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role (consulting, solutions architecture, sales engineering, or professional services)
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience architecting and deploying cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP, and/or OCI)
  • Hands-on experience designing and building hybrid and public cloud infrastructure
  • Strong networking background in routing technologies and network security
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code and automation tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Python, REST APIs)
  • Experience in large-scale network design/deployment is a plus
  • Strong passion for customer outcomes and creating long-lasting professional relationships
  • Flexibility to travel to customer sites
  • Relevant technical certifications are a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • BA/BS/MS degree is a plus

ABOUT ALKIRA

Alkira, a Lumen company, is building the future of enterprise networking: one programmable platform to connect, secure, and operate every cloud, site, partner, data center, and AI workload.

Founded by Amir and Atif Khan, the creators of Viptela and pioneers of the SD-WAN market, Alkira was built to radically simplify how enterprises deploy and manage network infrastructure. Today, as part of Lumen, we are bringing that cloud-native operating model to a global network foundation trusted by the world’s largest enterprises.

Our platform helps customers move faster without managing hardware, stitching together providers, or operating fragmented cloud networks. Teams can build and scale connectivity on demand, apply consistent security and segmentation, and gain visibility across distributed environments from one place.

At Alkira, you’ll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud-like consumption, private-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build technology that changes how global businesses connect.

Join us and help build the future of networking.

Blanc Labs is a premier partner for global enterprises, leading the way in digitization, automation, and the development of next-generation digital products and services. Our expertise in digital transformation powers businesses to accelerate service delivery, drive customer engagement, and foster growth.

We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead the end-to-end development and lifecycle management of machine learning models powered by proprietary data, within a Microsoft-centric technology environment. This is a highly impactful role at the core of our AI ecosystem, responsible for building scalable, production-grade ML systems on Azure that directly power intelligent product features.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and deploy end-to-end machine learning models using proprietary datasets, primarily within Azure Machine Learning
  • Own the full ML lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and validation
  • Collaborate with Data Scientists to identify and prioritize high-impact ML opportunities
  • Work with Principal AI Engineers to ensure models align with system architecture and engineering best practices across the Azure ecosystem
  • Package and expose trained models as scalable APIs (Azure Functions, Azure App Service, or AKS) for consumption by AI Engineers and downstream systems
  • Build and maintain model pipelines using Azure ML Pipelines / Azure DevOps, including versioning, retraining, and continuous improvement workflows
  • Monitor model performance in production using Azure Monitor and Application Insights, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and relevance over time
  • Troubleshoot model drift, data quality issues, and performance bottlenecks
  • Partner with data engineering teams working in Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Databricks to ensure clean, reliable data pipelines feeding ML workflows
  • Support integration of models with Microsoft-native AI services, including Azure OpenAI Service and Azure AI Studio, where applicable

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in machine learning engineering, with production deployment experience on Microsoft Azure
  • Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn)
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Machine Learning (AML Studio, AML SDK/CLI v2, endpoints, pipelines, model registry)
  • Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation techniques, using Azure Databricks and/or Azure Synapse Analytics
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML models as APIs or microservices using Azure-native compute (Azure Functions, App Service, or Azure Kubernetes Service)
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices on Azure, including model versioning (AML Model Registry), CI/CD via Azure DevOps, monitoring, and retraining pipelines
  • Experience working with large-scale or proprietary datasets stored in Azure Data Lake Storage / Azure SQL
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals (testing, scalability, performance optimization) with familiarity in .NET or C# environments an asset given the broader Microsoft stack
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a Microsoft-centric enterprise environment

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Studio, or Azure Cognitive Services
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Azure Kubernetes Service)
  • Experience with real-time or low-latency ML systems on Azure (Event Hubs, Stream Analytics)
  • Exposure to LLMs or hybrid AI/ML systems, particularly via Azure OpenAI or Microsoft Copilot ecosystem
  • Experience building data pipelines with Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines, or Databricks workflows
  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Data Scientist Associate, Azure Solutions Architect) considered a plus
  • Exposure to Power Platform (Power BI, Power Automate) for surfacing ML outputs to business stakeholders

Accommodations within reason due to a disability or medical need are available on request for candidates taking part in the recruitment process.

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.

  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

Team Overview

The Media and Telecommunications team is focused on expanding TransUnion’s presence across media markets, including social media, video and music streaming, publishing, traditional media, paid content and advertising. The team also supports growth within the telecommunications portfolio by developing new client relationships and increasing the adoption of TransUnion’s data, analytics, fraud, identity and risk capabilities. The Account Director – Telco & Media reports to Head of Utilities & Telco.This is a remote position which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

We’re looking for a Strategic Account Director to join our growing team as we look to expand into Media Markets: social media, content / video streaming, music streaming, publishers, traditional, paid-for and potentially advertising.

This role is primarily geared towards a Senior New Business hunter to make industry buyer connections, understand client CBI’s, gather Voice of Customer (VOC) to help TransUnion with proposition building and ultimately drive new business growth in the Media space. There is also an ambition to grow the client base within our Telecommunications portfolio which again will be powered by net-new business wins with logos not currently engaged with us. There may also be a requirement to manage, protect and grow existing recurring revenue within our wider client base.

Day to Day You’ll Be:

  • Develop and convert new-business opportunities across target Media and Telecommunications organisations, building relationships with relevant buyer groups and senior decision-makers.
  • Establish trusted partnerships with stakeholders across Know Your Customer (KYC), fraud and identity, age verification, digital, marketing, credit risk, customer experience, product, procurement and C-suite functions.
  • Position TransUnion as a long-term strategic partner by aligning its capabilities with client needs, market developments, regulatory priorities and measurable business outcomes.
  • Gather and represent the Voice of the Customer (VOC), ensuring client priorities inform proposition development, product investment, service delivery and innovation.
  • Identify white-space, cross-sell, upsell and net-new opportunities across TransUnion’s products, services and Lines of Business (LOBs).
  • Co-create innovation projects, proofs of concept and pilots with senior stakeholders, with a focus on delivering measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Own revenue performance across the assigned portfolio, including new-business growth, renewals, profitability, protection of existing recurring revenue and sustainable account growth.
  • Lead negotiations for new solutions, contract renewals and extensions, including multi-year and multi-million-pound commercial agreements.
  • Maintain territory and account plans, manage pipeline activity and forecasting, provide leadership reporting, and coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver client outcomes and support sector growth.

Required Knowledge And Experiences
