Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

The France Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-100,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

raw.title: Marketing Automation & Campaign Operations Manager
raw.excerpt: At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.
raw.description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.

OneSpan is seeking a Marketing Automation & Campaign Operations Manager to build and operate the automation and campaign infrastructure that allows OneSpan Marketing to execute sophisticated, measurable, and increasingly personalized programs globally with greater speed, quality, and scale. You will own global campaign delivery and the health and evolution of our Marketo Engage instance across our Digital Agreements and Security businesses, manage campaigns from intake through launch, own platform quality and governance, and build the repeatable processes and automations that make this possible.

This is a hands-on role with growing strategic scope. You will partner with Demand Generation, Field Marketing, Product Marketing, Creative Services, Sales Enablement, Analytics, GTM Systems, Web Operations, and IT. You will contribute to quarterly planning, assess capacity and readiness, and bring data-backed recommendations on priorities and investments. The Director of Marketing Operations sets the overall roadmap and prioritization framework; you help shape both and own delivery against them.

This role is a strong fit for an experienced Marketo practitioner who has led campaign operations and is ready to own a global platform, expand their cross-functional influence, and drive AI and automation work.

Key Responsibilities:

Planning and prioritization

  • Contribute to quarterly planning with Demand Generation, Field Marketing, and Product Marketing; assess operational capacity, dependencies, and readiness for planned campaigns and launches, and flag risks early.
  • Analyze campaign and operational performance to identify trends, gaps, and bottlenecks, and turn findings into practical recommendations for the Director and Marketing leadership.

Marketo administration and platform quality

  • Own the day-to-day health of the Marketo Engage instance, including users, roles, permissions, integrations, and processing performance; troubleshoot issues with the appropriate technical owners.
  • Maintain and improve global program templates, tokens, folder structure, engagement programs, nurture streams, triggered and batch smart campaigns, dynamic content, and segmentations. Use Velocity scripting and webhooks where appropriate.
  • Lead execution of prioritized instance audit and remediation work, including asset retirement, smart campaign cleanup, and technical debt reduction, and recommend architecture improvements that reduce build time and errors.
  • Monitor email deliverability, bounce trends, and communication limits; partner with IT on domain authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and mailbox provider requirements, and escalate issues promptly.

Campaign planning and delivery

  • Own campaign intake, workback schedules, and delivery for webinars, events, email, nurture, product launches, and customer communications. Estimate effort and dependencies, manage stakeholder expectations, and escalate capacity or priority conflicts early.
  • Build and launch Marketo programs, emails, landing pages, forms, and smart campaigns using standardized templates and tokens, with aligned Salesforce campaign records, membership, and statuses.
  • Translate targeting requirements into validated audiences, including installed-base segments that require subscription or other related-record data; document definitions for reuse.
  • Own launch QA and coordinate end-to-end testing with Web Operations, GTM Systems, and IT. Validate audiences, links, registration flows, Litmus email rendering, consent and suppressions, tracking, and Marketo to Salesforce synchronization.

Preference center, consent, and database management

  • Own the marketing email preference center and related workflows, including subscriptions, language preferences, opt-ins, unsubscribes, and consent history. Implement approved consent policies with Privacy and Legal, aligned with GDPR, CASL, and CAN-SPAM.
  • Own day-to-day Marketo database quality, including field completeness, email verification with Validity BriteVerify, deduplication, enrichment checks, list import standards, and reusable exclusions for ineligible audiences.
  • Build and maintain reusable audience segments; analyze segment size, reachability, overlap, and fatigue to recommend targeting improvements and reduce conflicting communications.

Workflow automation and AI enablement

  • Partner with the Marketing AI lead to identify and operationalize automation and AI opportunities within campaign operations, including campaign setup, content variation, QA, audience operations, and intake.
  • Design and maintain structured intake and approval workflows using Microsoft Forms, SharePoint, and Power Automate; make request status, ownership, and delivery expectations visible to stakeholders.
  • Prototype and test automations and agents using approved tools such as Copilot Studio, partnering with technical teams on anything requiring their support.
  • Move validated prototypes into supported workflows with appropriate access, human review, and documentation; measure adoption, time savings, and error reduction.

Campaign governance and measurement

  • Own operational standards for Salesforce campaign hierarchies, naming, metadata, member statuses, and UTM tagging across business units and evergreen programs.
  • Create reusable campaign and operational reports that show engagement, funnel performance, delivery timelines, and recurring bottlenecks; partner with Analytics and BI on attribution definitions and reporting alignment.

Cross-functional delivery and enablement

  • Partner with the lead lifecycle owner on campaign interactions with scoring and routing, and with GTM Systems and IT on Salesforce configuration, integration changes, and testing.
  • Maintain instance documentation, operating procedures, and training materials so the platform remains supportable beyond any single administrator. Train and mentor marketers on Marketo best practices and approved self-service capabilities.

Qualifications:

Required

  • 6+ years of B2B marketing operations or campaign operations experience, including hands-on ownership of campaign builds, launches, and operational improvements.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Marketo Engage experience, including instance administration, program builds, engagement programs, tokens, dynamic content, smart campaign logic, and platform troubleshooting.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce campaigns, campaign hierarchies, membership, and reporting, and of Marketo to Salesforce synchronization, including field mapping, sync errors, and lead and contact behavior.
  • Experience managing marketing databases, audience segmentation, and preference center, consent, and suppression workflows; strong skills in UTM tracking, data validation, and email QA.
  • Working knowledge of email deliverability and global privacy and consent requirements as they apply to marketing automation.
  • Demonstrated experience improving marketing workflows through automation, with the ability to translate business needs into clear requirements and validate results.
  • Strong project management, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to prioritize competing requests, influence without direct authority, and present data-backed recommendations to marketing leadership.

Preferred

  • Adobe Certified Expert, Adobe Marketo Engage Business Practitioner certification, or willingness to obtain it within the first six months.
  • Experience supporting or leading a Marketo instance audit, cleanup, re-architecture, or migration.
  • Familiarity with Velocity scripting, the Marketo REST API, webhooks, middleware or iPaaS tools, and basic proficiency in a scripting language such as JavaScript or Python.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Automate, Forms, SharePoint, Copilot Studio, AI agents, or MCP integrations.
  • Experience with Litmus, Validity BriteVerify, Marketo Measure or other attribution tools, and global campaigns spanning multiple business units.

What success looks like

Success is measured by reliable campaign delivery, platform quality, and measurable improvements in how Marketing works:

  • Speed to market: Shorter intake-to-launch cycle times and on-time launches through reusable templates, streamlined workflows, and automation.
  • Campaign quality: Fewer QA defects and less rework, with consistent adherence to campaign, tracking, and naming standards.
  • Data and attribution: Accurate campaign data, member statuses, and tracking that support reliable funnel and attribution reporting.
  • Platform health: Improved database completeness, email validity, deliverability, and campaign processing efficiency.
  • Efficiency and adoption: Measurable hours saved from automation and AI, and broader use of intake workflows, program templates, and documented processes.
  • Planning contribution: Clear, data-backed recommendations brought into each quarterly planning cycle.

Expected outcomes for the first 12 months include completed priority Marketo audit remediation with a recommended optimization roadmap, a standardized global program template library, current instance documentation, baseline reporting for intake-to-launch cycle time and hours saved, and a portfolio of automation improvements in production with documented reductions in campaign build time, manual effort, or errors, including at least one meaningful AI-enabled workflow deployed through the approved Marketing AI architecture.

Salary: $125,000 - $140,000 (depending on experience and qualifications)

About the Role

This is a system-focused Product Management role responsible for the execution, delivery, and ongoing optimization of BlockWorks Online, our tax-pro-facing digital application. The Senior Product Manager will partner closely with Product Experience, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams to drive seamless execution from discovery through release, delivering high-quality, customer-centric features that improve engagement, satisfaction, and measurable business outcomes. This role requires a strong operator who thrives in fast-paced environments and has experience managing and delivering enhancements across both consumer- and internal-facing applications, while playing a critical role in ensuring BlockWorks Online provides an intuitive, reliable, and engaging experience for clients and tax pros.

Day to day, you'll...

  • Manage the BWO product backlog, prioritization, and release planning
  • Partner closely with Product Experience, Engineering, and Design to define requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
  • Lead implementation of features and enhancements, ensuring the right solutions are built and delivered on time with high quality
  • Use data and customer insights to inform feature enhancements and experience improvements
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies and collaborate within an Agile delivery model
  • Ensure appropriate instrumentation, testing, and reporting capabilities are in place to support product performance and experimentation
  • Identify future and near-term risks, dependencies, and delivery challenges, proactively driving resolution and partnering with other system teams as needed
  • Ensure a smooth end-to-end tax pro and client experience across releases
  • Serve as the BWO subject matter expert, acting as a bridge between Product Experience, Engineering, and business stakeholders
  • Support continuous optimization of the experience through A/B testing, experimentation, and ongoing product improvements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 4+ years of product management experience, preferably supporting consumer-facing digital products or applications
  • Proven ability to manage backlogs, prioritize work, and deliver features in an Agile environment
  • Demonstrated experience partnering with cross-functional teams to drive execution and delivery
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and modern delivery methodologies (Agile, Lean, DevOps)
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data to inform decisions
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated learning mindset with experience applying experimentation frameworks to inform product decisions
  • Comfort leveraging AI tools throughout the product development lifecycle and curiosity for emerging technologies
  • A track record of improving end-to-end user experiences, not just shipping individual features
  • Experience managing multiple initiatives simultaneously while meeting deadlinesConfidence making decisions, learning quickly, and adjusting course based on feedback

Why work for us

At H&R Block, our purpose is simple: to provide help and inspire confidence in our clients and communities everywhere. For more than 70 years, we’ve led the tax industry and we continue to evolve through our Block Next strategy, blending human expertise with digital innovation.

That same commitment to care extends to our associates. When you join us, you become part of a High Performing, Connected Culture built on strong relationships, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful impact. We invest in your well-being through competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and support for life both in and outside of work.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

We combine data-driven content, rigorous product comparisons and user-first design, supported by a modern, scalable technology and data platform. Our global teams bring together expertise across performance marketing, product, commercial operations, data and analytics.

Our Data & Analytics organisation builds the products, platforms and intelligence that support commercial decision making across the business.

Overview

We're looking for a Business Analytics Manager who can turn complex business performance data into clear insights, recommendations and better commercial decisions.

You'll lead a small team of Analysts working directly with our business verticals, acting as a trusted analytics partner to General Managers and their commercial teams. Your focus will be on helping the business understand its performance, identify opportunities for growth and make better decisions through accurate, actionable data.

This is a hands-on leadership role that combines commercial understanding, analytical expertise and stakeholder management. You'll help your team move beyond reporting what happened to explaining why it happened, what it means for the business and what we should do next.

The Opportunity

Our Business Analytics team works directly with General Managers and their teams to understand commercial performance and identify opportunities to improve profitability.

You'll manage a small team of Analysts aligned to different business verticals, helping them become trusted partners to their stakeholders while maintaining a consistent standard of analytical quality across the organisation.

A significant part of the role involves understanding how the business makes money, from traffic acquisition and customer journeys through to conversions, partner performance, revenue and profitability. You'll help ensure that commercial and financial reporting is accurate, explainable and trusted, working closely with Finance and other Data teams to investigate discrepancies and improve the underlying information.

You'll also work with senior stakeholders to translate business questions into clear analytical requirements, prioritise opportunities and turn complex findings into compelling stories and practical recommendations.

This is an opportunity to shape how Analytics supports the business, developing a team that proactively identifies opportunities rather than simply responding to reporting requests.

What You'll Do

Commercial Performance & Business Partnership

  • Act as a trusted analytics partner to General Managers and senior commercial stakeholders, helping them understand the drivers of revenue, profitability and business performance. You'll work with your team to identify trends, investigate changes in performance and recommend opportunities for growth, ensuring analysis is grounded in a strong understanding of how each business operates.

Financial Accuracy & Data Confidence

  • Help establish confidence in the commercial data used to manage the business. You'll work closely with Finance, Revenue Operations and Data Engineering to understand revenue, costs, partner performance and profitability, investigate discrepancies and ensure reporting is accurate and explainable. You'll champion analytical rigour while recognising the importance of delivering timely, practical information to stakeholders.

Business Insight & Storytelling

  • Guide your team in translating complex datasets into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences. You'll help Analysts move beyond dashboards and descriptive reporting to explain the underlying drivers of performance, challenge assumptions and communicate what the business should do next. You'll also help identify opportunities for deeper analysis, forecasting and experimentation.

Analytics Products & Business Requirements

  • Translate commercial questions into clear analytical requirements, working with Analytics, BI, Engineering and Data Science teams to develop scalable reporting and insight products. You'll help identify where reusable datasets, dashboards and analytical approaches can replace repetitive work, improve consistency and enabling stakeholders to access trusted information more independently.

Team Leadership & Prioritisation

  • Lead and develop a small team of vertical-aligned Analysts, supporting their technical development, commercial understanding and stakeholder relationships. You'll help prioritise work across business areas, balance immediate commercial needs with longer-term improvements, and ensure the team's capacity is focused on delivering the greatest value. You'll remain technically involved, reviewing analytical approaches and helping the team tackle complex problems.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for someone who combines strong analytical expertise with commercial judgement, excellent communication skills and the ability to lead a team.

You'll likely bring:

  • Experience in business analytics, commercial analytics or performance analytics, including experience managing or mentoring Analysts.
  • Strong commercial understanding, with experience analysing revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, sales performance or other key business drivers.
  • Experience working directly with senior business stakeholders, translating complex questions into analytical requirements and actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex findings clearly and influence commercial decisions.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets.
  • Experience with BI and visualisation platforms such as Tableau, Power BI or Looker.
  • A strong understanding of data quality, reporting accuracy and the importance of reconciling commercial information with financial outcomes.
  • Experience prioritising analytical work across multiple stakeholders, balancing commercial urgency with analytical quality.
  • Experience coaching and developing Analysts, helping them build both technical capability and commercial confidence.
  • A proactive, curious approach to problem solving, with the ability to identify opportunities rather than simply respond to requests.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in performance marketing, affiliate marketing, lead generation or digital publishing.
  • Familiarity with marketing and acquisition data from platforms such as GA4, Google Ads, Meta or other advertising platforms.
  • Experience working with Finance, Revenue Operations or commercial reporting teams.
  • Experience analysing sales performance, partner economics, conversion funnels or customer profitability.
  • Python experience for statistical analysis, forecasting or more advanced analytical work.
  • Experience collaborating with Data Scientists on predictive modelling, experimentation or customer analytics.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery.
  • Experience developing reusable analytical products or self-service reporting capabilities.
  • Experience working with distributed teams and agile delivery processes.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help shape how Analytics influences commercial decisions across a growing, data-driven business.

You'll work directly with senior business leaders on meaningful commercial challenges, lead a talented team of Analysts and collaborate with specialists across Engineering, BI, Data Science and Revenue Operations.

You'll have the opportunity to develop a Business Analytics function that goes beyond reporting, building trusted relationships, improving the quality of business information and helping our teams make better, faster and more profitable decisions.

raw.excerpt: Wing Assistant places contractors across 25+ role types — GVAs, EAs, SDRs, CSRs, and more — for clients across the Philippines, LATAM, and global markets.
raw.description:
Wing Assistant places contractors across 25+ role types — GVAs, EAs, SDRs, CSRs, and more — for clients across the Philippines, LATAM, and global markets. Internal coordination runs through Discord as the single source of truth: pre-demo requests, mid-call heads-up, post-demo handoffs, and ongoing status all live in one place, so nothing gets lost between people.

This isn't a role for someone who wants a well-worn script.

The accelerated process rewards judgment — reading a client in real time, reading a candidate's fit on the fly, and knowing when to move before the moment closes.

The Account Placement Specialist is responsible for managing the end-to-end client engagement process at Wing Assistant.

You'll Own

  • Understand potential customer input through intake forms and quickly leverage on organization-wide ATS systems to find candidates that match the skillset- interview candidates to ensure fit for what potential client is looking for
  • Discovery & demo: Run full discovery calls and qualify what the client actually needs, then present
    Wing's value and bring live, vetted candidates directly into the call — real people, no recordings, no async profiles.
  • The close: Read the room and close while interest is highest — propose next steps before the call ends, and formalize the deal in Discord/JRF within 30–60 minutes.
  • Candidate bench: Keep the idle-pool current and taggable by role, industry, and availability, so you can pull 2–3 credible matches from a loose brief with 10–30 minutes' notice.
  • Flake-proofing: Confirm candidate availability at T-24h and again at T-30min; always have a backup identified before the call, not after someone drops out.
  • Post-close: Finalize compliance and formal matching once a deal closes, and keep CSM/TA aligned on onboarding status in real time.

Must Haves

  • Has personally run outbound/discovery through to close — not just handed off qualified leads
  • Recruiting or sourcing experience with genuine same-day turnaround, not multiday pipelines
  • Comfortable improvising live — can steer a call and brief a candidate in 10–15 minutes on the spot
  • Fast and responsive by nature — minutes, not hours, is this role's working speed

Nice to Have

  • Staffing, recruiting, or B2B services sales background
  • Already comfortable working async-first in Discord/Slack as the source of truth
  • History of maintaining a “warm bench” of backup candidates proactively
  • Track record of anticipating problems (candidate no-shows, client cold feet) before they happen

raw.description:
Who We Are:

Maa-Althahab is a Subsidiary brand from MAISON DE MAA Group, a leading and most famous fragrance brand in the Middle East and Africa. Founded in 2006, the company pursued innovative thinking in making unique global perfumes which match the lifestyles and personalities of all clients.

Job Purpose

The Group Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and executing the Group's marketing strategy across all markets and brands. The role ensures consistent brand positioning, effective marketing campaigns, successful product launches, and efficient budget management while driving business growth, increasing brand awareness, and supporting sales objectives

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and monitor the Group Marketing Strategy and annual marketing plans and budgets across all markets.
  • Analyze market dynamics, consumer behavior, industry trends, and competitive landscapes to identify growth opportunities.
  • Lead and manage the Brand Managers and Marketing Managers, ensuring the smooth execution of daily marketing operations.
  • Develop the annual promotions and discount calendar for all countries in collaboration with the Sales team.
  • Plan, execute, and monitor marketing campaigns and promotional activities across all countries based on market research, consumer insights, and local business requirements, including market visits when required.
  • Develop and implement brand promotion strategies to strengthen brand awareness, positioning, and long-term brand equity.
  • Prepare media and communication plans for each brand and oversee their execution across all countries to ensure consistency and effectiveness.
  • Provide innovative ideas and strategic recommendations to improve marketing efficiency, effectiveness, and overall business performance.
  • Recruit, lead, coach, and develop the marketing team to achieve monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual objectives.
  • Lead the successful launch of new products across all markets by developing comprehensive go-to-market plans tailored to each country's target audience and media landscape.
  • Conduct competitor analysis, including product assortment, pricing, promotions, market share, product availability, and positioning.
  • Monitor marketing budgets and ensure effective allocation of resources to maximize return on investment (ROI).
  • Measure and analyze the performance of marketing campaigns using relevant KPIs and recommend corrective actions where required.
  • Prepare regular marketing performance reports, campaign evaluations, and country business reviews for executive management.
  • Work closely with Sales, E-commerce, Creative, Product Development, and Country Managers to align marketing initiatives with business objectives.
  • Ensure brand guidelines and visual identity are consistently applied across all countries and marketing channels

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive marketing experience.
  • At least 5 years in a managerial or regional marketing leadership role.
  • Experience managing multiple brands and international markets.
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Experience with marketing analytics tools, CRM systems, and digital advertising platforms is an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing, social media, and e-commerce.
  • Excellent leadership and people management skills.
